cases.title_en: Rooftop Cat Sniper Protects Stray Cat
cases.description_zh: X 原帖公开提示词（6812 字）· Seedance 2.5 视频案例。
cases.author: HeyAirahAi
cases.prompt:
— 30 seconds, 16:9, live-action cinematic realism, soft overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, gentle desaturated tones. Whimsical, heartwarming comedy played completely straight. Keep the characters and locations identical in every shot.

CHARACTERS (repeat in every part)
NANA: young woman with a short black bob and a warm, easy smile, wearing a strapless black-and-grey patterned top and black-and-white beaded bracelets on her wrist.
SHU: a large, fluffy cream-colored long-haired cat with a flat grumpy face and blue-grey eyes, lying like a sniper behind a black tripod-mounted sniper rifle with a scope. The scope's front lens has a glowing ring that is dark, then orange, then blue.
STRAY CAT: a small orange-and-white tabby cat living in a concrete wall opening in an alley.
DOG: a lean grey short-haired dog that appears from a dark doorway in the alley.
LOCATION 1: a city rooftop with a ribbed grey mat on a low ledge, a small burlap pouch, an overcast sky and brick buildings far behind.
LOCATION 2: a grimy back alley with a grey concrete wall with a square opening, a blue ceramic bowl on the ground, a tall grey metal trash can, black trash bags, a brick wall and a dark doorway at the far end.

===== PART 1 (00:00-00:09.6) =====

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:02.5) — Distraction
Medium shot on the rooftop. Nana leans over the ledge beside Shu and playfully pushes her face toward his. Shu swats her face away with a front paw and returns his eye to the scope; she grins and keeps teasing him. Camera static.
SOUND: soft wind, distant city hum, her light giggles and a soft paw tap.

SHOT 2 (00:02.5-00:03.9) — Scope View
Black circular scope vignette with crosshair. Down in the alley, the stray cat eats from the blue bowl next to the wall opening, then looks up.
SOUND: the wind drops away, a muffled low hush, faint crunching from the bowl.

SHOT 3 (00:03.9-00:04.8) — The Charge
Front close-up on the rooftop. Nana, blurred, gasps with her mouth open and a surprised "oh". Shu stares through the scope with one eye closed, grumpy. The ring on the scope's front lens begins to glow orange.
SOUND: a loud sharp gasp from Nana, a rising electronic charge hum.

SHOT 4 (00:04.8-00:05.1) — Fire
A bright orange muzzle flash from the rifle.
SOUND: a crisp flash-whoosh pop.

SHOT 5 (00:05.1-00:07.0) — The Fish
Alley view. A grilled fish-shaped projectile with a bright orange flame trail streaks toward the stray cat's bowl, then glides in slow motion with the trail fading. Speed: fast at first, then SLOW MOTION (about 30-40% speed) for the glide.
SOUND: a rushing whoosh with a fiery crackle, then stretched and softened as it slows.

SHOT 6 (00:07.0-00:09.6) — Dinner
The fish drops gently into the blue bowl. The stray cat creeps out of the wall opening, sniffs it, and starts to eat. Close-up, then medium close-up.
SOUND: a soft plop in the bowl, quiet cat steps, soft eating sounds.

===== PART 2 (00:09.6-00:20.0) =====

SHOT 7 (00:09.6-00:11.5) — The Intruder
Wide alley shot. The stray cat eats at the right beside its wall opening. At the far end a grey dog appears from the dark doorway and starts walking toward it. The stray cat looks up warily.
SOUND: a low tense hum builds, a dog's low growl, light claw clicks on concrete.

SHOT 8 (00:11.5-00:12.4) — Orange Glow
Rooftop. Nana smiles and strokes Shu's fluffy back, then notices something and her mouth opens. The rifle's barrel glows orange.
SOUND: a soft fur-stroke rustle, her quick inhale, a faint electric hum.

SHOT 9 (00:12.4-00:13.6) — Blue Mode
The rifle's glow changes from orange to blue. Nana looks tense with pursed lips, Shu stays calm.
SOUND: a short electronic mode-switch click, a rising cold hum.

SHOT 10 (00:13.6-00:14.6) — The Dog Runs
Scope view. The grey dog sprints down the alley toward the stray cat, who stays by the wall opening.
SOUND: fast paw patter on concrete, a low growl, a heartbeat-like pulse.

SHOT 11 (00:14.6-00:15.6) — Aim
Rooftop front close-up. Nana and Shu stare through the scope, the ring glowing blue. A small blue flash appears at the muzzle at about 00:15.0.
SOUND: tense silence, a held breath, then a quiet energy pop.

SHOT 12 (00:15.6-00:16.0) — The Blue Shot
Wide alley shot. The dog leaps toward the stray cat. A blue energy ball with a blue trail from the right hits the dog's chest in a bright blue flash.
SOUND: a sharp energy zap and a bright impact boom.

SHOT 13 (00:16.0-00:17.2) — Blasted
The dog is thrown upright onto its hind legs, spins in the air, and is flung backward into the trash can. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 50% speed, estimate).
SOUND: stretched whoosh, a yelp, a clang as it hits the metal can.

SHOT 14 (00:17.2-00:17.9) — Topple
The trash can topples over the dog and rolls on the concrete.
SOUND: a loud metal crash, a long rolling rattle, then silence.

SHOT 15 (00:17.9-00:19.5) — Safe
The stray cat peeks out of its wall opening, then returns to eating the fish, while the trash can lies behind it and the dog lies under it.
SOUND: a soft meow, quiet eating, light alley ambience.

SHOT 16 (00:19.5-00:20.0) — Smug
Rooftop. Nana laughs happily beside Shu, who has half-closed eyes and a smug look.
SOUND: her bright laugh, wind.

===== PART 3 (00:20.0-00:30.2) =====

SHOT 17 (00:20.0-00:22.9) — Victory Wave
Front shot. Nana laughs and raises her hand with the palm out toward Shu, who stares grumpily straight at the camera behind the rifle.
SOUND: her happy laugh and light clapping of hands in the breeze.

SHOT 18 (00:22.9-00:24.0) — The Pouch
Close side shot. Nana picks up the burlap pouch and opens it. A small metal bowl sits on the ledge.
SOUND: a paper rustle, a soft metal clink.

SHOT 19 (00:24.0-00:27.8) — Reward
Nana holds the pouch and talks to Shu, leaning over the ledge. Shu taps the metal bowl with a paw. She points a finger at him as if teaching him, then takes out a small tin can.
SOUND: her soft voice in a murmur (no clear words), a paw tap on the metal bowl.

SHOT 20 (00:27.8-00:30.2) — Dinner for Shu
She opens the tin and spoons its contents into the bowl with a small spoon, smiling, while Shu watches with a grumpy, unmoved face. Hold, then end.
SOUND: a tin pull-tab click, a spoon scrape and a soft plop.

MASTER EFFECTS INVENTORY
1. Round scope-view vignette with crosshair (Shots 2, 10).
2. Scope lens ring glowing orange then blue (Shots 3, 8, 9, 11).
3. Slow-motion fish glide with a flame trail (Shot 5).
4. Blue energy ball hit and slow-motion dog blast (Shots 12-13).
5. Trash can topple (Shot 14).

SPEED SUMMARY
Slow motion: Shot 5 (about 30-40%), Shot 13 (about 50%, estimate).
Everything else: real time.

ENERGY ARC
Part 1 (0-10s): playful teasing, then the fish shot feeds the stray cat.
Part 2 (10-20s): the dog appears, the blue shot saves the stray cat.
Part 3 (20-30s): the laughing reward for Shu.

cases.author: mehvishs25
cases.prompt:
Visual Style
Ultra-photorealistic live-action Korean mystery drama, indistinguishable from footage captured on an ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses. Premium Netflix-quality production. Natural performances, realistic human movement, consistent protagonist throughout every frame, physically accurate lighting, ray-traced reflections, realistic skin texture, authentic Seoul architecture, subtle cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, realistic handheld stabilization, smooth Steadicam movement, premium production design, HDR, 4K. Absolutely no AI artifacts, morphing, flickering, identity drift, warped hands, unrealistic expressions, impossible transitions, or abrupt scene changes.
0:00–0:05 | Rainy Evening
A peaceful rainy evening in Seoul.
A slow cinematic drone shot reveals narrow streets glowing beneath warm storefront lights. Rain falls gently onto wet pavement, creating beautiful reflections of cafés, bookstores, and street lamps.
The camera slowly descends to street level.
A beautiful young Korean woman, around 24 years old, walks naturally along the sidewalk carrying a transparent umbrella. She wears a beige trench coat, cream knit sweater, black trousers, and white sneakers. Her long black hair moves gently with the breeze. Other pedestrians pass naturally without acknowledging her. Traffic flows realistically in the background.
Everything feels like a real Korean film.
0:05–0:10 | The Bookstore
She notices a quiet independent bookstore tucked between two cafés.
Warm light spills onto the wet pavement through large glass windows.
She pauses.
Closes her umbrella.
Naturally shakes off the rain.
Opens the wooden glass door.
A small bell rings softly.
The camera follows her inside in one continuous Steadicam shot without cutting.
Inside, shelves are filled with books, warm wooden furniture, soft ambient lighting, and a few customers quietly reading.
The environment feels authentic and lived in.
0:10–0:15 | The Discovery
She slowly walks through the aisles.
Running her fingers gently across book spines.
She notices one beautiful hardcover book displayed alone.
She picks it up.
As she opens it...
A single elegant orange envelope slowly slides out and lands gently on the wooden floor.
The envelope carries a subtle warm glow.
Nothing supernatural.
Just enough to draw attention.
She kneels.
Picks it up carefully.
Opens it.
Inside is a perfectly preserved photograph.
0:15–0:21 | The Photograph
Close-up.
The photograph shows...
Her.
Standing inside this exact bookstore.
Wearing the exact same outfit.
Holding the exact same book.
But...
The photograph is dated 10 years in the future.
The camera slowly pushes toward her face.
She studies every tiny detail.
Her breathing becomes slightly heavier.
No exaggerated acting.
Only subtle confusion and disbelief.
The ambient bookstore sounds become quieter, allowing the emotional moment to breathe.
0:21–0:26 | The Stranger
She slowly raises her head.
Across the bookstore...
A woman is quietly reading beside the window.
The camera slowly reveals her.
She looks almost identical.
Same facial features.
Same gentle smile.
Slightly older.
Elegant cream overcoat.
Hair styled a little differently.
The older woman looks up.
Their eyes meet.
She smiles warmly.
Says nothing.
Everything around them continues normally.
Customers browse books.
A barista prepares coffee.
Rain continues outside.
The world never stops.
0:26–0:30 | The Letter
The older woman calmly closes her book.
Walks toward the exit.
As she passes a nearby wooden table...
She quietly places another identical orange envelope on it.
Without looking back...
She exits through the front door.
The bell rings softly.
The younger woman immediately follows.
She steps outside.
The rainy street is completely normal.
Pedestrians continue walking.
Cars continue passing.
The older woman is nowhere to be seen.
The camera slowly pulls upward as the younger woman looks down at the second envelope in her hands.
Rain continues falling.
Fade to black.
Global Cinematic Direction
Every location must look like a real place in Seoul, filmed on location with practical lighting and premium cinema cameras. Maintain perfect facial consistency for both versions of the protagonist. The older woman should look like the same person approximately ten years later through subtle aging, hairstyle, posture, and wardrobe—not heavy makeup.
Camera movement should remain elegant and restrained: slow dolly shots, gentle Steadicam tracking, natural push-ins, and smooth crane movements. Every transition must have a logical cause-and-effect relationship. No sudden location jumps, no impossible continuity, and no unexplained character movement. Background extras should behave naturally and independently, creating the feeling of a genuine bookstore rather than an AI-generated environment.
The orange motif should appear only in the envelope, its subtle reflections, and the warm bookstore lighting, keeping it tasteful.

Overall tone: quiet, emotional, mysterious, and deeply cinematic, like the opening sequence of a premium Korean mystery film. The mystery comes from the story and performances, not from excessive visual effects, making the entire sequence feel believable and polished.

Scene 4 — Red Crystal Monsters Emerge: Show a wide establishing shot of the city street as massive red crystalline structures rise from beneath the asphalt. The road shakes, dust clouds spread across the street, and fragments of pavement scatter through the air. Giant jagged red crystals grow upward and outward, creating a dangerous obstacle in the middle of the road. Tall buildings surround the scene, with realistic urban details and daylight illuminating the environment. Use a smooth cinematic camera movement to reveal the enormous scale of the destruction.

Scene 5 — The Giant Green Crystal Creature: Cut to a large, intimidating monster made of green crystalline rock emerging onto the city street. Its body is enormous and heavily armored, with irregular stone plates, sharp crystal spikes, rough textures, and a bright glowing green core in its chest. Green magical energy pulses through the cracks in its rocky body. The creature lowers its massive head and moves forward with heavy, powerful steps. Scene 6 — The Final Monster Battle: Reveal several enormous crystal monsters standing together in the middle of the city. The monsters move aggressively through the street, turning their heads, raising their massive limbs, and preparing to attack. Their movements should feel heavy and powerful rather than cartoonish. Show realistic weight, physical impacts, flying debris, dust, and subtle camera shake.

Scene 7 — Powerful Green Energy Blast: Show a giant red-and-pink crystalline monster charging a powerful attack. Bright green magical energy gathers around its head and mouth, becoming increasingly intense. The energy forms a concentrated glowing beam that shoots forward across the city street. The beam illuminates nearby buildings, crystal surfaces, and the road with vivid green light. Dust, tiny crystal fragments, and glowing particles swirl around the blast. Capture the moment with a dramatic side-angle camera shot, followed by a wider view showing the beam cutting through the air.

Visual Style and Technical Details: Photorealistic Hollywood superhero movie, extremely detailed 3D CGI, realistic human characters, giant fantasy crystal monsters, physically accurate lighting, translucent red and green crystals, glowing emerald magical energy, natural daylight, realistic urban destruction, cinematic depth of field, volumetric dust, atmospheric perspective, high-detail textures, realistic shadows, smooth character animation, dramatic camera transitions, wide-angle establishing shots, close-up facial shots, low-angle monster shots, and epic action-movie visual effects.

Consistency Instructions: Maintain the same blonde girl, the same clothing, the same green protective dome, the same red crystal formations, the same giant green crystal monster, the same red-and-pink crystal monster, and the same city-street environment throughout the video. Follow the scene order described above. Do not introduce unrelated characters, random superheroes, different locations, unnecessary scene changes, or extra objects that do not appear in the reference. Keep the composition, creature designs, colors, proportions, and action as close to the reference video as possible.

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic Japanese school action-comedy video that closely follows the reference video, preserving the same characters, clothing, classroom layout, lighting, camera angles, and exact sequence of events. The video takes place in a bright Japanese high school classroom with large windows, wooden desks, chairs, a green bulletin board, classroom cabinets, and an open wooden classroom door.

He stands near the open classroom doorway, holding a dark navy schoolbag with tan-colored straps. He shouts, “How dare you hit me!” His facial expression shows anger and disbelief. In the foreground, the girl remains seated, looking down at her notebook as if she is completely uninterested in his threats.

Scene 2 — The Girl Remains Calm: Show a close-up of the young woman with straight, shoulder-length silver-blue hair, delicate facial features, and a small hair accessory. She wears a light-gray school blazer, white shirt, pale-blue ribbon tie, and dark pleated school skirt. She quietly studies her open notebook while holding a pen. The red-haired boy remains visible in the background near the door, holding the burning schoolbag. Other students in matching gray school uniforms sit at nearby desks, watching the confrontation with surprise. Maintain the natural daylight coming through the large classroom windows.

Scene 3 — The Sudden Martial Arts Kick: The silver-blue-haired girl suddenly springs into action. Using a nearby wooden desk for balance, she performs an extremely fast, powerful spinning kick across the classroom. cases.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic Korean home video from around 2003, casually recorded by a friend using an early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder. Capture an ordinary, slightly lazy evening with spontaneous moments, imperfect framing, and authentic everyday behavior.

**CHARACTER:** A young adult Korean woman in her early 20s with natural beauty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, and long black hair loosely tied in a messy side ponytail. She wears a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, and a simple silver necklace. Maintain consistent facial identity, outfit, and body proportions throughout.

**STORY:**

She wakes up from an evening nap in her modest Seoul apartment, looking sleepy and confused. She sits on the bed, rubs her eyes, stretches lazily, and checks the time on an old bedside clock. Her messy ponytail is half undone, and she yawns at the camera before saying, “Wait… is it evening already?”

She slips on her sneakers, grabs a little shopping bag, and leaves the apartment. The camera follows her down the stairs and through a narrow residential street filled with parked bicycles, overhead wires, small shops, and warm evening sunlight.

She visits a tiny neighborhood convenience shop, picks up potato chips, chocolate, instant noodles, and a bottled drink, then examines a snack packet suspiciously before laughing at the camera. She pays at the counter and walks outside with her purchases.

Feeling thirsty, she stops at an outdoor public water tap beside a small neighborhood park. She unties her ponytail, lets her long black hair fall naturally around her shoulders, splashes a little water onto her face, and drinks directly from the running tap with her hands cupped beneath it. Water drips from her fingers, and she laughs when a little splashes onto her top. She wipes her face with her hand and shakes her loose hair back casually.

She sits on a low concrete wall beneath the trees, opens her chips, takes a crunchy bite, and watches children playing and neighbors walking past. She offers a snack toward the camera as if sharing it with her friend filming.

Finally, she walks back home along the quiet street, carrying her snacks. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera with a sleepy but happy smile and says, “Okay, now I'm ready for the evening!” The footage ends abruptly as her friend laughs and the camera tilts toward the ground.

**CAMERA & FOOTAGE:** Authentic 4 3 early-2000s MiniDV footage, handheld shake, imperfect framing, delayed camera reactions, accidental zooms, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild compression noise, and natural motion blur. No polished cinematography or smooth tracking shots.

**SETTING:** A modest Seoul apartment and an older Korean residential neighborhood circa 2003, narrow lanes, small convenience shops, public outdoor water taps, concrete walls, bicycles, overhead wires, and leafy neighborhood corners.

**AUDIO:** Natural evening ambience, birds, distant scooters, footsteps, shop door chime, snack packaging, coins, running water, splashing, crunching chips, neighborhood chatter, and spontaneous laughter. Casual natural English dialogue. No background music or narration.

**REALISM & CONTINUITY:** Natural sleepy expressions, believable hand movements, realistic water flow and splashes, consistent clothing and accessories, and a single continuous character identity. Her ponytail is untied only when she stops at the water tap and remains loose afterward. The video must feel like a forgotten personal recording from 2003, not a staged production.

公開できる日が来るとは感無量でございます😭

※使い方
・引用元ポストでアンカー画像を生成
・アンカー画像とキャラシート指示書同時投入

※使用アグリゲーター（同一プロンプト）
・前半、SJinn WAN3.0 480p（調整済み）
・後半、SJinn Seedance2.5 480p（未調整）

※キャラシート指示書
👇️👇️👇️
【出力仕様】シンプルなキャラクターシートを1枚生成する。アスペクト比は16:9固定。完成画像を1枚だけ生成する。文字、タイトル、ラベル、数字、ロゴ、説明文、枠線、装飾は入れない。ポスター風デザイン、雑誌風デザイン、制作過程、比較画像、分割比較レイアウトは生成しない。\
【入力】本指示書と同時に、完成済みのアンカー画像を1枚だけ添付する。添付画像を唯一の人物・顔・髪・体型・衣装参照として使用する。\
【目的】アンカー画像の人物と衣装を正確に維持したまま、動画制作で使用しやすい、シンプルで見やすい16:9のキャラクターシートを作成する。人物と衣装の立体構造確認に加え、顔立ちや髪の印象も確認しやすい資料とする。\
【構成】1枚の16:9画面内に合計6ビューを整理して配置する。画面の左から中央にかけて、全身三面図を左から「正面全身／側面全身／背面全身」の順に横並びで3つ配置する。画面右側には、顔アップを上から「やや左向き／正面／やや右向き」の順に縦方向で3つ配置する。\
【人物同一性】アンカー画像の人物の顔立ち、目元、鼻筋、口元、輪郭、年齢感、肌、髪型、髪色、髪の長さ、前髪、体型、身長感、頭身、肩幅、胴体幅、腰幅、脚の長さ、脚の太さを維持する。全身三面図と顔アップ3点のすべてを同一人物として自然に揃える。\
【全身三面図】全身三面図は同一人物を3方向から見たものとして統一し、頭頂から足元まで切れずに収める。アンカー画像の衣装を主たる参照として、襟、袖、胸元、胴体部分、腰周辺の装飾、スカートやボトムの丈、スリット位置、布の重なり、色、柄、素材感、靴の形状をできる限り整合的に維持する。正面図はアンカー画像の人物と衣装を基準に最も忠実に再現する。側面図は人物と衣装の立体構造が分かる自然な真横向き、背面図は髪の後ろ姿、肩、背中、衣装背面、脚、靴の後ろ側を自然に再構成する。側面図と背面図はアンカー画像に見えていない部分を推定で補完してよいが、正面図と矛盾しないようにする。\
【顔アップ】顔アップはアンカー画像を主たる参照として、参照人物の顔立ち、目元、鼻筋、口元、髪型、髪色、雰囲気をできる限り維持する。3つの顔アップを同一人物として自然に揃える。髪の流れや顔まわりの印象はアンカー画像と矛盾しないように整える。衣装の襟元や肩周辺は適度に見えてよいが、顔の確認を優先する。「やや左向き」「やや右向き」は完全な横顔ではなく、顔立ちが十分に分かる程度の軽い角度にする。\
【姿勢】全身三面図は3方向すべてニュートラルな直立姿勢とする。正面図は真正面を向き、両腕は身体からわずかに離して自然に下ろし、両脚は軽く間隔を空けて立つ。側面図は真横から見た姿勢とし、腕で胴体の輪郭を完全に隠さない。背面図は完全に後ろを向き、顔をカメラ側へ振り返らせない。特徴的なポーズは取らず、身体と衣装の構造確認を優先する。\
【背景】背景は無地の明るい白、またはごく薄いライトグレー。装飾や模様は入れない。床表現も最小限にし、人物確認を優先する。\
【レイアウト】画面幅の約4分の3を全身三面図、約4分の1を顔アップ縦3点に使用する。全身三面図3体が主役として十分な大きさで見えるように画面左から中央の横長領域を広く使い、顔アップ3点は画面右側の縦列に上から下まで均等な間隔で並べる。全身と顔アップが干渉せず、衣装確認と顔確認の両方がしやすい構成にする。余白は適度に確保し、各ビューが十分な大きさで見えるようにする。\
【全体トーン】シンプル、クリーン、実用的。動画用資料として見やすく、人物と衣装の構造確認を優先する。デザインポスター化しない。\
【禁止】文字、タイトル、ラベル、番号、ロゴ、説明文、装飾フレーム、背景演出、ポスター風演出、過度な陰影演出、別人化、衣装変更、配色変更、柄の簡略化しすぎ、特徴的なポーズ、脚の交差、腕上げ、全身三面図を小さくしすぎるレイアウト、顔アップを横並びにするレイアウト、側面図や背面図で正面図と矛盾する構造、手足の欠損、人物同士の重なり。

Title: SHARED_KARATE_SPEED_ACTION_LOCATION_SEPARATION_v1_2_COMPACT

※動画生成プロンプト
👇️👇️👇️
[DECLARATION]
15秒・1:1スクエア。PHOTOREAL CINEMATIC HIGH-SPEED KARATE ACTION。
広大な木造修練場で、主人公が離れた地点間を爆発的に横断し、到着地点ごとに鋭い空手技を完成させる。大胆なコマ落ち、位置飛び、残影、強烈な打撃とインパクトフレーム、巨大木柱の破壊。終盤は空中高くで圧倒的な存在感を放ち、巨大な衝撃と圧力波で締める。

[REFERENCE]
@image1 主人公のキャラクターシート1枚。顔・頭部形状・髪・体型・衣装・靴・全身シルエットを唯一の人物参照として全編維持する。各ビューは同一人物。シート背景・枠線・文字・管理レイアウトは映像化しない。

[CONDITION]
巨大な古い木造修練場。高い梁天井、太い木製柱、遠方まで続く木板床、格子窓、冷たい自然光、薄い粉塵。柱間は数十メートル級に広く、複数の柱列で奥行きと横幅を見せる。
地点は同一空間内に固定：A＝左手前、B＝右奥の開けた床、C＝左奥の柱列付近、D＝右手前の巨大木柱前。地点名は画面表示しない。柱と地点の位置関係を維持し、移動距離が背景の遠近感から分かる画角にする。A→B→C→Dの地点変更は同一空間内の高速横断で描く。
移動と空手を完全に分離する。移動SHOTは固定広角で長い柱間を瞬間横断。通常の走行描写を短縮し、中間姿勢を大胆に省略して2〜3段階の位置飛びを作る。後方には時間差で薄く消える短い残影を複数残し、移動した方向と距離を示す。残影は別人ではない。床に粉塵の軌跡、空気の圧縮線と風圧。背景の柱は動かさない。人物本体だけが到着地点に達し、移動中は技を出さない。
空手SHOTは到着後、その地点で足場を固めて行う。正拳突き、下段受け、上段回し蹴り、連続打撃、跳躍回転蹴り。踏み込み、腰と軸足の回転、重心移動、技の起点と終点を明確にし、打撃動作は省略しない。全身ローアングルや近接構図で見せ、重要な打撃の決め瞬間のみ、極短い高コントラストのインパクトフレームを挿入し、直後は通常映像へ戻す。
終盤は白金色の強い光、空気の歪み、放射状の光線、巨大な圧力波、粉塵と木片を大胆に用いる。実写的な質感と空中の主人公の威圧感を維持する。

[SHOT FLOW]
[Shot 1｜0.00~0.70秒]
[START]
固定超広角。左手前Aの主人公と遠方右奥B、広い柱間を同時に見せる。
[MAIN EVENT]
主人公がA→Bを瞬間横断。中間姿勢が大胆に飛び、短い残影と粉塵の軌跡を残す。カメラと背景は固定し、人物だけが一気に右奥へ移る。
[END]
Bで急制動した瞬間にハードカット。

[Shot 2｜0.70~2.15秒]
[START]
B地点、ローアングル全身。移動は完了している。
[MAIN EVENT]
強い踏み込み、鋭い下段受けから腰を回した正拳突き。足から拳への力の伝達を見せる。拳の振り抜きに極短い白のインパクトフレーム。圧縮空気の衝撃波と粉塵が前方へ爆発的に走る。
[END]
突きを完成させ、次の移動方向へ切り返した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 3｜2.15~2.85秒]
[START]
Bと遠方左奥Cを収める固定広角。
[MAIN EVENT]
B→Cを横方向に瞬間横断。走行の中間を大胆に間引き、位置が2〜3段階で飛ぶ。時間差で消える短い残影、床の粉塵の筋、通過する風圧。移動中の技はない。
[END]
Cに到着し、足を踏みしめた瞬間にカット。

[Shot 4｜2.85~4.55秒]
[START]
C地点、横からのローアングル全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
重心を低く落として鋭く受け、軸足と腰を回して爆発的な上段回し蹴り。脚の伸展と蹴りの軌道を明瞭に見せる。振り抜きに極短い高コントラストのインパクトフレーム、白い衝撃光と横方向の圧縮波。粉塵が飛び、衣装が遅れて翻る。
[END]
脚を引き戻し、移動方向へ切り返した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 5｜4.55~5.30秒]
[START]
Cと右手前Dの巨大柱を見渡す固定ロングショット。
[MAIN EVENT]
C→Dを斜め手前へ瞬間横断。遠景の人物が前景へ急拡大する。大胆な位置飛び、時間差の残影、長い粉塵の尾、空気の圧力線で移動距離と速度を見せる。技は出さない。
[END]
Dの巨大柱前で急制動した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 6｜5.30~6.85秒]
[START]
D地点、巨大木柱を背景にしたローアングル全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
下段受けから高速の正拳突き、反対腕による追撃の正拳突き。足場を保ち、腰の回転と重心移動で2発を明確に成立させる。各拳の振り抜きに短い衝撃閃光と圧縮空気の波。技の途中では長く静止しない。衣装と粉塵が強く揺れる。
[END]
連打を完了し、軸足に力を集中した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 7｜6.85~8.65秒]
[START]
同じD地点。主人公と巨大木柱が見える斜め側方の広角全身。
[MAIN EVENT]
その場で床を蹴って爆発的に跳躍。空中で鋭く回転し、巨大木柱へ強烈な回転蹴りを放つ。体幹、脚の伸展、蹴りの方向を明確に描く。白金色の空気の筋が蹴りに沿い、粉塵と衣装が激しく巻き上がる。
[END]
蹴りが柱へ命中する直前にハードカット。

[Shot 8｜8.65~10.65秒]
[START]
蹴りと巨大木柱を捉える迫力ある斜めローアングル。
[MAIN EVENT]
命中時に極短い白のインパクトフレーム。直後に通常映像へ戻り、柱全体へ亀裂が走り、木片と粉塵が爆発的に飛散。巨大柱が折れて倒れ始め、床面へ衝撃波が走る。主人公は蹴りの反動で崩壊する柱から離れ、上空へ跳ね上がる。
[END]
柱が崩壊し、主人公が上昇を始めた瞬間にカット。

[Shot 9｜10.65~12.55秒]
[START]
巨大な梁天井を見上げるローアングル。主人公は破壊された柱の上方へ上昇中。
[MAIN EVENT]
主人公がさらに高く舞い上がり、回転を収束させて空中で威圧的な空手の決め姿勢を取る。衣装は激しく翻り、白金色の光と圧縮空気の渦が集まる。低いカメラから主人公の全身を大きく印象的に捉え、威圧するシルエットを強調する。下方では柱が崩落し、木片と粉塵が舞う。背後の強烈な光芒が天井と柱列を照らす。身体は停止したように見えるが、周囲の破片・光・衣装は動き続ける。
[END]
空中の主人公に光と圧力が極限まで集中した瞬間にカット。

[Shot 10｜12.55~15.00秒]
[START]
空中高くの主人公を正面下方から捉える。背後は梁天井と強烈な白金色の光。
[MAIN EVENT]
威圧的な決め姿勢の完成と同時に、画面全体を支配する巨大なインパクトフレーム。白・黒・金の極端な高コントラスト、主人公の強烈なシルエットと放射状の衝撃線・光の爆発を極短く見せ、即座に実写映像へ戻る。主人公から巨大な白金色の圧力波が全方向へ解放され、床の粉塵を巨大な円環状に押し広げ、木片を巻き上げ、空気を歪ませ、遠方の柱列まで強烈な光と風圧が届く。カメラは一気に大きく引き、巨大空間の中央上空に浮かぶ主人公と放射光・圧力の渦を超広角全景で見せる。
[END]
空中の強い決め姿勢と壮大な余韻を保ち、黒画面へ切らず自然終了。

[SOUND]
疾走感の強い打楽器主体のBGMあり。超高速移動の風切り・空気の破裂音、急制動、踏み込み、突き・蹴り、衣擦れ、インパクト音、木柱の破砕・倒壊を動作に同期。終盤は重い圧力音、巨大な衝撃音と空間の轟音。台詞・ナレーションなし。

[NEGATIVE]
移動しながらの格闘技、到着前の打撃、長い通常走行、ダンス化、全編スローモーション、残影の別人物化、人物・衣装の崩れ、狭い空間、無関係な柱の破壊、最後の着地、黒画面へのハードカット、文字、ロゴ。

cases.prompt:
天降裁决 · 焦林对峙与雷光激战 · 承接前篇】

一、项目定位
本段承接上一段"双翼坠落与流星降临":两位天使落地后穿行于半边燃烧的精灵森林,遭遇守护此地的人类兄长与半精灵弟弟,先伏击、再对峙、后爆发雷光激战。结构:0–20s 剧情铺垫(兄弟察觉→天使寻人→树冠伏击被轻松挡下→兄长登场对话),20–30s 十秒史诗终战。核心戏剧原则:天使的从容与兄弟的凌厉形成对撞;镜头以非常规机位贴近角色,背景全程鲜活自然。

二、一致性锁定协议(最高优先级)
@ Image1、@ Image2、@ Image4、@  Image5 全程保持参考图最终形态:面部轮廓、五官比例、肤色、发色、瞳色、服装、材质、配色、饰品、武器/宠物形态,帧级一致,零漂移。@ Image1与@  Image2外观与配音声线与上一段完全一致,零变身、零换装、零多余角色。每个分镜【角色锚定】字段必须重新注入参考图关键词。@ Image3为场景参考,锁定其建筑、巨树、拱桥、彩虹与火灾分布。

三、角色圣经
@ Image1「白发裁决天使」(女性)
外观锚定:及腰淡金白色长发／炽亮金色新月光环／发光蓝色瞳光与蓝晶羽翼面饰／米白色巨翼／骷髅黄金肩甲与胸甲／淡蓝色破损长袍与红色内衬披风／红玫瑰与骷髅腰饰、金链垂坠。
武器锚定:骷髅黄金巨型大剑,剑身燃烧,单手即可轻松挥动,火焰拖出长长火痕。唯一形态,不变形。
元素色:白金圣光 × 青蓝。
气质:温柔、安静、内敛,柔和之下藏着决绝;面对挑衅依旧从容。
配音:日语温柔少女音,轻柔清澈,语速偏缓,句尾轻轻下沉,柔中带刚,不喊叫(与前篇一致)。

@ Image2「同行资深天使」(女性)
外观锚定:及腰浅金色长发／金骨鸟首羽冠嵌蓝宝石／背后金色辐条圆环光轮(中央蓝色光核)／米白羽翼夹深蓝羽／深蓝金丝缠绕长袖与长袍／发光白蓝瞳／脸颊红色划痕／蓝色美甲／金饰与蓝晶珠链。
武器锚定:金色长弓,弓弦细亮,可瞬发金色光箭。唯一形态,不变形。
元素色:蓝金 × 米白。
气质:从容、玩味、护短,如姐姐/前辈般沉稳可靠,始终护在@ Image1侧后方。
配音:日语成熟御姐音,沉稳慵懒,优雅带笑,怒意时骤冷(与前篇一致)。

@ Image4「半精灵弟弟」(男性,@ Image5的弟弟,人类与精灵混血)
外观锚定:红棕色蓬乱翘发带一缕弧形呆毛／尖长精灵耳与金色耳饰／左绿右蓝异色瞳(右眼半隐于刘海)／脸颊白色创可贴／红色编发辫／奶白色泡泡袖衬衫／蓝色破旧披肩外套缀骷髅、黄色竖瞳眼球纽扣、铜扣与红蓝宝石吊坠／皮革腰带挂满小饰品与蓝色药瓶／黄色腰布。
宠物锚定:背后盘绕的彩色鳞片长蛇(黑红蓝黄花纹、橙黄竖瞳),体型随主人行动灵活缠绕、突袭、拦截。唯一形态,不变形。
战斗风格:精灵般轻盈敏捷的体术 + 与灵蛇协同突袭,不引入新元素。
气质:机灵、嘴硬、不屑人类的愚蠢战争,对兄长充满信赖。
配音:日语少年音(男声),清亮略带挑衅,语速偏快,带着少年的不服气与灵动感。

@ Image5「人类兄长」(男性,纯人类)
外观锚定:深红棕色凌乱短发／左绿右蓝异色瞳／右脸焦痕疤纹／深灰蓝披风衣领／古铜色旧金属肩甲与胸甲嵌绿色宝石圆核／皮革护具。
战斗锚定:徒手作战,双拳与前臂覆盖蓝白色雷电元素并溅出橙色火星,无武器。唯一形态,不变形。
元素色:雷霆蓝白 × 铜橙。
气质:沉稳、克制、压迫感极强,行走间自带气场,出手即重。自幼生活在精灵村,守护此地。
配音:日语青年男声,低沉沉稳,语速偏缓,句尾下沉,压迫感十足,怒意时更低沉。

四、场景环境圣经「焦林精灵村」(参考@ Image3)
参天巨树与悬空平台、青瓦飞檐亭阁、白金色镂空拱桥横跨树间、蓝天与双彩虹;画面左半侧森林与亭阁燃起大火,黑色浓烟柱冲天,红叶树被火光染亮,火星漫天飞散;右半侧仍是青绿完好的树海与垂落藤蔓。
活体原则(全程强制):火焰持续跳动翻卷、浓烟柱缓慢翻涌上升、火星与灰烬随热浪飞舞、红叶与碎屑飘落、藤蔓与树冠随风摇曳、远处拱桥与浮空巨树光影流动、彩虹光带微微闪烁、地面草叶被角色气场压伏——背景全程动态,绝无静止帧;打斗时树叶炸飞、草地被气浪压平、火焰被冲击波吹得倾斜。

五、特效圣经(前摇→释放→飞行→命中→余韵)
1. 圣焰剑:@ Image1大剑燃烧的火焰随挥动拖出长弧火痕,命中时火星爆散。
2. 金光箭:@ Image2弓弦拉满瞬间金色光箭凝成,射出后拖出金线光尾,命中炸开金色涟漪。
3. 雷霆拳:@ Image5拳臂蓝白雷弧缠绕,蓄力时地面雷纹蔓延,出拳时雷光爆闪、残影拖尾,命中时环形雷浪扩散。
4. 灵蛇突袭:@ Image4的蛇鳞片折射火光,扑击时带出风压与残影。
5. 彩虹光晕:全程镜头边缘出现彩虹棱镜光晕与蓝色变形宽银幕横向拉丝光斑,随冲击强度增减;每次大碰撞时彩虹光晕在强光中绽放。
6. 气场:@ Image5登场时周身气压使草叶外倒、火焰偏向、灰烬绕身旋转、细小雷弧在脚边跳动。

六、色彩与光影脚本
0–4s 冷青绿与火橙对比,精灵村晨光 → 4–12s 焦林火光与烟尘,暖橙与深绿并存 → 12–20s 气场压迫,色调转冷,雷蓝微光渐起 → 20–30s 雷蓝、圣金、火橙三色对撞,彩虹光晕峰值,最后收束定格。

七、镜头语言规范
景别:【脚部局部特写→半身像→近景→面部特写→手/拳/剑局部特写】,对打段允许全身中景展示四人站位;严禁脱离角色的空镜。
非常规机位库(核心要求,每镜选用):脚部行走低角度跟拍、贴地滑行仰拍、右后脑/左后脑角落越肩拍、耳侧近距离贴脸、蛇视角树冠俯拍、剑身侧面贴拍、拳锋怼镜头、垂直俯拍四人交错、半身环绕。
镜头时长:剧情段每镜2–3.5秒,对打段每镜2秒,快速切换。
帧率策略:主体24fps;树冠伏击被挡、首次拳剑对撞、终极对撞三处内嵌120fps高速摄影慢镜,各占该镜约40%时长后硬切回全速。
光学规范:彩虹棱镜光晕与蓝色拉丝光斑随动作强度出现;强风与冲击镜头加方向性动态模糊;浅景深,焦外火星光斑与烟尘体积光。

八、分镜时间轴(S1–S13)
S1｜0–2.5s｜精灵村·弟弟察觉
脚部行走低角度跟拍:@ Image4靴子踏过巨树枝干,缓缓上摇至半身;远处天际有圣光痕迹,左侧森林燃烧、烟柱翻涌。@ Image4抬眼望天,尖耳微动,背后灵蛇缓缓游动。对话(日语,少年音,带不屑):
@ Image4:「兄さん、空の連中が降りてきたみたいだよ。バカな人間どもが戦ってばかりいるからさ。」(哥哥,天上的家伙们好像降下来了。都是因为那些愚蠢的人类总是打仗。)
角色锚定:@Image4红棕翘发异色瞳尖耳蓝色骷髅披肩灵蛇;背景为@ Image3的精灵村与大火。

S2｜2.5–4.5s｜兄长回应
右后脑角落越肩近景至面部特写:@Image5左绿右蓝异色瞳微眯,指尖雷弧一闪,背后火光与烟柱流动。对话(日语,青年低沉男声):
@ Image5:「ああ、お前の言う通りだ。あいつらの気配を感じる。」(嗯,你说得对。我感觉到了他们的气息。)
角色锚定:@ Image5深红棕乱发右脸焦痕古铜肩甲绿宝石圆核。

S3｜4.5–7s｜焦林行进·寻找幸存者
脚部低角度跟拍:@ Image1与@ Image2的靴子并肩踏过焦土与未燃尽的草地,火星从镜头前飞过;切左侧耳旁角落近景,两人穿行于半边燃烧的森林,巨翼与披风被热浪微微掀动。对话(日语):
@ Image1(温柔少女音,轻声):「……生き残りを探しましょう。」(……我们去找找幸存者吧。)
角色锚定:@ Image1淡金白长发金色新月光环骷髅金甲圣焰巨剑;@ Image2浅金长发金骨鸟首羽冠金色光轮蓝金长袍金弓。

S4｜7–9.5s｜树冠伏击·单剑挡下
蛇视角树冠俯拍:@Image4伏在高处树枝间,灵蛇探头对准下方两人;切@Image4与灵蛇同时俯冲突袭——@ Image1头也不回,单手挥起燃烧巨剑一记横斩,120fps慢镜半秒:剑火拖出长弧,灵蛇被轻松扫开,@ Image4空中翻身落回树枝,表情惊讶不甘。彩虹光晕在镜头边缘扫过。
角色锚定:@ Image4灵蛇与异色瞳;@  Image1骷髅金剑圣焰。

S5｜9.5–12s｜御姐判断
@Image2面部近景,火光映亮半张脸,嘴角带笑,护在@ Image1侧后方半个身位;背景火焰跳动、灰烬飘落。对话(日语,御姐音,带笑):
@Image2:「あら……この大地にも、まだ文明の名残があるみたいね。」(哎呀……这片大地上,似乎还残存着文明的痕迹呢。)
角色锚定:@ Image2金骨鸟首羽冠金色光轮脸颊红色划痕。

S6｜12–15.5s｜兄长登场·气场压迫
脚部行走低角度跟拍:@ Image5的靴子缓步踏过焦土,草叶被气场压伏外倒、火焰向两侧偏斜、灰烬绕身旋转、脚边雷弧细跳;缓缓上摇至半身,披风被气流掀起,@ Image4跳落至他身侧,灵蛇环绕。镜头转右后脑角落,@ Image5直视前方的两位天使,气势逼人。对话(日语,低沉男声,压迫感):
@ Image5:「お前たち、なぜここへ降りてきた。ここはお前たちの領域ではない。」(你们为什么降到这里?这里不是你们的地盘。)

S7｜15.5–17.5s｜天使回应
@Image1面部特写:新月光环在气场中微微震颤,蓝色瞳光不动,神情平静。对话(日语,温柔少女音,轻而坚定):
@ Image1:「あら……まだ人間が残っていたのですね。」(哎呀……原来还有人类留下来了呢。)
@ Image2在侧后方半身,依旧带笑,手搭弓弦。

S8｜17.5–20s｜兄长蓄势
耳侧贴脸近景:@ Image5对话(日语,低沉男声):
@ Image5:「ああ。俺は最初から、エルフの里で暮らしてきたからな。」(是啊。因为我从一开始就和精灵村一起生活。)
话音落,拳局部特写:@ Image5握拳,蓝白雷电从指尖爬满前臂,地面雷纹蔓延,草叶与火星被吸引上扬;@ Image4在旁侧摆开架势,灵蛇昂首。彩虹光晕在镜头边缘亮起。

S9｜20–22s｜雷拳突袭
贴地滑行仰拍:@ Image5徒手裹雷一个突进,雷光残影拖尾;拳锋怼向镜头,切@ Image1举起骷髅金剑硬接——120fps慢镜半秒:拳剑对撞,环形雷浪与火焰同时炸开,彩虹光晕在强光中绽放,草地被气浪压平,火焰倾斜。

S10｜22–24s｜弓蛇交锋
左耳侧角落近景:@ Image4与灵蛇同时扑向@Image2;@ Image2后跃拉满金弓,近距离连发金光箭,@ Image4空中翻转避开,灵蛇盘身拦下光箭,金色涟漪与鳞片火星四散,@ Image2嘴角仍带笑。

S11｜24–26s｜剑雷对撞
剑身侧面贴拍→面部近景:@ Image1圣焰巨剑与@ Image5雷拳连续快速交锋,火线与雷弧交织;两人僵持于一点,彼此近距离对视,@ Image1眼神平静温柔、@ Image5眼神凌厉,火星雷花溅在脸上。

S12｜26–28s｜四人交错
垂直俯拍转半身环绕:四人在燃烧的森林中交错换位——@ Image2一箭逼退@ Image4,@Image4借灵蛇缠绕树干反弹回攻,@Image5从侧面突进,@Image1挥剑斩出火弧挡住雷拳;背景火焰、烟柱、树叶、藤蔓全部随冲击卷动。

S13｜28–30s｜终极对撞·定格
半身大特写:@ Image1圣焰巨剑与@ Image5雷霆重拳在画面中央硬撞,同时@ Image2弓弦拉满对准@Image4,灵蛇扑向箭尖——120fps慢镜半秒:四人同时对撞,巨大环形冲击波向四周炸开,气浪吹飞火星与树叶,彩虹光晕在强光中绽放后向镜头边缘收束,画面定格后渐暗。无对白。

九、配音与音效设计
配音语言:日语,各角色声线固定:@ Image1温柔少女音、@ Image2成熟御姐音(与前篇一致);@ Image4清亮少年音(男)、@ Image5低沉青年男声。在风声与火焰声中保持清晰,不喊叫,仅对打段允许短促气声与喘息。
音效:森林燃烧的噼啪声、浓烟翻涌的低频声、草叶被气场压伏声、脚步踏碎焦土声、火焰剑挥动与火花声、雷拳蓄力的电流嗡鸣与爆闪声、金光箭破空声、蛇鳞摩擦与嘶声、拳剑对撞的低音爆与环形冲击波声、树叶与灰烬飘落声。
配乐:无BGM。

十、画质与风格
电影级大片质感,超写实3D动画,IMAX级画面;极致材质细节——羽毛层次、发丝逐根飘动、火焰与火星粒子、雷电弧光、蛇鳞折射、焦土与树皮纹理、烟尘体积散射;圣金、雷蓝、火橙的强烈色对比;电影级调色,浅景深,体积光,高动态范围;动作快而清晰,有重量感与真实物理感;全片背景自然鲜活、层次丰富。

十一、禁止清单
禁止镜头脱离角色(严禁无角色空镜);禁止四位角色外观、声线与参考图及前篇不一致;禁止巨剑、金弓、灵蛇、雷拳形态变形或漂移;禁止火焰凭空熄灭;禁止翅膀形态漂移或羽毛细节丢失;禁止变身、换装;禁止多余角色;禁止字幕、文字、水印、Logo;禁止血腥与残肢;禁止画面抖动变形、手部畸形、多余肢体;禁止背景静止;禁止@ Image1与 @ Image2姿态狼狈,须保持庄严从容。

cases.prompt:
下，它比 MiniMax H3在细节刻画上更到位，更具备电影感和物理逻辑（背后离不开大量电影、动作视频的数据喂养）。

提示词（中文版）：

在夜晚昏暗的工业仓库内，创作一段15秒的超现实主义电影式战斗序列，展现两位熟练成年格斗手之间的激烈对抗，将爆炸性的实时战斗与戏剧性的超慢镜头冲击瞬间相结合。空气中弥漫着尘埃，地面散落着碎混凝土，头顶灯光微微闪烁，冷光从高大的仓库窗户透入。  [00:00-00:03] 逼近：** 以低角度手持跟踪镜头开始，格斗手A向格斗手B猛冲。格斗手B上前一步，快速挥出一记右拳。格斗手A勉强侧身闪避，拳头从脸部几厘米处掠过，镜头迅速围绕两位格斗手旋转。保持动作迅猛、真实且物理可信。  [00:03-00:06] 首次慢镜头：** 格斗手A立即反击，以一记强力旋转踢腿回应。腿部逼近格斗手B的瞬间，顺畅过渡到极慢镜头。从近距离侧面角度跟踪踢腿，展现衣物因旋转力而拉伸、头发在空气中飘动、尘埃颗粒围绕他们浮动，格斗手B抬起手臂格挡。踢腿击中防御，压缩衣物并自然推动防御者的身体因冲击而偏移。尘埃从袖口迸发，镜头围绕这一冻结般的瞬间平滑环绕。  [00:06-00:09] 连击：** 自然切换回实时速度。格斗手B踉跄一步，重新稳住平衡，俯身躲过另一记打击，然后快速反击至身体中段。格斗手A格挡，抓住攻击手臂，利用对手的冲力旋转并将其重定向向附近的混凝土柱子。镜头紧跟，以充满活力的肩部高度移动，同时保持清晰的空间感和可读的编舞。  [00:09-00:12] 第二次慢镜头：** 格斗手B一脚蹬地，反转冲力，发起一记横扫反踢腿。在旋转过程中过渡到慢镜头。镜头降至地板高度，紧贴腿部扫过浮动的尘埃。格斗手A跃过踢腿，身体短暂悬浮于旋转腿上方，宽松衣物、头发、尘埃和小碎片自然响应动作。镜头从空中格斗手下方掠过，随后速度开始恢复。  [00:12-00:15] 最终交锋：** 随着格斗手A落地，爆炸性地回归实时，立即转身，施展一记最终的控制打击，格斗手B用双臂格挡。接触瞬间短暂进入慢镜头，强调物理压缩、肌肉张力、飞扬尘埃，以及力量通过两人身体的传递。他们分开并在布满尘土的地板上向后滑行，保持眼神接触，镜头渐变为广角。  在实时动作与超慢镜头冲击之间使用强烈的速度渐变，而不是让整个战斗保持慢速。编舞必须保持连续、可读、真实且物理连贯。整个过程中保持相同的格斗手、衣物、伤势、环境、光线、位置和移动方向。真实体现冲力、平衡、脚部着地、防御反应、布料物理、头发物理、冲击压缩、空中尘埃、自然运动模糊，以及电影式镜头视差。禁止传送、不可思议的身体旋转、重复肢体、多余手指、解体解剖、悬浮角色、无重力移动、过度破坏、血腥、鲜血、武器、超级英雄能力、不必要剪辑、字幕、文字或标志。

Style: Hyper-realistic 1980s romantic soap opera. Everything looks like a premium 1980s television drama: soft diffusion filters, warm golden lighting, subtle film grain, dramatic close-ups, gentle camera zooms, emotional acting, glamorous costumes, rich color grading, elegant cinematography and classic soap-opera pacing. No cartoon, no CGI, no 3D appearance. Characters must exactly match the provided reference sheets.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

Adrian:

• 20-year-old athletic man

• Dark tousled hair

• Blue eyes

• White fitted T-shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers

• Charismatic but emotionally guarded

Evelyn:

• Elegant brunette

• Soft bob haircut

• Polka-dot blouse, red pleated skirt

• Pearl necklace

• Intelligent, graceful, emotionally reserved

SETTING

A beautiful small-town street during golden sunset. Palm trees sway gently, vintage cars pass slowly, neon motel signs begin glowing, warm summer breeze, unmistakable 1980s atmosphere.

[00:00–00:05]

Wide cinematic establishing shot.

Adrian leans against his vintage convertible outside an old café, absentmindedly spinning his car keys. He notices Evelyn walking down the sidewalk carrying a notebook. Time almost seems to slow. Soft breeze moves her hair as she glances toward him. Close-ups alternate between Adrian's captivated eyes and Evelyn's shy smile.

[00:05–00:10]

Medium tracking shot.

Evelyn accidentally drops her notebook. Loose handwritten pages scatter across the street. Adrian immediately rushes over to help. They kneel together gathering the papers. Their hands reach for the same page and gently touch. They both freeze for a moment, exchanging an awkward but genuine smile.

[00:10–00:15]

Close-up sequence.

Adrian stands and hands the notebook back to Evelyn. She thanks him softly. They lock eyes for several long seconds. The surrounding street noise fades beneath the emotional moment. A slow push-in captures subtle smiles, nervous breathing and growing attraction.

[00:15–00:20]

A sudden summer rain begins. People hurry away, but neither of them moves. Adrian removes his leather jacket and carefully drapes it over Evelyn's shoulders. She looks deeply touched. Close-up of their eyes meeting again as raindrops glisten on their faces.

[00:20–00:25]

Wide romantic shot.

They walk side by side beneath glowing neon signs and vintage storefronts, sharing quiet conversation and occasional laughter. Camera circles around them while the rain slows into a gentle drizzle. Evelyn looks at Adrian with growing affection. Adrian steals another glance at her, smiling.

[00:25–00:30]

They stop beneath an old cinema marquee illuminated with warm lights. Silence. Adrian slowly reaches for Evelyn's hand. She accepts without hesitation. They stand together, smiling softly, as the camera slowly cranes upward, revealing the glowing street below while they continue looking into each other's eyes, hopeful about their future.

Audio:

Classic 1980s romantic soap-opera soundtrack with warm synthesizers, soft piano, gentle saxophone, light rain ambience, distant traffic, footsteps on wet pavement, subtle city ambience and emotional silence during intimate moments.

Camera:

Frequent close-ups, slow push-ins, over-the-shoulder conversations, elegant tracking shots, gentle crane movement, emotional reaction shots, cinematic wides and soft-focus glamour close-ups reminiscent of iconic 1980s television romances.

Negative:

No action, no comedy, no modern technology, no smartphones, no CGI, no animation, no exaggerated acting, no text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark.

- SHOT 7: back to color for the last second, wide: all five thugs lie knocked out on the wet ground around her, she flicks the rain off the blade and turns away, and the shot ends on the motion.

Riko approaches from the tree side, passes beneath the same near bench, climbs the same table leg and reaches the same tabletop. Do not mirror the environment between shots.
Maintain strict prop continuity. There is exactly one basket, one hinged lid, one sandwich, one plate, one spoon and one thermos. The basket never moves from its place on the tabletop. The lid remains attached to the same hinge for the entire video. The plate never moves. The thermos never moves. The spoon moves only during the single CLINK gag and then remains still. The sandwich moves only when Riko, Moku or both raccoons are visibly holding it.
Do not allow the sandwich to slide deeper into the basket on its own. Do not allow Moku to appear before his reveal. Do not allow the basket lid to open or close without Riko physically moving it. Do not allow the basket to tip while Riko pulls the sandwich. Do not allow any food, plates or props to duplicate or disappear.
Prioritize clear readable physical actions over flashy camera movement. Use wider shots whenever the climbing route or tabletop geography needs to be understood. During the final reveal, keep both Riko and Moku visible simultaneously so the audience clearly understands that there are two separate raccoons. Do not use a transformation cut. Do not cut from Riko to Moku in a way that could imply Riko transformed into the second raccoon.
Use playful cinematic heist-style orchestral music with light plucked strings and soft percussion. Begin with quiet suspense as Riko watches the basket. Increase the rhythm slightly during his low sprint and climb. Reduce the music during his careful tabletop approach. Use one clear metallic CLINK when the spoon lightly touches the ceramic plate, followed by an immediate brief musical stop and near silence while Riko freezes. Resume the quiet heist rhythm when he continues. Add soft wicker creaks while Riko opens the basket lid. Reduce the music again when the sandwich unexpectedly stops moving. Use one small suspense cue as Moku’s paws appear. At the full Moku reveal, use one tiny surprised orchestral note rather than a loud sting. Let the final awkward stare play almost silently. Add soft sandwich bite audio, then one gentle wicker THUMP as Riko closes the lid. Cut to black.

cases.title_zh: 潘多拉之盒实为陶罐盖不揭开
cases.title_en: Pandora's Box Was a Jar — Lid Stays On
cases.description_zh: X 原帖公开提示词（14410 字）· Seedance 2.5 视频案例。
cases.author: alessia_orbit
cases.prompt:
Lock the room with a photo, not words.

Five storyboards, five different rooms. I described the same Paris atelier in words every time, and every run built a new studio. One reference photo of the room fixed it on the next try, light included.

Only in the storyboard, though. In the video, that wide room photo drags every close-up back into a wide shot, so the video gets the room in words only.

Seedance 2.5 · 1 render · ~$3.20

Prompt 👇

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
20-second, 16:9 landscape, hyper-realistic live-action short. A 24-year-old woman builds a tall clay storage jar by hand in a grand old artist's atelier in Paris: she slams and wedges terracotta-red clay, throws a base on an old potter's wheel, builds the walls up with heavy ropes of clay, beats them into shape with a wooden paddle, and finishes the rim. A montage of one continuous pottery session at real-time speed: eight shots, each hard cut jumping forward in time so the jar is visibly more complete in every shot where it appears, smears of red clay building up on her hands and forearms as it goes. Handheld documentary feel, filmed as if by chance: slightly imperfect framing, subtle handheld drift, gentle exposure breathing, autofocus arriving half a beat late. Each shot is one steady handheld framing with only a gentle drift, and every shot has its own camera position and its own body position; the one camera move is a slow push toward her eyes in the seventh shot. Real-time the whole way, never slow motion.
Lighting: soft overcast daylight through the single tall window as the only light source, brightest near the window and falling off gradually darker toward the foreground and the corners, gentle side falloff with smooth tonal transitions across her face, her body and the clay, bright and airy but with real directional shadow, never flat dead light. No studio beauty light, no god-ray beams, no sunbeams, no rim light, no added lamps. Face shadows stay soft but present, do not over-fill.

LOCKED SET:
- The room: a grand, very tall old 19th-century atelier, weathered ochre-beige limestone and plaster walls curving into shallow apse corners, a vaulted ceiling with faint faded painted decoration, a single very tall white-framed rectangular French casement window in the middle of the far wall, rows of white plaster busts on pedestals along both side walls, a long rough wooden trestle work table on the right, pale worn stone floor. Aged, lived-in, grand but working, never a clean empty film set.
- THE POTTERY CORNER: an old heavy potter's wheel stands on the open stone floor in the left-center of the room, between the left row of busts and the window: a wide round flat metal wheel head on a squat round drum base about knee height, crusted with dried red clay, with a low sturdy wooden stool about knee high beside it. She slams the clay at the long trestle work table on the right; on it lie a bucket of water, a sponge, a flat wooden paddle, a smooth round grey stone, a thin curved wooden rib and a cutting wire. The only pottery anywhere in the room is her one jar.
- DIRECTION LOCK: the wheel and the jar are always on frame-LEFT of her body and she works facing frame-LEFT, except in the seventh shot, where the camera faces her across the jar. The camera is always in front of her or at her side. The 180-degree line held, the space never flipping between cuts.

LOCKED CAST:
- THE WOMAN: Use @character as her locked visual identity, an adult woman, age 24 - preserve her face, low bun, body proportions and outfit exactly across every shot, never reinterpret or let her face turn generic. Matte natural skin, real pores and fine peach-fuzz. Warm chestnut brown hair in a low bun at the nape, a few loose face-framing strands at the cheeks. Outfit, identical every frame: a fitted plain white short cropped t-shirt sitting high above the waist leaving the midriff bare, the thin soft stretch-knit clinging with real fabric creases across the bust and waist, short sleeves, plain crew neckline; relaxed loose dark charcoal grey trousers on the hips, no branding; plain white low sneakers. Smears of terracotta-red clay on her hands and forearms only, building up shot by shot; the white tee, the trousers and her face stay clean. She is the only person ever seen. Calm, absorbed, focused on the clay throughout, never posing, never looking at the lens, her figure seen only through the natural slam, lift, lean, reach and stretch of the work.
- THE CLAY: coarse terracotta-red clay, the iron-rich red earthenware of ancient Greek storage jars; wet it is a deep brick red, and as it firms up it turns a slightly paler, matte red.
- THE JAR, her own work: ONE single large storage jar in the shape of an ancient Greek pithos, plain terracotta-red clay with faint horizontal throwing rings, no decoration, no handles, no figures, no faces. The same jar, the same color and the same width of belly in every shot; only its stage advances: no jar yet in the first two shots, then a short squat open base, then low open walls about knee high, then tall to her chest with a swelling belly and a straight open top, then almost full height with the shoulders curving in, then finished with a wide mouth and a heavy rolled rim, standing on the wheel about as high as her shoulder, and at the very end closed with a flat round lid of the same red clay.

AUDIO:
All sound captured in-camera by a single handheld camera, raw, never a studio mix, never dubbed. Her quiet breathing, one heavy wet thud as the clay block slams onto the wooden table, a dull wet thump as the clay ball lands on the wheel head, the low steady rumble of the turning wheel, the soft wet squelch of clay under her fingers, a few dull flat knocks of the wooden paddle on the firm clay wall, the faint scrape of the wooden rib along the rim, a soft dull tap of the clay lid settling, the faint room tone of a large stone hall, distant muffled street sound beyond the window. No dialogue, no music, no BGM, no added effect sound, everything kept low and real.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
@character = the woman: face, hair, body and outfit. The only face in the video.
The clip BEGINS already mid-motion.

[TIMELINE]
0-2.5s | CLOSE THREE-QUARTER FRONT FROM SLIGHTLY ABOVE, SLAMMING THE CLAY: camera very close and a little above her, in front of her, looking down at her bowed head and leaning body, framed from the top of her head to her waist, already mid-motion. At the long trestle table she lifts a heavy block of wet red clay a little off the tabletop with both hands and slams it straight down with real weight: one heavy wet thud, the block squashing flat at frame-LEFT of her body, a few flecks of clay jumping off it. Both hands stay pressed on it, arms straight, her whole upper body following through forward and down toward the camera, the white tee stretching across her as she leans in. Her head bowed, eyelids lowered, her gaze on the clay, never up at the lens. The edge of the table and the clay sit in the near foreground at frame-LEFT, cut off by the frame edge.
2.5-5s | VERY LOW ANGLE BACKLIT SIDE, LIFTING THE CLAY BALL OVER THE WHEEL: camera just above the floor, close, at her left side, looking up, framed from her hips up, her body filling most of the frame height, the tall bright window directly behind her. She stands beside the bare wheel side-on in profile facing frame-LEFT, her left side toward the camera, and raises a round wedged ball of red clay, as big as a melon, with both hands up to the height of her head, then throws it hard down onto the center of the bare wheel head below her at frame-LEFT with a dull wet thump. The bright window glows directly behind her so her lifted arms, the long stretched line of her torso, her bare midriff, narrow waist and the curve into her hips read as a clean outline against the light. Her face in profile, eyes on the clay ball, face shadows soft but readable.
5-7.5s | TIGHT CLOSE on her face and hands together, eye level, side-front angle, framed from the top of her head to her chest, her face filling the upper half of the frame: she sits on the low stool bent low over the spinning wheel, and along the bottom edge of the frame, just below her chin, her fingers are inside the short squat open base of red clay, opening it out, her elbows held out to the sides, wet red clay on her fingers and wrists. Her whole face stays clear above her hands, eyes down on the clay, jaw set in concentration. Behind her, soft and out of focus, the weathered ochre wall and a white plaster bust. Her face large and sharp.
7.5-10s | LOW PURE SIDE PROFILE AT WHEEL HEIGHT, ASTRIDE THE WHEEL: camera at the height of the wheel head, close, at her exact left side, perpendicular to her body, framed from the wheel head up to just above her head, her body filling most of the frame height, white busts soft behind her. She sits astride the wheel on the low stool, one leg on each side of the drum base, facing frame-LEFT, the drum base and the wheel head hiding her lap. The jar's low open walls, now about knee high, turn on the wheel in front of her. She leans far forward toward frame-LEFT over them, both arms extended, laying a heavy rope of red clay around the top and pressing it down with both hands, the forward reach stretching her torso so her chest, narrow waist and the curve of her hip on the stool read as one long unbroken side line. Her face in profile, lowered to the clay.
10-12.5s | THREE-QUARTER FRONT AT WAIST HEIGHT, BEATING THE WALL WITH THE PADDLE: camera at her waist height, three-quarter in front of her, framed from mid-thigh up to just above her head. The jar stands on the wheel at frame-LEFT of her body, now tall to about her chest but still unfinished: its lower half swells into a round belly, its top is still a straight open wall with no rim, its clay firm, matte and slightly paler. She stands close against it facing frame-LEFT: her LEFT arm reaches over the open top and down inside the jar up to the elbow, her left hand holding the smooth round grey stone against the inside of the wall, and her RIGHT hand swings the flat wooden paddle against the outside of the wall at the same spot, two or three firm slaps with dull flat knocks. She leans in so close that the front of her white tee lightly touches the firm, dry outer wall, just a light touch, nothing pressed flat. Her face three-quarter to the camera, eyes on the spot she is beating.
12.5-15s | LOW ANGLE SIDE, STANDING ON THE STOOL AGAINST THE BRIGHT WINDOW: camera low near the floor at her exact left side, perpendicular to her body, looking up, framed from her feet on the stool up to just above her head, her whole body in frame, the tall bright window directly behind her. The jar on the wheel at frame-LEFT is almost full height, its shoulders curving in. She stands up on the low stool facing frame-LEFT and bends forward from the hips over the jar's mouth, her RIGHT arm reaching all the way down inside the jar up to the shoulder, smoothing the bottom inside, her LEFT hand resting flat on the jar's shoulder. Her whole body is one long side line from her feet on the stool through her legs, hips, narrow waist and bent back to her head, drawn as a clean silhouette against the glowing window. The camera sees her from her left side: her face and the front of her body side-on to the camera, her back turned away from it. Her face in profile, cheek just above the rim, eyes looking down into the jar.
15-17.5s | ACROSS THE RIM AT HER FACE: the jar is finished now, a wide mouth with a heavy rolled rim. The camera sits just beyond the jar at the height of the rim, facing her across its open mouth: the curve of the wet red rim runs through the near foreground, soft and out of focus. She stands on the low stool on the far side of the jar, facing the camera, framed from the top of her head down to her chest. Her RIGHT hand holds the thin curved wooden rib against the outside of the rim and her LEFT fingertips rest just inside it, shaping the lip as it slowly turns, her hands low at the rim so her whole face is clear above them. The camera pushes slowly forward across the rim toward her face, focus settling sharp on her eyes. Calm, a light quiet concentration, eyes on the lip of the jar, never the lens.
17.5-20s | WIDE full pull-back from the near end of the room, camera at standing eye level looking straight at the window wall, the whole atelier visible from floor to vault, the tall window behind throwing the room into soft backlit depth: the wheel stands on the open stone floor in the left-center with the finished tall red jar on it, now closed with its flat round red clay lid, still wet and untouched. She has stepped two paces away from it, to its right and a little closer to the window, so the tall bright window glows directly behind her, small in the frame. She stands side-on in profile facing frame-LEFT toward her jar, her hands empty and nowhere near the jar, and slowly raises both arms high above her head in one long stretch, fingers interlacing, palms turning up toward the vault, her back gently arching, her chin tipping up, her eyes closing, one long quiet exhale at the end of a long day's work. The window light draws her raised arms, the long line of her torso, her bare midriff, narrow waist and the curve into her hips as one clean silhouette. The short tee lifts a little with the stretch and still covers her ribs. She holds the stretch at the top, still, never looking at the lens. Against the far left wall, beside a white plaster bust, a finished strung yew longbow leans upright, untouched and far from her, simply part of the room. Hold this wide as the final frame.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Raw handheld documentary atelier footage, 16:9, eight hard jump cuts forward in time, real-time. The same single jar growing only more complete, the same wheel, stool and trestle table, the same outfit and low bun in every shot, a different camera position and a different body position in every shot. Identity lock to @character. Soft window daylight, mild grain.

Avoid: subtitles, text, watermark, anime, 3D-CG, plastic skin, over-beautifying, a second person, more than one jar, a changing jar color, the work flipping sides, her back to the camera, posing for camera, nipple protrusion, clay on her clothes, slow motion, speed ramp, freeze, dramatic god-ray beams, studio beauty light, music, BGM, crowd, commentary.

Spike Lee double dolly shot. Night, an old street. A middle-aged man in a dark coat stands on an invisible moving platform: feet still, body not bobbing, gliding toward the camera at a steady speed, as if floating.

cases.title_zh: 竖版沉浸式枕边轻吻害羞对视
cases.title_en: Vertical Immersive Bedside Kiss & Shy Gaze
cases.description_zh: X 原帖公开提示词（3762 字）· Seedance 2.5 视频案例。
cases.author: johnAGI168
cases.prompt:
Duration: 30秒
Aspect ratio: 9:16

SUBJECT / REFERENCE
@图片1＝男主，只参考面容与五官，保持身份一致。
@图片2＝女主，只参考面容与五官，保持身份一致。
两人为成年恋人。角色卡不提供服装、姿势和背景。以下正文只使用男主、女主指代。

WARDROBE
男主穿深墨蓝色柔软长袖睡衣，翻领、纽扣前襟，领口自然松开一颗纽扣。
女主穿奶油白色柔软长袖睡衣，小翻领、细窄滚边。
睡衣只在画面边缘露出少量领口和肩部，不为展示服装扩大景别。

STORY
男主以为女主睡着，俯身看她，稍微拨一下她脸旁的头发，低头轻吻。
女主醒来，发现男主近在眼前，害羞地拉起被子遮住脸。
男主停在近处，低头笑着看她。
女主躲了片刻，又觉得不对，自己把被子拉下来，重新看他。
两人短暂对视，男主再次俯身，女主回应，两人投入地吻在一起，持续到结束。

核心摄影要求
这是一场以大特写和极近特写组成的枕边戏。

开场就贴近人物，不拍房间全景，不交代走到床边的过程。
单人镜头以面部占满画幅为准：允许裁掉头顶、部分发际线、脸侧与肩膀。不要把完整头部、双肩和胸口全部装进画面。
双人镜头让女主侧脸位于左下、男主面部从右上贴入，两人的脸共同填满竖幅，房间背景几乎消失。
藏被动作也在脸部附近完成，只出现脸、被沿和抓住被沿的局部手指。

摄影机已经在近处。镜头以固定机位（Locked-off camera）为主，仅有极轻的自然呼吸感，不反复慢推，不环绕。
用硬切（Hard cut）在男主大特写、女主大特写、双人侧面极近特写之间转换。
让眼神方向、画外视线和局部入画交代两人的位置，不依赖中景解释空间。

ENVIRONMENT / LIGHTING
夜晚卧室，灰米色枕头与被褥，深色床头。
床头暖白色灯光从侧后方照来，在鼻梁、脸颊边缘与睫毛上留下柔和亮部；另一侧面部保留自然阴影。
皮肤温暖但不过度泛黄，背景暗而柔软。枕头在画面边缘形成一小块浅色，衬托近处的脸。
浅景深，眼神和接触处清楚，保留真实皮肤纹理。
画面中不出现完整台灯、床头柜或大面积卧室陈设。

AUDIO
无对白、无旁白、无内心独白、无字幕。
低音量、无歌词的柔和R&B氛围配乐，节奏轻，不做强烈卡点。
自然呼吸、被子和衣料摩擦声贴近画面，不添加夸张喘息或放大的亲吻音效。

CONTINUITY
男主一直从女主面对的一侧俯身，身体由撑在床垫上的手臂承重；支撑动作在画外成立，不专门切镜展示。
女主头部始终由枕头承托。
女主自己拉被遮脸，也自己把被子拉下来。
第一次吻轻，第二次吻投入而持续；两次之间完整保留醒来、害羞、藏脸和重新对视。
头发只做一次简单拨开，不增加整理、反复抚摸等动作。

SHOT 01｜0.0–2.0秒
女主睡颜大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
女主侧躺的脸占据画面主体，头顶和一部分脸侧出框，下边缘最多露到下巴与少量睡衣领口。背景只有贴着头部的枕面。
摄影机就在枕边，略高于她的脸，沿她躺卧的方向拍摄。

动作：
女主闭眼，面部放松，呼吸轻而均匀。
镜头末尾，男主模糊的脸侧从右上边缘靠入，只出现一小部分，不把画面撑成双人中景。

SHOT 02｜2.0–5.5秒
硬切男主大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
男主俯下的脸斜着铺满竖屏，从左上向右下形成倾斜构图。
头顶和右侧部分脸颊出框，下方贴近下颌，仅在左下角留下女主虚化的局部轮廓。
摄影机处于接近女主视线的位置，看他俯身靠近的脸。

动作：
男主垂眼看着女主，目光停留，嘴角缓缓放松。
他以为她睡着了，眼神里带着不急于离开的温柔。
保持这个大特写，让他看她的时间真实发生，不急着接吻。
摄影机不推进，变化只来自他的目光、呼吸与轻微低头。

SHOT 03｜5.5–7.5秒
硬切女主面部特写（Close-up）

画面：
回到女主枕边的近距离，女主的脸占左侧和下方。
男主只在右上方露出局部下颌，右手从画外进入，构图始终围绕女主的脸。

动作：
男主轻轻拨一下她脸旁的散发，手随即退出画面。
女主仍闭眼，没有额外反应。
男主的脸开始从右上方降低，下一镜承接这次靠近。

SHOT 04｜7.5–13.5秒
硬切双人侧面极近特写（Extreme close-up）

画面：
机位降到接近枕面高度。
女主的侧脸从左下方占住画面，男主从右上方斜着贴入。
两人的头顶和部分脸侧自然出框，只留贴近的面部轮廓。背景被两张脸遮住，剩下一点虚化的枕面。
摄影机固定，不拉远容纳完整头部。

动作：
7.5–10.0秒：
男主缓慢低头，两张脸之间的空隙一点点缩小。他轻微调整头部，鼻尖自然错开，在将要碰到时有很短的迟疑。

10.0–12.0秒：
男主轻轻吻住女主的嘴唇，保持一次柔和的吻。动作小，距离近，画面始终停在两人面部。

12.0–13.5秒：
男主略微抬头，嘴唇分开，但脸没有离远。
女主睫毛轻动，开始睁眼。

SHOT 05｜13.5–15.5秒
硬切女主醒来的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
女主的眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇清楚可见，枕头只剩窄窄一圈。
男主虚化的脸侧留在右上前景，挡住一小部分画面，让观众感觉他仍在她眼前。

动作：
女主睁眼，先看清男主，再短暂停住。
她的目光在他脸上停留，随后轻轻抿唇、避开一点视线，羞意从眼神和嘴角浮出来。
男主没有离开，没有大幅后退。

SHOT 06｜15.5–17.5秒
女主近距离拉被遮脸（Close-up）

画面：
仍贴着女主拍摄，只比上一镜多容纳一点被沿。
不切成能看清两人上半身的镜头。

动作：
女主抓住胸前的被沿，快速往上一拉，遮住自己的整张脸。
被子在近处掠过镜头视野，替代她的面部占住画面。
男主顺势稍微抬头，给被子留出空间。
抓着被沿的手指停在画面边缘，保留一小段藏起来后的安静。

SHOT 07｜17.5–19.5秒
硬切男主含笑的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
回到前面男主斜着俯身的同一近机位。
他的脸再次占满画面，被沿虚化在下方前景，脸与被子之间距离很近。
不出现完整肩膀和手臂。

动作：
男主低头看着藏在被子里的女主。
眼尾先放松，嘴角随后扬起来，笑意越来越明显，但不笑出声，不做夸张挑眉。
他停在原处等她，没有伸手扯被子。

SHOT 08｜19.5–21.0秒
硬切女主拉下被子的特写（Close-up）

画面：
开头被子仍遮住女主的脸，和前一个遮脸镜头保持同样近的距离。

动作：
女主躲了一会儿，自己把被子直接拉回下巴以下，重新露出整张脸。
动作带一点“怎么就停了”的迟疑和急切，但没有台词。
她看向男主，这次目光停住，没有继续躲，也不再把被子拉回去。
不要增加先露眼睛偷看、反复升降被子的过程。

SHOT 09｜21.0–22.5秒
硬切男主回应的大特写（Tight close-up）

画面：
男主的眼睛与嘴角同时清楚，面部依然斜着贴满竖屏。
女主只是左下角一小块虚化前景。

动作：
男主接住她的目光，笑意短暂停在嘴角。
他没有再长时间等待，顺着这个对视直接低下头，脸朝画面左下方靠近。
在低头动作进行中切下一镜，动作不断开。

SHOT 10｜22.5–26.5秒
双人贴脸极近特写（Extreme close-up）

画面：
恢复女主左下、男主右上的双人侧面构图，比第一次吻略紧。
两张脸填满画幅，头顶、后脑和肩膀都不要求完整入镜。
仍能看到女主闭眼的变化，以及男主靠近时的面部反应。

动作：
男主俯身吻上去，女主轻轻抬起下巴迎接，自然闭眼，明确回应。
第二次吻比第一次更投入，靠近更直接，两人不再试探。
保持连续的亲吻，头部随着彼此的动作自然小幅调整，不演成重复点一下就退开的啄吻。
摄影机停在近处，让人物的靠近与回应充满画面。

SHOT 11｜26.5–30.0秒
同侧切入更紧的双人面部特写（Tighter close-up）

画面：
在同一次亲吻中硬切，摄影机仍留在原轴线同侧，只调整少量侧面角度。
两张脸几乎没有周围留白，允许裁掉额头上部与下巴边缘。
眼睫、脸颊、鼻梁与相贴的嘴唇组成整个画面，保持两人的面部轮廓独立。
这仍然是两个人的面部亲密镜头，不拍成孤立的嘴部微距。

动作：
承接同一次持续的吻，两人保持投入和相互回应。
女主头部在枕上自然微动，男主顺着她的变化调整，动作连贯、有呼吸。
不重新起吻，不分开对视，不额外加笑或拥抱。
保持这个极近距离直到30秒结束。

NEGATIVE
中景开场，房间建立镜头，全身，完整双肩肖像，服装展示
每镜慢推，环绕，突然变焦，拉远容纳人物，结尾远景
大面积背景，完整床头柜，环境空镜，支撑手插镜
长时间整理头发，反复抚摸，额外抓衣服，反复掀被
男主替女主遮脸，男主强行拉被，人物左右位置交换
持续固定笑脸，夸张挑眉，瞪眼，质问表情，说话口型
面部融合，鼻子穿透，嘴唇错位，头部悬浮，多余手臂
重复啄吻，亲吻动作重置，突然扑倒，大幅甩头，脱衣
身份变化，睡衣变款，塑料皮肤，重度磨皮，过度黄光
字幕，水印，标志，旁白，额外对白，夸张喘息音效

cases.author: tokyo_Valentine
cases.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9 cinematic battle between the two characters in the attached reference images, set in a destructible Manhattan street. Photorealistic materials, explosive superhuman martial arts, aerial combat, smoke teleportation, and visceral action-film cinematography.

REFERENCE IMAGES AND CHARACTER CONSISTENCY
Use the reference sheets strictly for character appearance. Render exactly one fighter from each reference as a fully realized character inside the scene. Do not display the design sheets, their panels, labels, or typography.
Character A — Mechanical Fox-Mask Ninja, reference image 1:
Preserve the white-and-red fox mask, glowing red eyes, black mechanical armor, white armor accents, intricate brass details, thick cable-like hair, respirator components, ragged red-and-black fabric, and katana. Fast, precise, aggressive movement.

Character B — Decayed Antlered Warrior, reference image 2:
Preserve the ivory skeletal body, skull face, enormous branching antlers, intertwined dead branches, weathered off-white robes, ornaments, and sheathed swords. Visibly taller than the ninja. Heavy, devastating physical power. Maintain the same anatomy, costume, and silhouette throughout the battle.
LOCATION AND VISUAL LANGUAGE
A Manhattan intersection at blue hour: towering glass facades, yellow taxis, streetlights, steam rising from subway grates, and long views between skyscrapers. Keep the action within this recognizable intersection and the airspace immediately above it.

Destruction must follow the attacks: punches launch bodies into architecture, impacts fracture asphalt, and shockwaves shatter nearby windows. Heavy debris falls with convincing weight.
SMOKE TELEPORTATION RULE
Only the fox-mask ninja uses smoke teleportation. His entire body dissolves into dense black smoke threaded with red embers, then reforms as a solid, intact body at another position.

Smoke clouds linger where he disappears. He can return to these previously established locations. Establish three recognizable smoke positions during the early exchanges, then reuse them during the final counterattack. These are successive appearances of ONE ninja, never clones.
TIMELINE — EXACTLY 15 SECONDS

0.0–2.0 seconds — IMMEDIATE IMPACT
Begin on the antlered warrior’s fist already striking the ninja’s armored torso. The impact launches the ninja backward over a yellow taxi and into a building facade. Glass and masonry burst outward.

Start with a low, wide-angle street-level shot, then accelerate alongside the airborne ninja. Show the impact clearly before the debris expands. No introduction or preparatory posing.
2.0–5.0 seconds — SMOKE TELEPORT COMBAT
The warrior charges toward the damaged facade. Just before his follow-up punch connects, the ninja dissolves into black smoke.

The ninja reforms behind the warrior and lands a powerful rising knee, lifting him off the street. He immediately dissolves again and reappears overhead, driving a heel downward. Establish lingering ember-filled smoke clouds at the departure positions.

Use an over-the-shoulder view, a motivated whip-pan to the rear attack, then a wider upward view between the skyscrapers. Both fighters remain identifiable through each transition.

5.0–8.0 seconds — BRUTAL REVERSAL
The warrior catches the descending ninja by the ankle and violently swings him down into the intersection. Asphalt fractures outward and a nearby taxi slides sideways from the shockwave.
Follow the downward motion from above, then cut to a low angle for the ground impact. The ninja disappears inside black smoke and rising dust. The warrior stands over the crater, apparently victorious. Let the impact sound decay into a brief hush.

8.0–12.0 seconds — THE SMOKE TRAP
Red embers ignite inside the smoke clouds left earlier.

In one readable medium-wide view, the ninja reappears from the rear cloud and kicks the warrior forward, vanishes, reforms from the side cloud and punches his ribs, then vanishes and reforms directly in front of him.
Three rapid, distinct positions. Every attack connects before the next teleport. The warrior staggers, unable to recover between hits. The ninja finishes firmly planted in front of him, hand gripping the katana hilt.

Accelerate the rhythm through these attacks. Use short whip-pans and decisive impact cuts while maintaining clear geography.

12.0–15.0 seconds — DECISIVE FINISH
Briefly slow the instant before the ninja draws his sword. Return to full speed for one clean, devastating slash across the warrior’s torso, leaving a thin red trail.

A short still beat. A crack races through the warrior’s skull and antlers. His skeletal body and branches fracture into dry ivory fragments and collapse completely. The warrior is definitively defeated.
The ninja remains standing and begins to sheath his sword as damaged masonry falls behind him. End on a sharp close-up of the fox mask’s glowing red eye.

GLITCH AND NOISE
Synchronize effects with physical events:
During disappearance, the ninja’s silhouette briefly tears sideways before dissolving into smoke.
During reappearance, a red chromatic afterimage resolves into the solid body.
At major impacts, add a very brief frame tear, digital noise burst, and sharp audio distortion.

Keep faces, striking limbs, contact points, and the final collapse readable. Preserve the cinematic image between these short disruptions.
CAMERA AND SOUND
Combine ground-level wide angles, shoulder-level tracking, an overhead descent, controlled whip-pans, and selective speed ramps. Each camera movement follows an attack or reveals a teleport destination.

Sound: heavy metallic impacts, rushing air, pressure-wave bass, breaking glass, asphalt cracking, mechanical movement, a sharp sword draw, and brittle bone fracture. A tiny silence immediately before the final slash, followed by a powerful impact and debris falling.

No dialogue, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, split screens, character duplication, extra limbs, costume changes, blood, or flesh. No regeneration after the final defeat.

cases.author: hfranques_cine
cases.prompt:
how it was made, in four steps, with every prompt.

1. style sheet. before any shot, the film's van gogh: three key paintings, then ten panels from all over the film in the same manner. three colours only: blue for the world, yellow for warmth, red for the pep.

the key paintings (nano banana 2.1, from a grey blender plate + earlier paintings of the film):
THE SCENE: a 1970s concrete high school seen frontally across its courtyard, a big bare plane tree, a sweeper in a blue work jacket and an orange wool beanie sweeping red-orange leaves beside his green wheeled bin, students behind the lit classroom windows. Paint this scene as an oil painting in EXACTLY the manner of the attached style sheet and of the two attached paintings from the same film (the leaf in the swirling sky, the sketchbook over the courtyard): that manner is the one to keep, its colours, its deep cold blue, its swirling sky, its thick impasto, its warm lit windows, its red-orange leaves and beanie; do not invent another Van Gogh. Compared to those two paintings, push only two things: MORE BRUSHSTROKES EVERYWHERE, every surface made of visible loaded strokes laid side by side, no smooth area, the strokes following the forms (sky in swirls, walls in stacked horizontals, trunk in twists, ground in long horizontals, each leaf one thick dab); and THE PEOPLE MORE PAINTED: the figures built from a handful of bold strokes like Van Gogh's figures, their clothes dissolved into blended strokes of colour, no photographic face, no fabric detail, still recognisable by posture and colour (the sweeper: bent, blue jacket, orange beanie, broom; the students: dabs of warm colour behind the glass; the boy at the window: a few strokes, head turned to the glass). Same composition and placement as the scene; 21:9 canvas. The attached picture is not a photograph but the rendering of a crude architectural scale model with red handwritten notes saying what each shape must become: read the notes, make the real place out of it, then paint that real place as described; the notes disappear.

the panels (nano banana 2.1, each from its grey blender plate + the three key paintings + the sheet):
THE SCENE: [what each panel shows]. Paint this scene as an oil painting in EXACTLY the manner of the attached three paintings and the attached style sheet, all from the same film: keep that manner, its thick impasto, every surface made of visible loaded brushstrokes laid side by side, the strokes following the forms (sky in swirls, walls in stacked horizontals, trunks in twists, ground in long horizontals, each leaf one thick dab), its heavy contours, its deep cold blue dominating; its people painted in a handful of bold strokes, recognisable by posture and colour, never a photographic face. PALETTE OF THREE: the BLUE of the world (Prussian blue, cobalt, blue-grey, violet in the shadows), the YELLOW of warmth (the lit windows, the students' clothes, the lamplight, a chrome yellow that glows in the blue), and the RED for the pep (the red-orange leaves, the sweeper's beanie, the red smoke and flags, the painted nails). Same composition and placement as the attached grey plate, which is a crude architectural scale model of the scene: make the real scene from it, then paint it; if it carries red notes, read them and remove them. 21:9 canvas, no text.

2. blender. no prompt: the school is built as a grey world in python, then the frame of this shot from the classroom window, with a handheld camera move.

3. the painted still (nano banana 2.1, from the grey frame + the style sheet + the three key paintings):
THE SHOT (S2.01, beat 1, the landscape, the church at the back): Van Gogh, low horizon: from Matisse's window, the window post and the pier frame the courtyard, the wall, the roofs and the spire on axis; the sky takes more than half of the frame. Paint this scene as an oil painting in EXACTLY the manner of the attached style sheet and the three attached paintings from the same film: keep that manner, its thick impasto, every surface made of visible loaded brushstrokes laid side by side, the strokes following the forms (sky in swirls, walls in stacked horizontals, trunks in twists, ground in long horizontals, each leaf one thick dab), its heavy contours, its deep cold blue dominating; its people painted in a handful of bold strokes, recognisable by posture and colour, never a photographic face. PALETTE OF THREE: the BLUE of the world, the YELLOW of warmth (lit windows, lamplight), the RED for the pep (leaves, the sweeper's beanie, fire, red smoke and flags). The attached grey picture is a crude architectural scale model of the scene, rendered from the film's camera: keep EXACTLY its framing, lens, composition and the place, size and pose of every figure and object; make the real scene from it, then paint it. 21:9 canvas, cinematic, no text.

4. the animation (seedance 2.5, the still as first frame, the blender camera as motion reference, the style sheet as image reference, 8 seconds):
A moving oil painting in EXACTLY the manner of the attached style sheet (the film's Van Gogh), 24 fps, 21:9: every frame is thick paint, impasto, visible loaded brushstrokes, heavy contours; the strokes themselves breathe and swirl over time. Start EXACTLY on the start image: from the first-floor window of the classroom, a window post at the left, the courtyard wall, the roofs of the suburb, the church spire on the horizon, and a huge sky filling most of the frame. THE SKY CHANGES COLOUR LITTLE BY LITTLE, over the whole 8 seconds, never suddenly: it starts calm, all deep Prussian and cobalt blue with pale swirls; from the first seconds the swirls begin to turn faster and heavier; a glow of orange appears low on the horizon behind the roofs and the spire, then climbs into the swirls stroke by stroke, orange and red-orange paint mixing into the blue, the clouds thickening and darkening into storm clouds; by the end the upper sky is a churning storm of blue and orange, menacing, as if a fire or a war were rising beyond the town; a far rumble of thunder; a few leaves and birds carried by the wind. The town below stays still, a few windows glow yellow. THE CAMERA is a person standing at the window, holding it by hand: a very gentle, natural handheld breathing, a slow drift of a fraction of a degree, a faint tremor of the hands, as in the attached reference video (a layout previs on the empty set: take from it exactly this camera motion and its timing); no pan, no zoom, no jolt, no fast shake, never steady like a tripod. No text, no cuts, real time. Sound: wind, a distant rumble rising.

cases.prompt:
Style: Hyper-realistic 1980s romantic soap opera. One continuous location with multiple cinematic camera angles. Warm golden lighting, soft diffusion filter, subtle film grain, glamorous close-ups, slow dramatic zooms, elegant camera movement, emotionally restrained performances. Everything feels like a premium 1980s primetime romance. No CGI, no cartoon, no 3D appearance.

Keep the characters identical to the provided reference sheets.

Adrian:

• Athletic young man

• Dark tousled hair

• Blue eyes

• White fitted T-shirt and blue jeans

• Handsome, confident, emotionally guarded

Evelyn:

• Elegant brunette

• Polka-dot blouse

• Red pleated skirt

• Pearl necklace

• Intelligent, graceful, quietly emotional

SETTING

A quiet old-fashioned café at sunset. Warm orange sunlight pours through the large windows. Vintage décor, wooden tables, soft curtains moving in the breeze, only a few distant customers. The entire story takes place in this single room.

The scene begins with a wide establishing shot. Adrian sits alone at a table, nervously stirring untouched coffee. Evelyn enters the café and notices him. The camera cuts between Adrian's hopeful eyes and Evelyn's uncertain expression before she slowly walks toward him.

She quietly asks, "May I?"

Adrian nods. She sits across from him.

The tension is immediate.

Alternating over-the-shoulder shots reveal neither knows how to begin. Close-ups linger on nervous fingers, subtle eye movements, hesitant smiles, cups of coffee left untouched, and tiny changes in expression.

A slow push-in captures Adrian finally breaking the silence.

"I wasn't sure you'd come."

Evelyn lowers her eyes before softly answering,

"I almost didn't."

Silence.

The camera slowly circles around them as neither looks away.

Close-up on Adrian gathering the courage to reach across the table. His hand stops halfway.

Evelyn notices.

She hesitates...

...then gently places her hand into his.

Extreme close-up of their hands touching.

Neither speaks.

A tear quietly forms in Evelyn's eye, but she smiles.

Adrian smiles back with visible relief.

The surrounding café ambience seems to fade, leaving only their breathing.

The camera alternates between intimate close-ups, profile shots through the café window, low-angle table shots, and soft side tracking shots, emphasizing every glance and every pause.

In the final moments, they continue holding hands across the table without saying another word. The camera slowly dollies backward, revealing the warm café around them while the golden sunset fills the room. They never break eye contact.

Audio:

Soft 1980s romantic soap-opera piano with gentle strings, quiet café ambience, distant dishes, subtle footsteps, soft breathing and long dramatic pauses.

Negative:

No action, no comedy, no modern technology, no smartphones, no CGI, no cartoon, no exaggerated acting, no fast editing, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermark.
