cases.title_en: Shibuya Scramble Mech Skull vs Skeletal King
cases.description_zh: X 原帖公开提示词（9199 字）· Seedance 2.5 视频案例。
cases.author: tokyo_Valentine
cases.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9 cinematic action video set at Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo, at night.

CHARACTER REFERENCES
Use only the two character reference images for identity and design.
Reference 1: Character A, the yellow-and-black mechanical skull cyborg.
Reference 2: Character B, the towering skeletal king wearing crimson robes.

A: Approximately 180 cm tall. Chipped yellow industrial armor, horizontal pointed head extensions, skull mask, black breathing hoses, intricate mechanical joints, spiked shoulders, chains, and torn dark fabric.
B: Approximately 260 cm tall. Huge branching black antlers, ornate crown, glowing red eyes, exposed skeletal ribcage, elaborate tattered crimson robes, and an ornate staff.

Preserve their exact silhouettes, proportions, materials, colors, and accessories. Create fluid full-body combat animation and dynamic camera movement. Maintain their height difference.

VISUAL STYLE
Photorealistic live-action cinematography, spectacular destruction VFX, and explosive shonen battle intensity.

Extreme acceleration, brutal close-range punches, powerful blocks, violent recoil, and physical impacts that destroy roads and buildings.

Combine tactile physical realism with aggressive digital corruption: RGB separation, horizontal signal tearing, datamoshing trails, pixel fragmentation, scanline interference, and dirty electronic noise.
Keep the choreography and decisive impacts clearly readable.

GLITCH AND NOISE DIRECTION
Make the effects react to the action.

On punch contact: short, violent RGB displacement around the fighters, horizontal image shearing, and a burst of coarse digital static radiating from the impact.

During extreme acceleration: stretched datamoshing trails and fragmented afterimages attached to moving limbs. These are visual motion trails, not separate characters.

Around the reality fracture: unstable scanlines, displaced image strips, crawling pixel noise, and flickering red-white edges.
During mist transformation: mechanical surfaces break into tiny yellow particles, black vapor, and granular signal noise. The transition remains continuous and visibly follows the body.

During the final destruction: physical fragments mix with pixel breakup, corrupted motion trails, and a dense burst of electronic interference.

Use the strongest corruption in brief bursts, followed by clear moving imagery. Keep physical motion flowing through every effect. Avoid prolonged freezes or static poses.

LOCATION
An empty, rain-soaked Shibuya Scramble Crossing. Recognizable diagonal zebra crossings, giant LED billboards, QFRONT-style architecture, and surrounding shopping towers.

Wet asphalt reflects cold city lights, yellow sparks, and crimson energy.

Billboards briefly malfunction in response to nearby shockwaves: distorted footage, broken scanlines, and signal noise.

Keep the fight within this intersection. Environmental damage accumulates and remains visible.

0–3 SECONDS — EXPLOSIVE COLLISION
Begin immediately in motion.
An ultra-low camera races along the white crossing stripes as both fighters launch toward each other.

A’s fist crashes into B’s blocking forearm. Show clear contact and recoil, followed by an expanding pressure ring that blasts rainwater outward and fractures the asphalt.

At contact, deliver a sharp burst of RGB separation and horizontal signal tearing. Restore a clear image immediately as the movement continues.

Whip-pan into a side-on tracking shot. A drives a heavy punch into B’s guarded ribs.

B slides backward, tearing trenches through the road. The shockwave lifts asphalt slabs and bursts a nearby empty building’s glass facade.
Debris travels outward from the strike. Yellow motion trails and fragmented crimson afterimages emphasize their opposing momentum.

3–5 SECONDS — REALITY FRACTURE
B plants its foot, pivots, and swings its staff in a savage diagonal counterattack.

A crimson energy slash cuts across the viewer’s image plane, opening a glowing fracture through reality directly in front of A.

Shoot from an extreme low Dutch angle as the staff passes close to the lens.

Along the fracture, image strips slide out of alignment. Red-white pixels crawl across the edges. Horizontal static and displaced scanlines expose a narrow black slit.

A ducks beneath the slash.

The camera pushes toward A’s articulated metal hand as it catches the fractured edge and pulls the moving image open like a curtain.

This is a fracture in reality at the camera plane, not a broken billboard or ordinary glass.
5–8 SECONDS — BODY BECOMES MIST
Without pausing, A transforms its entire body into dense black industrial mist threaded with yellow sparks and tiny metal particles.

Feet and legs dissolve first, followed by torso and arms. Its skull and reaching hand disappear last.

Mechanical surfaces progressively fragment into smoky particles and granular digital noise. Show the physical anatomy continuously becoming vapor.

A’s former position becomes completely empty.

The mist flows through the opened fracture.

Rise into an overhead view of Shibuya’s diagonal crossings. Follow one coherent ribbon of black-and-yellow mist racing around B’s blind side and converging directly behind the king.

Use streaming pixel trails and localized datamoshing within the moving vapor. Keep its path and destination obvious.

8–10 SECONDS — REASSEMBLY AND COMBINATION
Dive into a low rear three-quarter angle behind B’s whipping crimson cape.
The mist converges and reconstructs A behind the king. Yellow particles condense into the original skull, armor, arms, and legs.

Digital noise contracts into the mechanical surfaces and disappears as each part becomes solid.

A immediately attacks. B pivots toward the movement.

From over A’s yellow shoulder, show a left body punch connecting with B’s ribs, followed by a compact elbow that snaps the king’s upper body sideways.

Each contact creates a brief pulse of image displacement, metallic sparks, and dirty static. Keep the connecting fist, cracking bone, and recoil visible.

Arc toward a clear three-quarter side angle as A plants its foot and draws back its right fist.

10–13 SECONDS — FINAL PUNCH AND COMPLETE DESTRUCTION
A steps forward and drives one decisive rising right straight into B’s sternum.

Show unmistakable fist-to-bone contact from a powerful low angle.
Use a fraction of a second of slow motion at contact, then accelerate into explosive destruction.

A concentrated glitch pulse erupts from the contact point: RGB channels split outward, the surrounding image briefly shears horizontally, and coarse electronic noise follows the expanding shockwave.

B’s ribcage caves inward and shatters outward.

Cracks race through its spine, skull, crown, antlers, arms, and legs. The entire skeletal king physically breaks into thousands of small fragments and fine powder.

Its staff splinters. Its crimson robes tear into scattered scraps.

Mix the flying physical fragments with brief pixel breakup and corrupted motion trails. Show the destruction clearly; the king must visibly shatter rather than simply disappear.

The same impact creates a massive radial shockwave across Shibuya. Asphalt buckles into a crater. Crossing slabs erupt. Nearby empty building facades collapse, and billboard supports bend and fall.

A remains solid and intact through the follow-through.
13–15 SECONDS — AFTERMATH
Pull back into a ground-level wide shot of the devastated intersection.

Connect cuts through movement and preserve spatial continuity.

Use selective motion blur during acceleration, crisp silhouettes at contact, and camera shake precisely on impact.

Synchronize short bitcrushed crackles and electronic noise with the glitch bursts.
Build aggressive industrial percussion through the fight. Drop the music at the final punch, exposing the impact and destruction. Finish with rain, settling debris, and fading electrical interference.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS
Full-screen 16:9 moving cinematic video.
No dialogue, subtitles, added titles, or watermarks.
Preserve character identity through every glitch.
Maintain continuous physical motion and readable combat.
Show full-body mist transformation, directional travel, and complete reconstruction.
Major environmental destruction follows visible impacts.
The yellow cyborg survives.
The skeletal king is completely pulverized.

Create an original 30-second cinematic Korean action-thriller with dark comedy, photorealistic live-action visuals, 16:9 widescreen, 24fps.

VISUAL STYLE:
A modern Seoul metro station late at night, featuring pale grey tiled walls, muted jade-green platform doors, brushed-steel railings, cool overhead lighting and reflections across the polished floor. Use a moody blue-green colour palette with subtle amber highlights, realistic film grain, dynamic handheld cinematography, sharp close-ups and energetic tracking shots. The atmosphere should feel suspenseful yet unexpectedly humorous.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
WOMAN: Korean woman in her early 20s with a short, slightly tousled black bob and soft fringe, wearing a dark espresso-brown leather bomber jacket, charcoal pleated skirt, cream knee-high socks and chunky black combat boots. A compact burgundy shoulder bag hangs across her body. Her expression shifts from frightened uncertainty to quiet confidence.

MAN: Korean man in his mid-20s with untidy black hair featuring subtle ash-blonde streaks, narrow sunglasses resting on his head, a dark graphite overshirt, plain ivory T-shirt, black trousers and worn trainers. He has an overconfident smirk and exaggerated comic expressions.

SHOT-BY-SHOT TIMELINE:

[0–3 seconds]
Begin with a low-angle tracking shot descending a metro staircase. The man suddenly grabs the woman's shoulder from behind, startling her. She twists away, loses her balance momentarily and catches the metal railing. Her bob swings naturally with the movement. A sharp camera jolt emphasizes the surprise.

[3–6 seconds]
Cut to a high-angle wide shot. The woman hurries down the remaining stairs while looking back nervously. The man follows at a brisk pace, wearing an unsettlingly cheerful grin. Her bag bounces against her side as the station lights flicker subtly overhead.

[6–9 seconds]
Use a fast lateral tracking shot as she reaches the lower landing and rushes toward the platform. Her boots echo against the tiles. A train approaches in the background, its headlights reflecting across the polished floor.

[9–12 seconds]
The train stops with a metallic hiss. She slips through the open doorway just before the doors begin closing, turns around and raises both palms toward the glass. Her breathing is quick, and she looks relieved for half a second.

[12–15 seconds]
Over her shoulder, reveal the man standing inside the carriage behind the opposite glass panel. He slowly raises one finger as if he has just remembered something important. His exaggeratedly innocent smile makes the moment darkly funny. The woman freezes in disbelief.

[15–18 seconds]
Extreme close-up of the man leaning toward the glass. Fluorescent light reflects in his eyes. He tilts his head and says with dry sarcasm, "You really thought that was going to work?" His smile widens. Use a brief dramatic pause and restrained comic timing.

[18–21 seconds]
A sudden metallic bang interrupts the silence as he strikes the reinforced glass panel with his palm. The impact produces a sharp reverberation and a brief stylized spiderweb of cracks in the glass. The woman flinches and steps back. Keep the impact non-graphic, with no injuries or flying glass shards.

[21–24 seconds]
Wide shot as the carriage doors reopen. The man steps onto the platform with exaggerated confidence, straightens his jacket and gestures toward her as if inviting a conversation. She cautiously retreats, then notices a nearby station staff member watching them.

[24–27 seconds]
The woman abruptly changes her expression. Instead of running, she sidesteps his approach and pulls her bag out of his reach. He spins slightly off balance and ends up sitting on a padded station bench, bewildered. The action is quick, believable and comedic rather than brutal.

[27–29 seconds]
Static medium-wide composition. The man sits awkwardly on the bench, trying to preserve his dignity. The woman stands several steps away, adjusts her jacket and calmly checks her watch. A train announcement echoes through the otherwise quiet station.

[29–30 seconds]
Extreme close-up of the woman's eyes as she glances toward the camera with a composed, almost amused expression. In the blurred background, the man raises a hand as if he wants to explain himself. Cut sharply to black.

CAMERA AND EDITING:
Use varied shot sizes, low-angle tracking, over-the-shoulder framing, controlled whip-pans, brief crash zooms and carefully timed reaction shots. Keep screen direction consistent and transitions smooth. Build tension through pauses and sound before releasing it with an unexpected comedic reversal.

AUDIO:
Realistic subway ambience, footsteps on stairs, distant train brakes, door chimes, leather and fabric movement, a metallic impact, station announcements and subtle suspense music. Introduce a short comedic musical accent during the final reversal. Dialogue should sound natural and match the characters' expressions.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS:
Photorealistic live-action appearance, convincing facial expressions, natural movement, realistic clothing textures, consistent character designs, believable station architecture, cinematic lighting and polished professional colour grading.

30.3 seconds, 4:3, live-action cinematic realism, cold white fluorescent school-restroom light, desaturated cream-and-teal tones, handheld and low-angle camera, water-power fantasy revenge drama. Keep faces, uniforms and the location identical in every shot. Keep the violence non-graphic, no blood.

CHARACTERS (repeat in every part)
HEROINE: Japanese high-school girl, long straight black hair with full bangs, white short-sleeve blouse, navy tie, navy pleated skirt, dark knee socks. Calm and cold; after the sink she is soaked, wet hair clinging to her face.
BOY: Japanese high-school boy, short messy light-brown hair with blond tips, white dress shirt with red-brown stains, loose navy tie, dark grey trousers, black shoes.
PONYTAIL GIRL: black hair in a high ponytail, same girl uniform, black knee socks.
WAVY-HAIRED GIRL: long dark wavy hair with bangs, same uniform.
BOB GIRL: short dark bob haircut, same uniform.
LOCATION: a school restroom. Cream-tiled walls, a long white row of sinks with chrome taps and a wide mirror, a row of off-white toilet stall doors, urinals, small high windows, wet tile floor.

WATER POWERS (appear in the fight): transparent water gauntlets wrapped around forearms, a large circular water shield, a long translucent water whip/blade, a ball of water that can blast a person back, a ring of water rising around the floor, and a glowing glass-like water orb that explodes.

===== PART 1 (00:00-00:10.3) =====

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:00.9) — The Setup
Wide low-angle shot of the restroom. The heroine stands at the first sink, looking down at the full basin of water with the tap running. The boy stands beside her. Behind them the ponytail girl and the wavy-haired girl stand smirking with arms crossed. Camera static.
SOUND: quiet room tone, a faint tap drip, a low tense hum.

SHOT 2 (00:00.9-00:02.7) — The Yank
The boy grabs the heroine's tie and collar and yanks her toward the sink. She is bent forward, twisting over the basin, as he steps behind her and holds her. The two girls watch in the background.
SOUND: a cloth tug, a low grunt from the boy, her shocked inhale, shoes squeaking on wet tile.

SHOT 3 (00:02.7-00:03.8) — Forced Down
Wide shot. He forces her head down into the water-filled sink, pressing one hand on her head. The tap keeps running. The girls watch from behind.
SOUND: a splash, sudden louder water rush, the tap running, muffled shock.

SHOT 4 (00:03.8-00:06.1) — Underwater
Side underwater view of her face in the sink: eyes closed, bubbles rising slowly past her hair, her face calm, the drain visible. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 50% speed).
SOUND: muffled underwater rumble, stretched bubble pops and a distant ringing, no voices.

SHOT 5 (00:06.1-00:07.0) — The Burst
Wide shot. She plants a hand on the sink's edge and pushes up, and the water in the basin erupts upward in a violent splash as she rises. Speed: REAL TIME.
SOUND: the sound drops almost to silence, then a single heavy water burst and a short ringing.

SHOT 6 (00:07.0-00:08.2) — Gasping
Medium two-shot. She stands bent forward, soaked, gasping and coughing for breath. The boy stands behind her in a stained white shirt, hands at his sides, staring.
SOUND: almost no background sound, her ragged breathing, water dripping off her hair and clothes.

SHOT 7 (00:08.2-00:08.8) — The Palm
She turns to face him and raises one open hand toward him. A ball of water forms against his chest.
SOUND: a low rising swell, a quiet water hiss building.

SHOT 8 (00:08.8-00:10.3) — Blasted Back
The water ball slams into him and blasts him backward, arms flung out. His body blurs as he is thrown across the room and pinned against the toilet stall doors in a spray of water.
SOUND: the music and effects kick in loud, a heavy water-impact boom, a crash against the stall doors, a muffled shout.

===== PART 2 (00:10.3-00:20.4) =====

SHOT 9 (00:10.3-00:12.5) — Gauntlet Fight
Wide shot in front of the mirrored sinks. The ponytail girl attacks the heroine with a transparent water gauntlet wrapped around her forearm. The heroine blocks with her own water-wrapped forearm, and they trade punches and blocks. At the end she sweeps the ponytail girl aside, who stumbles backward.
SOUND: continuous driving music, punchy water-slap hits on each blocked strike, sneakers squeaking on wet tile.

SHOT 10 (00:12.5-00:15.9) — The Water Shield
The bob girl charges in from the right. The heroine conjures a large circular water disc in front of her, and the bob girl's fist slams into it. The disc ripples, bulges and bursts into spray, leaving both in fighting stances with puddles at their feet. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 50% speed).
SOUND: a rising hum as the shield forms, a deep watery thud on impact, a splashing burst, drips.

SHOT 11 (00:16.0-00:17.0) — The Kick
The heroine kicks the bob girl, who flies backward and slams into the tiled wall. The mirror behind her cracks into a star-shaped fracture, and she slumps down the wall.
SOUND: a sharp whoosh and a heavy kick, a wall slam, glass crackling.

SHOT 12 (00:17.0-00:17.45) — Behind the Sink
Low shot from behind the edge of the sinks, looking at the heroine in front of the toilet stalls with the wavy-haired girl behind her. Her face is cold and angry, one arm out.
SOUND: music tension, a held low hum.

SHOT 13 (00:17.45-00:18.2) — The Water Whip
She whips out a long translucent ribbon of water horizontally, spinning with her hair swinging as the blade fades.
SOUND: a fast water whip-crack, a long swish.

SHOT 14 (00:18.2-00:19.9) — The Lock
The heroine and the wavy-haired girl lock their water-wrapped forearms, pushing against each other, hair swinging.
SOUND: strained effort grunts, water squeaking and squelching between their arms, music building.

SHOT 15 (00:19.9-00:20.4) — The Knee
She drives a knee into the wavy-haired girl, who spins away with her hair flying. A single black frame at about 00:20.3 as a flash cut.
SOUND: a sharp thud, then a half-beat cut to silence on the black frame.

===== PART 3 (00:20.4-00:30.3) =====

SHOT 16 (00:20.4-00:21.0) — The Boy Returns
Close-up of the boy lunging toward the camera, shirt stained. The heroine's fist comes in from the right and punches him in the face with a splash of water. He staggers, hand at his face, stunned.
SOUND: a loud punch and splash, a short groan.

SHOT 17 (00:21.0-00:21.4) — Knocked Aside
At the stall doors, the wavy-haired girl is knocked sideways, hair flying.
SOUND: a body scuff, a quick swish.

SHOT 18 (00:21.4-00:22.3) — The Charge
Floor-level wide shot of the wet tile. The heroine crouches at the center, hands on the floor, while the two girls charge in from both sides (shown with their backs to the camera).
SOUND: running shoes slapping on wet tile, rising bass, water gathering.

SHOT 19 (00:22.3-00:25.3) — Ring and Orb
A circle of water rises around the three of them as a ring-shaped wave on the floor. The heroine holds a glowing glass-like water orb at her chest while the two girls are pressed at the edge of the ring. The orb brightens to a blinding white. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 40-50% speed).
SOUND: a deep humming bass swell, a rising high whine, rippling water.

SHOT 20 (00:25.3-00:26.0) — The Burst
The orb explodes in a burst of white water spray, hurling the girls outward in a cloud of droplets, hair and uniforms flying. Speed: SLOW MOTION (about 40-50% speed).
SOUND: a huge water explosion boom with a long, stretched, hissing tail.

SHOT 21 (00:26.0-00:26.5) — Thrown Apart
Wide shot. The heroine stands in the center with an arm out. One girl is thrown against the left wall and slides down, the other tumbles against the sinks and falls to the floor.
SOUND: two body thuds, falling water, the music fading out.

SHOT 22 (00:26.5-00:27.0) — The Boy Staggers
A black wipe across the right of the frame, then the boy swaying in the background while the heroine's face fills the right foreground.
SOUND: the sound thins quickly, a ringing hush.

SHOT 23 (00:27.0-00:29.0) — Aftermath
The heroine stands soaked in the foreground, panting, mouth open, a wet mist hanging in the restroom and water streaking the cracked mirror behind her. The boy collapses to the floor behind her and starts pushing himself up on his hands and knees.
SOUND: mist hiss, dripping water, her heavy breathing, his weak groan, a faint room tone.

SHOT 24 (00:29.0-00:30.3) — The Last Gesture
The heroine looks down at him and raises her right arm toward him, palm open. The boy crawls on the floor. Hold, then end.
SOUND: near silence, a faint drip, one soft breath (a quiet line is possible here, see notes).

MASTER EFFECTS INVENTORY
1. Underwater face shot with rising bubbles (Shot 4).
2. Water burst from the sink as she rises (Shot 5).
3. Water ball blast and wall pin (Shots 7-8).
4. Water gauntlets, shield disc, water whip (Shots 9, 10, 13).
5. Cracked mirror impact (Shot 11).
6. Floor water ring, glowing orb and white-water explosion (Shots 19-20).

SPEED SUMMARY
Slow motion: Shot 4 (about 50%), Shot 10 (about 50%), Shots 19-20 (about 40-50%).
Everything else: real time.

ENERGY ARC
Part 1 (0-10s): humiliation, then the first burst of power.
Part 2 (10-20s): the water-powered fight.
Part 3 (20-30s): the orb explosion, then the quiet aftermath.

人物与汽车关系 左右以汽车车头朝镜头时的画面方向为准：画面左侧是一名举起已点燃红色火焰礼花的成年男球迷，礼花有明亮红色火光、少量火星和红烟；女主角位于画面右侧车门侧窗，二人是不同的人，不能互换位置。 男球迷与车辆左侧位置关系参照分镜，不站在车顶，礼花不能长在汽车上。 女主角的侧窗玻璃完全降下。只有头、手与半边上半身从侧窗自然向外探出，一只前臂搭在车门窗沿、靠近侧后视镜的位置，另一只手松弛地抬起向近处观众挥手。肩膀与手臂从真实侧窗开口连接到车内，姿态有支撑、比例自然，不能像身体穿透玻璃。 她兴奋地笑、短暂张口欢呼、看向身旁和下方球迷，挥手只是间歇动作，不持续摆拍。身体随汽车晃动轻微调整，随后自然收回车内。挡风玻璃始终完整，车顶全程无人。 ## 时间线 0–1.5秒｜完全拉远广角 从确认首帧开始。鸟巢看台巨大的弧线、顶棚和浅灰蓝天空占画面上方，正在比赛的足球场与跑道位于右下方，近处球迷背影在底部。成千上万人如活的波浪般上下跳动。 紫色汽车位于远处左中部看台，比例很小，只能隐约辨认车身；左侧红色礼花是醒目的小光点，淡红烟与灰尘向右飘散。女主角此时留在车内，不可辨识。 1.5–5秒｜手持向左甩动＋快速放大 镜头向左寻找红光，数码变焦反复搜寻并短暂放大过头，随后锁定人群上方的紫色SUV。构图接近4秒参考图，汽车仍是远处人群中的小主体，四周密集球迷与薄尘雾充满视野。数百只手直接支撑底盘，汽车随人群上下摇晃。左侧男球迷的礼花已经燃烧，红烟向右散开。女主角仍在车内。 5–10秒｜像素化最大倍数变焦 镜头继续放大，画面变软、轻微像素化。汽车在人群头顶逐手接力，倾斜并上下颠动。 9秒附近构图与参考分镜一致：斜向俯视能看见车顶、挡风玻璃与车头，汽车方向和大小参照确认图片。左侧男球迷高举红色礼花，红烟混入尘雾。 女主角第一次短暂从右侧车门侧窗探出头、手和半边上半身。她一只前臂自然搭着窗沿，另一只手向旁边球迷挥两下，兴奋地笑；髋部与腿保持在车内，随后收回。不要为展示她而改变镜头或另切特写。 10–17秒｜跟随变焦 人群一片接一片地接力，将汽车从画面左侧向右侧、沿弧形看台朝拍摄者方向传递。汽车接近，镜头缓慢拉远以保持主体在画面中。礼花仍是汽车左侧明亮的红色光点，烟尘持续向右飘散。女主角大部分时间留在车内，只能偶尔透过侧窗见到她的头部，不连续探出。 17–23秒｜变焦几乎完全拉远 汽车逐排上升，由连续几排球迷接力托举，朝拍摄者靠近。手机周围的球迷蹦跳、指着汽车，并举手准备承托。 21秒附近匹配参考：近处观众背影与举起的手臂在前景，鸟巢顶棚重新进入上方，汽车仍在几排之外的中远处，不能提前变成占满画面的近景。左侧礼花亮点与红烟可见，女主角已经缩回车内。 23–27秒｜手机广角近景 汽车车头朝前到达距镜头几米的位置，车身在大量承托手掌之上摇晃。26秒附近接近确认分镜：紫色车头巨大，黑色展示牌白字“智界R7”清晰可读；略带三分之二正面的角度，让右侧车门窗口及侧后视镜可见。 汽车左侧男球迷高举燃烧礼花，红光、少量火星和烟尘掠过人群。司机短促按响喇叭。 女主角第二次短暂从右侧侧窗探出头、手和半边上半身，前臂撑在车门窗沿，朝近处观众兴奋挥手。她位于侧后视镜之后、挡风玻璃侧边之外，挡风玻璃与车顶完整无人。动作自然、幅度克制，随后收回车内。 27–30秒｜极近特写 汽车直接从镜头上方经过。先是“智界R7”展示牌，随后车底、悬空轮胎与托举的手掌占满画面。车轮只受外力轻微转动，汽车由人群传递而非发动机驱动。 手掌拍打金属车身并继续承托底盘。手机被碰撞一下，镜头突然向上倾斜，拍到浅灰蓝天空与鸟巢钢结构顶棚，现场录像自然结束。没有结束字幕或转场。 ## 声音 仅手机现场原始收音：震耳欲聋的重庆球迷助威、人群有节奏地跺脚、助威大鼓、汽车喇叭、礼花燃烧的嘶嘶声与轻微噼啪声。近处球迷用自然重庆话重叠喊：“看车子！看车子！”“哎哟，我的妈耶！”“接到！接到！”“重庆，雄起！” 女主角偶尔自然笑着喊一句“雄起！”，不要配成长段口播，不必刻意突出她的声音。保留手机麦克风轻微爆音、风声和人群混杂声。无配乐，无字幕，无旁白。 ## 风格与质量强化 照片级真实的手机纪录片录像；可信的体育场规模与连续空间关系；汽车重量通过承托手臂、人群受力与车身轻微起伏体现。人群个体有差异并持续运动。汽车造型、紫色漆面、展示牌、两名人物、服装、旗帜、礼花与烟尘方向全程一致。 负面约束：无车顶人物，无穿透挡风玻璃或天窗，无腿伸出车窗，无坐上窗沿，无人物巨型化，无重复脸或多余肢体，无悬空无支撑汽车，无车体变形、瞬移、镜头切换或插入参考图，无鲜艳高饱和广告色，无整片纯红服装，无巴西旗帜或葡萄牙语。

cases.description_zh: 用 GPT Image 2 先定死人物形象，再配一张正面产品实拍，交给 Seedance 2.5 出 15 秒竖版自拍口播广告；提示语把四段节拍、口播台词、手持相机质感和标签文字锁死，所以整条片子人脸不漂移、瓶身文字不被模型改写。
cases.author: abxxai
cases.prompt:
A 15-second vertical (9:16) ultra-photorealistic close-up vlog clip, filmed on a phone held at arm's length. Not an ad. A girl talking to her own camera at the end of the day, the way people actually film themselves.
TALENT —
Young woman, early-to-mid 20s. Long light-brown hair with soft caramel balayage, middle part, loose undone waves, a few strands stuck to her cheek. Fair-to-light-tan skin with visible freckles across the nose and cheeks, thick natural brows, blue-green eyes, bare face, small blue resin hoop earrings, thin gold chain with a small pearl pendant. Face, freckles, hair and eye color must 100% match the reference. Oversized white linen button-down over a fitted white ribbed top, fully covered, collar slightly crooked, sleeves pushed up.
PRODUCT —
LANEIGE Water Sleeping Mask_EX, 70 ml. Frosted translucent light-blue glass jar, smooth matte cobalt-blue screw lid. Front label reads, in this exact order: "LANEIGE" in wide-spaced capitals, "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" below it, then "SLEEPING MICROBIOME" and "BRIGHTENING · HYDRATING · SOFTENING" in smaller pale-yellow type, then "70 ml" at the base. Inside, thick pale mint-blue gel with a wet glossy surface that holds a soft peak. Shape, color, gel texture and all label text must 100% match the reference, correctly spelled, legible whenever in focus.
LOCATION
A villa bedroom at golden hour. Only fragments read in frame because the camera is so tight: white stucco wall, a corner of rumpled white linen bedding, blurred bougainvillea and olive leaves through an open door behind her. The background stays soft and mostly out of focus the entire time.
LIGHTING
One condition, unchanged across all four beats. Low warm sun from frame-left through the open door, roughly 4800K, soft white-wall bounce filling the shadow side of her face. Warm rim on the left edge of her hair and jaw. Slight blown highlight where the sun clips her cheek. No ring light, no fill, no glam lighting.
FRAMING
Close-up throughout. Her face fills most of the frame in every beat, chin to just above the hairline, never wider than upper-chest. The jar enters frame close to her face, never held out toward the lens.
0:00–0:04
Visual: Tight front-camera close-up, slightly below eye level. She's mid-motion already, pushing hair off her face with the back of her wrist. She glances just off-lens, checking her own image, then back. The jar comes up beside her cheek, held low and casual, only the top half in frame, lid already off. A slow exhale through the nose.
Camera: Selfie camera, arm's length, natural handheld drift, one quick autofocus hunt between her face and the jar.
Dialogue: "Okay. Last thing, then bed."
0:04–0:07
Visual: She tips the jar slightly and drags two fingertips through the gel. Macro-tight: her fingertips, the wet mint-blue surface, a fine thread of gel stretching and snapping. The "LANEIGE" and "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" lines cross the frame in focus for a beat. Her face stays partly in frame at the edge, out of focus.
Camera: Same front camera pushed in close, shallow focus, rack from the label to the gel on her fingers.
Dialogue: "It's cold, by the way."
0:07–0:11
Visual: Back to her face, closer now. She taps the gel across one cheek, her forehead, her chin, then presses it in flat-palmed, working outward. The gel flashes milky over her skin, then settles clear with a faint sheen. She winces at the cold, blinks it off, keeps going. Freckles, pores and natural under-eye shadows stay visible right through the layer. She's talking while working, not pausing for the line.
Camera: Selfie camera, very close, small handheld corrections, a slow drift as she turns her cheek toward the light.
Dialogue: "Thin layer. You don't wash it off."
0:11–0:15
Visual: Closest framing of the clip. She presses two fingertips against her cheek and lets them lift, feeling the faint tack. Turns her head slowly through the low sun, checking the sheen along her cheekbone, eyes tracking her own reflection in the screen rather than the lens. A short nod. The corner of the blue jar sits soft-focus in the lower frame edge, label partly readable. She reaches to stop the recording and the frame tilts as her hand moves.
Camera: Selfie camera, slow handheld orbit from three-quarter profile to straight-on, ending on her face filling the frame, then a small tilt as she reaches.
Dialogue: "Morning me is gonna be so happy."
PERFORMANCE
End-of-day, low energy, unperformed. She talks the way someone talks while doing something else, lines half-thrown-away, not projected. Micro-behavior carries the beats: a slow blink, a genuine flinch at the cold, a half-smile that arrives late, eyes checking her own reflection instead of the lens, one natural swallow, visible breath, a small unconscious head tilt. No presenter voice, no bright delivery, no exaggerated reactions, no pointing at the product.
VOICE
Soft, slightly flat, close to the mic because the phone is at arm's length. Natural room tone around it. Unhurried, a little tired. Ordinary speaking volume with a touch of breath on the ends of words.
REALISM
Pore-level skin realism: visible pores across the nose and cheeks, fine forehead texture, natural freckling, faint under-eye shadows, a small blemish near the jaw, stray flyaway hairs catching the backlight, vellus hair on the cheek edge. Wet living eyes with catch-lights and natural asymmetric blinking. The gel reads as a real cosmetic layer refracting light on top of her skin, never replacing its texture.
PHYSICS
Gel holds a soft peak on her fingertip and slumps under pressure. Hair moves with real inertia and a few strands fall back across her face. Linen creases and drapes naturally. The jar has real weight and correct contact shadow against her hand. Camera weight shifts naturally with her arm.
CAMERA CHARACTER
Authentic modern smartphone selfie footage. Natural handheld tremor throughout, small framing corrections, quick autofocus hunts, mild wide-angle distortion at close range, natural rol

cases.title_zh: mini DV 咖啡 ASMR vlog
cases.title_en: Mini DV Coffee ASMR Vlog
cases.description_zh: 用家用摄像机的缺陷反向做真实感：手抖、来回找焦、曝光漂移、磁带颗粒全写进提示词，再配一份 ASMR 声音清单和每段三秒的分镜节奏。
cases.author: Strength04_X
cases.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright kitchen morning light. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy coffee-prep vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bean grinder whirring, portafilter tamping, steam wand hissing, cup clinking, milk frothing.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain t-shirt, hair slightly tousled, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy while making his morning coffee.
SETTING: Small kitchen counter with an espresso machine on a bright morning. Natural daylight, coffee beans and a mug nearby, quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the counter, switches on the machine. "Morning coffee, the proper way."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Grinds fresh coffee beans, fine grounds falling into the portafilter.
→ (3s, close-up) Tamps the grounds down firmly and evenly.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Locks the portafilter into the machine. "Here we go."
→ (3s, detail shot) Espresso streams slowly into a small cup. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Pours cold milk into a small steel pitcher. "Time for the milk."
→ (3s, macro shot) Steam wand hissing as it froths the milk.
→ (3s, propped shot) Pours frothed milk carefully over the espresso, forming light layers.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Holds the finished cup, takes a small sip, satisfied smile. "That's exactly what I needed."
→ (3s, final shot) Reaches toward camera, still holding the cup. "See you later." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural kitchen ambience — grinder whirring, tamping, steam hissing, milk pouring should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine focused smiles, occasional careful pauses while pouring, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright morning light shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal coffee vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial or AI-generated production.

Vibrant hot pink, electric blue, and silver color palette. 0–2s: Wide shot in a bright circular pink studio with reflective floor. Pink-haired woman (left) and black-haired woman (right) perform energetic opening pose and synchronized dance. 2–4s: Medium close-up of the black-haired woman on a blue spotlight stage, confidently pointing at the camera. 4–6s: Pink-haired woman dances before shimmering blue-silver tinsel curtains, dramatic hair flip and fluid arm movements. 6–8s: Back to the pink studio. Both perform synchronized choreography with sharp arm waves, hip sways, and strong formations. 8–10s: Extreme close-up of both faces against a blue background, glossy makeup, subtle smiles, and direct eye contact. 10–14s: Solo shots at the tinsel backdrop. Pink-haired woman mouths lyrics and gestures confidently, followed by the black-haired woman with relaxed jacket styling. 14–18s: Pink studio. Coordinated jacket choreography, hair flips, powerful synchronized dance, ending hands-on-hips. 18–22s: Glamour close-ups. Black-haired woman under glittering bokeh lights, then pink-haired woman with wind-blown hair against a soft pink background. 22–24s: Blue spotlight stage. Mirrored black-haired performer effect with synchronized spins and flowing hair. 24–26s: Both walk confidently toward the camera in front of shimmering tinsel curtains, reflections visible on the floor. 26–29s: Final synchronized dance and ending pose in the pink circular studio, standing together and looking into the camera. Style: Hyper-realistic live action, Seedance 2.5-quality motion realism, perfect lip sync, natural weight shifts, flowing hair, realistic fabric simulation, polished K-pop music video cinematography.

cases.title_en: Seoul Subway Revenge: Woman Throws Her Tormentor into a Bin
cases.description_zh: Don't F*** with her Made using Seedance 2.5 on @wavespeed_ai Prompt : Create a live-action cinematic revenge-comedy video set in a Seoul subway station. Use rea…
cases.author: AIwithSynthia
cases.prompt:
Create a live-action cinematic revenge-comedy video set in a Seoul subway station. Use realistic handheld camera movement, cold fluorescent lighting, teal-green accents, and real-time action.

A Korean woman in her 20s with a black bob, sunglasses on her head, a fitted crop top, high-waisted blue jeans, black boots, and a brown shoulder bag descends the subway stairs holding a takeaway coffee. A Korean man with messy dark hair and blonde tips, wearing a dark-green bomber jacket, suddenly hits her from behind and laughs as she stumbles against the handrail. Furious, she chases him onto the platform as he boards a train and mocks her through the closing glass doors.

She punches the glass, creating a dramatic crack and opening. As she confronts him, her coffee cup slips from her hand, falls to the platform, and spills visibly across the floor. She grabs his jacket, forcefully throws him through the air, and sends him crashing into a large metal rubbish bin. The bin rattles and wobbles as he lands inside, looking terrified and humiliated.

She leans toward him and says, "Don't mess around." She then calmly walks away while he remains stuck in the bin.

Maintain identical faces, hairstyles, outfits, and location throughout. Include realistic physics, expressive reactions, cinematic close-ups, subway ambience, and clear white subtitles. Keep the action non-gory, the coffee spill visible, and the final dustbin landing unmistakable.

cases.title_zh: Seedance 2.5 超真实 AI 动态桌面壁纸：换装互动女主一镜到底
cases.title_en: Seedance 2.5 Hyperreal AI Live Wallpaper: Outfit-Changing Heroine in One Take
cases.description_zh: 木马人（@cnyzgkc）揭晓一条引发 29 万次浏览的 AI 动态桌面壁纸视频由 Seedance 2.5 生成。作者在 @johnAGI168 的 prompt 基础上优化加料，完整复刻效果。Prompt 描述一段 29 秒固定机位超真实 AI 动态桌面互动视频：女主坐在黑色皮沙发上，根据画外男声指令换装三套学院风造型，全程一镜连续。Prompt 极其精
cases.author: cnyzgkc
cases.prompt:
时长29秒，比例16:9横屏，语言中文。
人物参考：仅参考图片1锁定五官、发型、肤色和人物身份；服装严格按下文变化。人物要求：成年女主。全程同一人物，不换脸、不改变身材比例；提高权重，优先死死锁住五官、发型、肤色、身份。

整体风格：超真实AI动态桌面互动视频，模拟电脑全屏桌面录屏。底部保留简洁任务栏，左上角少量桌面图标；画面主体是一张会实时互动的动态壁纸。黑色皮质沙发，冷色柔光，深色背景。固定机位，全程一镜连续，不切镜、不推拉。女主主要位于画面右侧，左侧留给语音字幕界面。

字幕界面（保留，覆盖「禁止文字」约束）：字幕必须出现于画面左侧中部，不能放在底部。纤细现代无衬线中文字体，中等字号，无底框，轻微柔光和阴影。女主说话：淡紫色文字，左侧显示扬声器图标。男声说话：白色文字，左侧显示麦克风图标。字幕下方始终有一条细小白色音频波形，随声音实时跳动。所有字幕跟随发音逐字输入，约每字0.08—0.12秒，像键盘正在手动打字；当前句说完后停留约0.4秒，再整体淡出。不能整句突然出现，不能提前显示后面的字。

服装设计（三套造型统一只改领口：低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余保持完整遮盖）：
初始造型：黑白横条纹修身短款七分袖上衣（低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余完整遮盖），黑色低腰抽绳休闲长裤，银色细项链。
第一套学院风：上衣为低圆领/浅V领、微露事业线、其余完整遮盖，蓝黑格纹百褶短裙，白色过膝袜，白色十字装饰袜带，整体清爽俏皮。
第二套学院风：黑色修身西装外套、白色衬衫（衬衫低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余完整遮盖）、酒红格纹领带、酒红黑色格纹百褶短裙、浅肤色薄丝袜、黑色乐福鞋，精致成熟。

SINGLE CONTINUOUS SHOT（00:00-00:29）

00:00-00:02.80
女主穿初始造型坐在黑色皮沙发右侧，腿上抱着黑色靠枕。她双手轻轻整理头发，随后看向镜头，露出亲切、略带俏皮的微笑。
女主自然开口：「说吧……今天想看什么？」
字幕逐字显示：「说吧……
今天想看什么？」

00:03.00-00:03.80
男主始终不露脸，仅有画外男声，语气直接而期待：「想看JK。」
女主安静听着，笑容稍微加深，轻轻点头。
字幕逐字显示：「想看JK」

00:04.70-00:06.00
女主爽快回答：「好，等我一下。」
她把怀里的靠枕放到一旁，右手撑住沙发准备起身。
字幕逐字显示：「好，等我一下。」

00:06.00-00:08.80
女主快速起身。由于机位固定且距离较近，她的腰部和腿部从镜头前向上掠过，脸部离开画面上沿；随后向右侧走出画面。动作带轻快的「嗖」声，但不能瞬移、不能直接变形。

00:08.80-00:11.50
换装完全在画外完成。沙发上多留约一秒空镜。伴随轻快的亮相音效，女主穿第一套蓝色学院风造型从右侧重新走入。她站得离镜头较近，画面主要呈现腰部、格纹裙摆和过膝袜，头部自然超出画面上沿。
女主带着展示新造型的俏皮语气说：「当当……老公……怎么样？」
字幕逐字显示：「当当……
老公……怎么样？」

00:11.70-00:12.50
男主画外音稍作思考，满意地回答：「嗯……不错。」
女主保持站姿，轻微左右转动腰身，让格纹裙摆自然摆动。
字幕逐字显示：「嗯……不错」

00:12.90-00:14.40
女主突然想起另一套造型，轻快地说：「等等，还有一套。」
说完立即转身向右侧离画，裙摆随动作摆动。
字幕逐字显示：「等等，还有一套」

00:14.40-00:17.40
换装完全在画外完成。沙发上多留约一秒空镜。随后响起一次短促流畅的换装「嗖」声，女主穿第二套酒红学院风造型从右侧走入。固定镜头先看到黑色西装下摆、酒红格纹裙、丝袜和乐福鞋，服装必须真实完整，不能在行走中融化或改变。

00:17.40-00:19.00
女主停在镜头右侧，略微调整站姿，让西装下摆和裙褶自然落下，询问：「这套呢？」
字幕逐字显示：「这套呢？」

00:19.50-00:20.50
男主画外音立即赞赏：「这套也好看。」
女主听完轻轻笑一下，身体开始降低准备坐下。
字幕逐字显示：「这套也好看」

00:20.50-00:24.80
伴随轻微衣料摩擦声，女主迅速而自然地坐回沙发。她将黑色靠枕重新放在腿上，整理两侧头发和领带，随后微微侧身靠住沙发。镜头重新完整拍到她的脸。她始终看着镜头，表情自信、亲近、略带捉弄感。

00:25.00-00:28.20
女主抱住靠枕，先露出得意的小笑容，然后对镜头说：「机会用完啦。老公想留哪套呢？」
「机会用完啦」语气像宣布游戏规则；「老公想留哪套呢」稍微放慢，尾音上扬，带亲密询问感。
字幕逐字显示：「机会用完啦。
老公想留哪套呢？」

00:28.20-00:29.00
字幕完整停留。女主保持眼神交流，轻轻偏头，嘴角维持俏皮微笑。波形逐渐归于平静，画面自然结束。

音频：女主真实现场人声，口型精确；男主为镜头外中文男声，不露脸。保留轻微电子氛围音乐（对白时自动降低，权重提高）、换装「嗖」声、亮相提示音、衣料摩擦声，所有对白清楚可辨。

表演约束：女主不是夸张卖萌。微笑、点头、整理头发、展示服装均自然克制；开场亲切，第一次换装俏皮，第二次换装更自信，结尾带轻微捉弄感。男声说话时女主必须闭嘴并自然聆听。

cases.author: Zarnab_with_Ai
cases.prompt:
Made with seedance 2.5

Prompt 👇 
Create a high-quality vertical 9:16 3D animated educational kids video in a bright, colorful, cute nursery-rhyme style.

Main character:
A cute adorable toddler boy, around 2 years old, with chubby cheeks, big expressive eyes, short light-brown hair, wearing a bright blue T-shirt with a playful “LOL Kids” style graphic and matching diaper/shorts. Keep the child’s appearance consistent throughout the entire video.

Environment:
A clean, bright indoor children's learning room with a glossy white floor, colorful geometric shapes scattered around the background, playful decorations, and a series of colorful doors. Use vibrant red, blue, yellow and green doors. Soft studio lighting, cheerful atmosphere, polished 3D cartoon animation, smooth reflections, high-quality Pixar-like children's animation aesthetic.

VIDEO SEQUENCE:

Scene 1 — A for Apple:
The toddler stands in front of a bright red door with a large bold yellow letter “A” on it. He reaches toward the door handle and opens the door with excitement. Behind the door is a colorful apple-themed environment with red apples. Show the text “A - APPLE” at the top. The child looks surprised and happy.

Scene 2 — B for Banana:
Cut to a bright blue door with a large yellow “B”. The toddler walks toward it, reaches for the handle and opens the door. Reveal a playful collection of bright yellow bananas behind the door. Display “B - BANANA” at the top.

Scene 3 — C for Cat:
Show a yellow/orange door with a large red “C”. The toddler opens the door and a cute friendly cat appears behind it. The child reacts with excitement and curiosity. Display “C - CAT”.

Scene 4 — D for Dog:
Show a red door with a large yellow “D”. The toddler opens it and reveal a cute friendly brown-and-white puppy standing behind the door. The puppy happily looks toward the child. Display “D - DOG”.

Scene 5 — E for Elephant:
Show a blue door with a large yellow “E”. The toddler opens the door and a cute baby elephant appears. The elephant playfully raises its trunk while the child reacts happily. Display “E - ELEPHANT”.

Scene 6 — F for Fish:
Transition to a bright underwater-themed aquarium area. Show colorful orange fish swimming inside a large glass aquarium. The toddler stands beside it and looks excitedly at the fish. Display “F - FISH”.

Scene 7 — G for Grapes:
Show a green door with a large yellow “G”. The toddler opens the door and discovers a huge bunch of shiny purple grapes behind it. He points toward the grapes with excitement. Display “G - GRAPES”.

Scene 8 — I for Ice:
Show a red door with a large yellow “I”. The toddler stands beside the closed door, reaches for the handle and opens it. Reveal a playful icy environment. Display “I - ICE”.

Scene 9 — J for Jelly:
Show a blue door with a large yellow “J”. The toddler opens the door and reveal colorful jelly/jelly dessert behind it. The child points toward it happily. Display “J - JELLY”.

Scene 10 — K for Kite:
Show a red door with a large yellow “K”. The toddler opens the door and reveal a colorful kite-themed scene. Display “K - KITE”.

Scene 11 — L for Lion:
Show a green door with a large yellow “L”. The toddler opens the door and a cute friendly cartoon lion appears behind it. The lion looks gentle and playful, not scary. The toddler reacts with excitement. Display “L - LION”.

Final scene:
Show a cute fluffy hamster waving goodbye to the camera in a bright pastel background. Add cheerful text:
“Bye-Bye 👋”
and a colorful kids-learning logo at the bottom.

Animation and camera:
Smooth toddler walking and reaching movements, natural hand interaction with every door handle, realistic door opening motion, expressive facial reactions, playful character animation, gentle camera movements, medium full-body framing, occasional slow push-ins, clean transitions between alphabet scenes, consistent character proportions, bright cinematic lighting, glossy 3D rendering, vibrant colors, soft shadows, highly detailed children'

cases.prompt:
Made with seedance 2.5

cases.author: sipteaandcoffee
cases.prompt:
Create a **45-second ultra-realistic personal home-video** of a young Korean woman going to a small neighborhood gym for a casual morning workout. Use the **attached image as the absolute character reference** and keep her face, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions and overall appearance consistent throughout.

The video should feel like a friend casually followed her to the gym with an **early-2000s consumer DV camcorder**. It should feel spontaneous, slightly awkward, playful and real — **not like a fitness advertisement or influencer workout video**.

Camera Settings: shot on 35mm film, anamorphic 2x squeeze, 2.39:1, oval bokeh, heavy grain,
halation on the bulbs. Focal length: 35mm. Aperture: f/2.0.
 
### CHARACTER & OUTFIT

She begins with her **long blonde hair worn loose**.

For the walk to the gym, she wears a casual oversized zip-up hoodie over her workout clothes and carries a small dark gym bag.

Inside the gym, she removes the hoodie and ties her hair into a **slightly messy high ponytail**.

Her workout outfit is:

- muted sage-green fitted short-sleeve athletic top
- loose black athletic track pants with a comfortable straight-leg fit
- gray-and-white training sneakers
- simple black fitness watch
- no jewelry
- minimal natural makeup

Keep this exact workout outfit consistent throughout the gym sequence.

She carries:

- dark gym bag
- translucent reusable water bottle
- small light-gray workout towel

### 00:00–00:06 — WALKING TO THE GYM

Open outside her home in soft morning daylight.

She steps through the door carrying her gym bag and starts walking through a quiet residential neighborhood.

The friend filming walks slightly behind her.

The camera shakes naturally with every step.

She turns around while walking backward for a moment and smiles at the camera.

**WOMAN, laughing:**
“Why are you filming already?”

The person behind the camera quietly laughs.

She shakes her head, turns around and keeps walking.

Cut to her approaching a modest neighborhood gym.

Before entering, she puts her bag down for a second and ties her long black hair into a messy high ponytail.

She looks at the camera.

**WOMAN:**
“Okay. Now I’m ready.”

She immediately laughs at herself.

### 00:06–00:12 — WARM-UP

Inside the gym, she removes her hoodie, revealing the **sage-green athletic top and loose black workout pants**.

She places her gym bag beside a bench, sets down her water bottle and towel and begins warming up.

Instead of ordinary stretching, show:

- shoulder rotations
- arm swings
- standing torso twists
- alternating knee raises

The camera awkwardly zooms toward her face.

She notices.

**WOMAN:**
“Don’t zoom in!”

She laughs and briefly covers the lens with her hand.

The camera pulls back.

### 00:12–00:20 — KETTLEBELL & STEP-UPS

She picks up a **light kettlebell** and performs slow, controlled kettlebell deadlifts.

Show realistic posture, grip, weight and breathing.

Cut to her performing **alternating step-ups onto a low padded exercise box**.

Her ponytail bounces naturally.

After several repetitions, she stops with her hands on her hips and exhales.

**WOMAN:**
“Why is this harder than it looks?”

She smiles breathlessly.

Small beads of sweat are beginning to appear around her forehead and hairline.

### 00:20–00:27 — RESISTANCE BAND

She places a resistance band around her thighs and performs **controlled lateral band walks** across the gym floor.

The friend filming follows her sideways.

She looks toward the camera while continuing.

**WOMAN:**
“My legs are already complaining.”

She laughs, loses her rhythm for a second, then continues.

cases.prompt:
Use @[char ref] as the exact character and style reference. Preserve her black hair and braids, oversized blue hooded jacket with cream graphics and orange trim, white cropped top, layered cream-and-orange pants, orange ribbons and white sneakers with black stripes and orange panels. Preserve her single sword with its black wrapped handle, gold guard and red tassel. Keep the same angular painterly anime rendering and blue background.

MAIN VISUAL GOAL:
An unmistakable OUT-OF-FRAME, POP-OUT effect. The character repeatedly projects beyond the central picture window, with her sword, hands, sneakers, hair and loose clothing visibly moving OVER the black letterbox bars toward the viewer.

COMPOSITING ORDER, BACK TO FRONT:
1. Background and scene.
2. Two broad black letterbox bars at the top and bottom.
3. The foreground character, including her sword, hands, sneakers and clothing.

The background is confined to the central picture window. The foreground character is NOT confined to that window. Her silhouette continues uninterrupted across its boundaries and onto the black bars. Blue sleeves, cream fabric, orange panels, sneakers and the silver blade remain fully visible when overlapping black.

STATIC BARS, MOVING CHARACTER:
Both bars are completely static screen graphics. Keep their equal thickness, full width and exact screen position unchanged throughout. Their inner boundaries remain perfectly straight and horizontal.

The character simply renders in front of them. Her movement temporarily hides portions of their black surface. The underlying bars never move or deform. Visible edge segments on either side of an overlap remain aligned on the same horizontal line. When she withdraws a limb, reveal the original unchanged black bar beneath it.

Keep black visible beside the overlapping body parts. No bending, sliding, shaking, stretching, opening or impact reactions in the bars.

The camera stays stationary with a fixed wide-angle lens. One continuous shot. She stays close and large in the composition, using short forward approaches, lateral pivots and compact recoveries. Never retreat deep into the background.

OPENING:
Already close to the viewer, she reaches toward the lens with her EMPTY hand while retaining the sword in her other hand.

Her fingertips visibly overlap the upper black bar. She makes one brisk diagonal lens-wiping gesture with her open palm, passing across the center and over the lower black bar. The hand and sleeve appear in front of both bars during the gesture. The bars remain unchanged beneath them.

The instant her palm clears the lens, she snaps into fast action without a pause.

CHOREOGRAPHY:
A diagonal sword slash passes close to the lens and visibly extends over the upper black bar. Reverse immediately into a tight turning cut. Her blue sleeve and loose cream-and-orange fabric sweep across the lower black surface.

She chambers a knee and fires a sharp FRONT KICK toward the viewer. The sneaker sole becomes large in the foreground and clearly overlaps the lower black bar, with black still visible beside it. Her shin connects continuously back to her body inside the central window. Retract immediately.

Plant the foot and pivot into a fast sword flourish crossing the upper bar. Continue into a compact SPINNING HEEL KICK. The sneaker sweeps close past the lens, its heel and sole projecting over the lower bar while her jacket and trouser fabric trail behind.

Keep alternating clear close-range overlaps: sword above the upper bar, sneaker over the lower bar, empty hand across a border, blue sleeve and cream fabric sweeping across black. Use fast connected combinations with crisp readable extensions and immediate recoveries.

Her clothing follows her body with strong momentum. Preserve the garment construction, patterned orange sections and cream folds. Fabric stays attached naturally and visibly covers the black surface without affecting its straight boundaries.

FINISH:
A final close-range sword extension crosses the upper black bar as her loose clothing flares over the lower bar. Resolve sharply into a confident martial-arts pose, retaining visible foreground overlap and quick natural follow-through.

The frame-break effect must come from the character visibly covering black areas outside the central picture window. Do not keep her entirely behind the bars. Do not simulate the effect by moving the bars or enlarging the window.

Fast real-time movement throughout, including the opening wipe. No slow motion, speed ramps, long windups or floating pauses. No camera movement, duplicated limbs or weapons, clothing morphing, text or background music. Sword whooshes, kick air bursts and fabric snaps only.

cases.description_zh: Seedance 2.5 Prompt: Main subject: young Indonesian woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded mustard-yellow
cases.author: RishuaVR
cases.prompt:
Main subject: young Indonesian woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded mustard-yellow oversized cotton t-shirt, brown high-waisted linen wrap skirt reaching just below the knee, simple brown leather slide sandals, thin gold stud earrings, dark wavy hair in a messy low bun with loose wispy strands framing her face. Realistic warm brown skin texture, minimal natural makeup, warm and approachable demeanor. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video.

Location: Authentic Indonesian residential neighborhood (gang) during a calm late morning. Narrow paved alleys, low-rise houses with open front terraces, terracotta roof tiles, potted frangipani and bougainvillea, laundry on bamboo drying racks, parked motorbikes along plastered walls, overhead utility wires, banana and coconut trees casting dappled moving shadows, quiet tropical residential atmosphere. No modern stores, billboards, cafés, or crowds.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion.

Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between harsh tropical sun and deep alley shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, warm faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.

00:00–00:02
Outside a small house entrance with an open terrace. She sits on the low terrace step adjusting her loose hair bun with both hands raised. A light warm breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to lock focus.

00:02–00:05
The camera follows her into a narrow alley lined with potted plants and plastered walls. She notices a neighborhood cat resting on a warm concrete ledge, crouches down, and gently pets it. Framing drifts off-center as the operator tries to keep up. Morning sunlight flickers through banana leaves overhead.

00:05–00:08
Small front terrace with a glass of sweet iced tea on a wooden stool. She sits relaxed on a plastic chair watching the quiet gang, casually brushing hair behind her ear. A motorbike passes slowly in the distant background. Handheld side angle with natural camera drift.

00:08–00:10
She turns toward the camera with a warm, genuine smile, gives a gentle nod of acknowledgement, then turns to walk down the tree-lined alley holding her iced tea. Recording cuts abruptly to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was switched off.

Audio: Hyper-detailed environmental ASMR binaural audio — crisp micro-sounds captured up close with high sensitivity. Crisp rustle of cotton fabric and linen as she moves, deep rhythmic cat purring vibrating close to the microphone, ice cubes gently clinking against the glass condensation, soft scuff of leather sandals on textured concrete pavement, dry banana leaves brushing together in the warm breeze, rhythmic faint sound of a sapu lidi broom sweeping fallen leaves nearby, water dripping into a terracotta gentong, distant gentle crowing rooster, faint muffled low-frequency hum of a passing motorbike down the alley. Pure natural foley textures, zero music, zero studio effects, zero narration, zero speech.

Goal: Authentic Indonesian neighborhood life captured like a forgotten home video from the early 2000s — candid, imperfect, realistic, warm, and deeply believable, with immersive environmental ASMR soundscape.

The camera moves naturally between people, capturing real candid moments. She looks back at the camera and smiles. 27-30s: Ending moment. Golden hour sunset. She sits near the ocean, holding a drink, watching the sunset. The camera slowly moves backward, revealing the beach, waves, and the peaceful evening. A feeling of a real personal travel memory. Visual style: Authentic travel vlog footage. Realistic smartphone or mirrorless camera look. Natural daylight. Casual handheld movement. Slight camera shake. Real human reactions. Documentary realism. No cinematic commercial look. No dramatic posing. No artificial transitions. No text overlays. No logos. No face changes. No identity changes.

cases.title_zh: 单人 K-POP MV · Y2K 糖果世界逐秒分镜
cases.title_en: Solo K-POP MV · Second-by-Second Y2K Candy World Storyboard
cases.description_zh: 一份 30 秒逐秒 K-POP MV 脚本：用音频时间码把舞蹈、口型、剪辑和场景全钉死在真实节拍上，主角锁脸锁服装贯穿六个 Y2K 场景，伴舞人数和位置逐段精确控制，翻盖手机合盖硬停收尾。
cases.author: aiwarts
cases.prompt:
使用@音频1《Zero to Pop》作为唯一音乐、节拍和口型依据，生成一支30秒、16:9、24fps的原创单人K-POP MV。

视频必须完整覆盖音频的0.00–30.00秒，不得截断、延长、变速或自动淡出。不要重新生成背景音乐，不要加入另一首歌曲。

全片只有@图1是主角和主唱。允许出现2—6名伴舞，但伴舞不能获得面部特写、不能对口型、不能遮挡主角或成为第二视觉中心。

主角的脸、发型、发色、身材比例、服装和饰品全程锁定。只有主角按照@音频1中的实际人声精确对口型；没有人声的段落保持闭唇表演。

【整体视觉】

高预算真人K-POP MV，结合Y2K未来主义、怪诞糖果世界和千禧年数字文化：

CRT电子宠物、透明翻盖手机、像素图标、果冻便利店、充气卧室、镭射洗车通道、巨型CD舞台、镀铬金属、透明塑料和CD彩虹衍射。

色彩以泡泡糖粉、电光蓝、蓝莓紫、酸性绿和镀铬银为主。

怪诞元素必须像真正搭建的实景、机械装置和高级视觉特效，不能像廉价AI拼贴、普通夜店或传统赛博朋克城市。

【主角造型】

主角穿原创Y2K未来女团服装：

银白色不对称短夹克、糖果粉亮片内搭、蓝紫渐变低腰工装裤、透明树脂腰带、镀铬圆环饰品、银白厚底运动鞋，以及一个迷你透明翻盖手机挂饰。

服装全程不变。金属、塑料、布料、头发和饰品必须表现真实重量、反光、惯性和自然摆动。

【音频同步原则】

歌曲约128 BPM，每个主节拍间隔约0.469秒。

最重要的画面锁点：

2.78秒：第一个强重拍，正式进入舞蹈。
6.06秒：第一次换景。
9.82秒：进入翻盖手机表演镜头。
12.63秒：进入第一段收束动作。
14.02秒：音乐明显降能量，切入失重卧室。
17.78秒：节奏重新启动。
21.07秒：高潮副歌和巨型CD舞台出现。
24.82秒：音乐突然抽空，伴舞冻结。
28.95秒：最后一句和最终特写。
29.90—30.00秒：翻盖手机合上，画面硬停。

所有剪辑、甩发、转身、手势、踩地、队形变化和摄影机冲击都必须落在@音频1的真实重拍上。

【逐秒镜头时间线】

0.00–0.47秒：

黑暗中出现一条细窄的CRT扫描线，随歌曲第一个电子启动声闪亮。

不要出现人物，不要添加片名或文字。

0.47–1.88秒：

扫描线展开为一台圆角CRT显示器。

屏幕内出现一只原创像素电子宠物。它随着音频中的电子声睁开眼睛，头顶依次跳出像素爱心、电池和小星星。

所有图标只使用抽象像素图形，不要出现品牌、角色或乱码文字。

1.88–2.78秒：

摄影机快速从CRT屏幕中后退，揭示完整的半透明粉色街机房。

主角已经站在CRT前，侧身背对镜头。摄影机停稳时，她缓慢回头，眼神锁定镜头。

她必须在2.78秒第一个强重拍准确击中开场姿势。

2.78–6.06秒：

低机位鱼眼单人中近景。

主角进入第一段独舞：按键式手指动作、肩部弹动、手臂波浪、髋部重心切换和一次快速半转。

所有动作根据@音频1逐拍执行，不要机械地平均分配动作。

主角按照实际人声自然对口型。背景CRT里的像素宠物同步模仿她的节奏，但不能变成人类或复制她的脸。

摄影机围绕主角移动约45度，同时缓慢推进。

6.06秒，主角手掌拍向镜头，形成遮挡式硬切。

6.06–9.82秒：

进入外星果冻便利店。

主角站在粉色自动传送带中央，4名伴舞从两侧货架后滑入，形成主角在最前方的V形队列。

五人完成连续行进编舞：两步滑行、交叉手臂、肩部撞击、一次同步下沉和快速回弹。

主角距离摄影机最近，服装颜色最鲜明，面部始终清晰。伴舞动作统一但幅度略小。

摄影机正面后退，与传送带保持相同速度。

9.82–12.63秒：

中长焦主角单人镜头。

伴舞退到背景并失焦。主角从货架上拿起一只巨大的透明果冻翻盖手机。

她对着手机完成歌曲中这一段的实际对口型，通过眼神和嘴角表现出俏皮、略带嫌弃的态度。

手机按键根据音乐节拍发光。摄影机在强音上做两次短促punch zoom，但不改变主角身份或面部结构。

12.63–14.02秒：

切回全身镜头。

主角把果冻手机抛向空中，4名伴舞重新进入队形。

全员在三个主要节拍上依次完成：

第一拍：双臂向外展开；
第二拍：快速转身并甩发；
第三拍：身体下沉后锐利定格。

主角踩亮地面上的圆形像素按钮。一道蓝紫色扫描光从脚底向上扫过所有人物。

14.02秒，音乐降能量的瞬间完成场景转换。

14.02–15.55秒：

进入淡紫色失重充气卧室。

画面由快速舞蹈突然转为稳定、梦幻的长镜头。主角坐在充气床边，房间和家具开始缓慢旋转，但主角仍保持正常垂直方向。

不出现伴舞。

摄影机缓慢靠近。主角根据实际音频进行克制、贴近耳语感的对口型，不做大幅度舞蹈。

透明枕头、小型CD和银色耳机线缓慢漂浮。

15.55–17.78秒：

主角从床边站起，向摄影机走来。

两名伴舞出现在旋转房间的左右墙面，制造重力方向错乱的视觉效果，但不能抢夺主角注意力。

主角伸手触碰一张漂浮的小型CD。CD逐渐膨胀为彩虹色圆形入口。

17.78秒节奏重新出现时，主角迈步穿过CD入口，摄影机紧随她穿过，形成无缝转场。

17.78–21.07秒：

进入镭射泡泡洗车隧道。

20.60–21.07秒之间，主角踢向一个巨大的透明泡泡。泡泡表面转化为CD彩虹纹理。

21.07–24.82秒：

进入巨型CD终章舞台，这是全片能量最高的段落。

一次同步旋转；
一次全身下沉；

24.82秒音乐突然抽空时，所有伴舞立刻冻结。

24.82–27.00秒：

主角继续保持运动，伴舞像卡顿的电子游戏角色一样定格在背景。

主角独自向摄影机走两步。画面根据音频中的断奏出现克制的数字卡顿效果：同一个动作短暂重复1—2帧，但主角面部保持稳定。

随着音乐继续变空，冻结的伴舞依次化为方形像素颗粒并消失。

主角不得消失、复制或变形。

27.00–28.95秒：

舞台上只剩主角。

画面运动变得极简，把注意力完全留给最后一句和主角表情。

28.95–29.90秒：

主角精确对口型歌曲最后一句。

她直视镜头，从冷静表情逐渐变成带有恶作剧感的轻微笑容。摄影机继续推进至面部特写。

只保留银粉色轮廓光和眼睛里的小型方形反光。

29.90–30.00秒：

主角"啪"地合上翻盖手机。

合盖动作必须与歌曲最终收尾音完全同步。背景灯光瞬间熄灭，画面硬切为黑色。

只允许主角对口型。口型必须依据@音频1中的真实语音和节奏生成，不要根据文字自行猜测，不要在纯器乐段随机张嘴。

主角在快速舞蹈时仍保持自然呼吸、面部肌肉运动和稳定身份。表情变化需要与音乐能量一致：

前半段俏皮、自信；
14.02秒后变得梦幻、克制；
17.78秒重新充满力量；
21.07秒进入主打歌级舞台状态；
24.82秒后变得冷静、带恶作剧感。

【硬性限制】

不得改变@音频1的速度、结构或长度。
不得加入新的背景音乐、对白或无关人声。
音效只能作为非常轻微的视觉反馈，不能覆盖原曲。
主角从第一帧到最后一帧必须保持同一张脸。
不得生成主角克隆体或第二名主唱。
伴舞最多6名，面孔必须互不相同。
禁止人物融合、额外肢体、畸形手指、脚底漂移、错误倒影、服装突变和随机换景。

cases.title_zh: 大学实验室感染失控，学生变成丧尸
cases.title_en: University Lab Infection Turns Students into Zombies
cases.description_zh: The College Lab Infection 🧟‍♀️ Seedance 2.5 on @wavespeed_ai Prompt: Create a photorealistic live-action zombie-horror sequence inside a modern university scie…
cases.author: AIwithSynthia
cases.prompt:
Create a photorealistic live-action zombie-horror sequence inside a modern university science laboratory during a normal college practical session. The central character is a young adult Korean female college student wearing a white laboratory coat over a simple shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing and body proportions identical throughout. Surround her with several college students, laboratory benches, microscopes, glass test tubes, chemical containers, computers and scientific equipment. Use realistic fluorescent lighting, practical effects, handheld camerawork and believable physics.

The students are quietly working on an experiment when a sealed glass specimen container suddenly cracks. A dark infected substance escapes and attaches itself to the young woman near her shoulder and neck. She stumbles backward in fear as dark veins slowly spread beneath her skin, traveling across her neck and face. Her fingers begin twitching, her body develops violent tremors and her skin becomes pale and clammy.

Her frightened expression gradually disappears. She raises her head and her eyes slowly transform into deep cloudy-black eyes. She suddenly turns toward a nearby classmate and charges. He desperately backs away behind a laboratory table while she repeatedly slams against it, moving with unnatural strength.

The other students freeze before scrambling toward the laboratory exit. The infected woman suddenly becomes completely still, then slowly rotates her head toward them. Her dark veins pulse visibly across her face while her black eyes remain fixed on the students.

Another glass specimen container cracks in the background. A second infected student suddenly collapses onto the floor, convulsing violently as dark veins spread across his neck and face and his eyes turn black. Panic erupts throughout the laboratory.

Students grab backpacks, chairs and laboratory equipment while trying to escape. One student pulls another toward the emergency exit as the infected chase them through the narrow aisles. A heavy laboratory table is pushed against the door as a temporary barricade.

The survivors finally reach the hallway and slam the laboratory door shut. Red emergency lights begin flashing as they catch their breath.

Inside the laboratory, everything becomes silent.

The camera slowly approaches the small observation window in the door. The infected female student stands motionless in the darkness, still wearing her white lab coat and jeans. Her pale face, prominent dark veins and completely black eyes are clearly visible.

She slowly tilts her head toward the window.

Then she suddenly smiles.

Cut to black.

AUDIO: Realistic laboratory ambience, fluorescent hum, glass cracking, equipment falling, footsteps, frightened breathing, screams, alarms, convulsions, impacts and distant banging. No music or exaggerated sound effects.

STYLE: Ultra-realistic college laboratory horror, practical-effects infection, realistic skin texture, believable anatomy, natural handheld camera, grounded movement, realistic facial transformation, dark spreading veins, black/cloudy eyes, violent convulsions and unnatural infected movements, cold fluorescent lighting transitioning into red emergency lighting.

NEGATIVE: Excessive gore, graphic dismemberment, graphic eye gore, anime, cartoon, illustration, plastic skin, fake CGI, duplicated students, face morphing, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, floating objects, impossible physics, changing clothes, inconsistent identities, subtitles, text, logos, watermark.

cases.prompt:
STYLE: Photorealistic live-action miniature-person FX, cinematic macro photography, ultra-shallow depth of field, realistic convenience store, dynamic handheld camera, dramatic practical lighting, realistic physics, detailed textures, premium viral commercial aesthetic, 4K.

Create a 30-second cinematic adventure featuring one athletic miniature woman at approximately 1 : 5 scale. Maintain her exact face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, backpack, and scale throughout.

She races across towering snack shelves, jumping over oversized packages and gaps. A giant candy box falls, creating an avalanche of rolling candies that she uses as stepping stones before landing on a massive chocolate bar. She climbs a huge drink bottle, runs up its curved surface, jumps over the cap, and lands on a hanging promotional display. She then rides a moving shopping cart through checkout, dodging the scanner and jumping onto the conveyor belt. At the refrigerated section, she runs across frozen-food packages, slides beneath a closing freezer door, and swings onto the display using the handle. Finally, she climbs onto a giant store sign and looks across the enormous store filled with products and shoppers as the camera pulls back to reveal just how tiny she is.

Use dynamic macro tracking, dramatic low angles, smooth aerial-style movements, strong foreground parallax, realistic reflections, shadows, depth of field, product packaging, natural human movement, believable physics, seamless transitions, and cinematic lighting.

End with the cinematic title: “SMALL SCALE. BIG ADVENTURE.” followed by “EVERY AISLE IS A NEW WORLD.”

SFX: Footsteps, packaging crinkles, candy rattles, plastic flexing, cart wheels, scanner beeps, conveyor hum, freezer sounds, rushing air, and cinematic impact.

NEGATIVE: No cartoon, anime, toy-like appearance, animation, duplicated character, face or outfit changes, distorted anatomy, floating, scale changes, narration, or subtitles.

三至四名朋友站在屋顶左侧，用手机拍摄并等待主角返回。不能抢占主体。

CAMERA CONTINUITY

全片为屋顶朋友手持手机拍摄的一镜到底。

摄影者先在主角身后跟拍助跑；主角跃下后，摄影者迅速冲到护墙边俯拍；随后镜头持续锁定主角，从垂直向下逐渐抬向天空；主角反弹回到屋顶后，镜头恢复平视。

不切镜、不瞬移、不更换视角。

STUNT ENGINE

动作闭环必须固定：

屋顶助跑 → 飞越护墙 → 高空下落 → 命中圆形弹性面中心 → 装置深度下陷 → 强力回弹 → 主角高速升空 → 空中团身翻腾 → 展体定位 → 双脚返回同一屋顶 → 屈膝落地 → 欢呼庆祝。

SHOT 1（00:00-00:10）高空反弹往返特技

Subject:
@图片1主角站在屋顶停机坪后方，正对远处护墙。朋友位于画面左侧拍摄。

Action:

00:00-00:01.50｜快速助跑

主角背对镜头，从停机坪中央快速冲向屋顶边缘。步幅逐渐加大，身体前倾，双臂自然摆动。

摄影者手持手机紧跟主角向前跑，画面产生真实脚步震动。朋友站在左侧举起手机，紧张注视。

00:01.50-00:02.30｜跃出屋顶

主角最后一步用力蹬地，身体越过低矮护墙。离开屋顶的瞬间，双臂向左右展开，身体稍微前倾，主动朝两栋高楼之间俯冲。

摄影者冲到护墙边，镜头快速向下俯转，始终把主角保持在画面中央。

00:02.30-00:04.80｜高空下落

镜头接近垂直俯拍。主角沿楼宇之间的空间快速下降，身体由前倾逐渐调整为面向下方，双臂保持展开以稳定方向。

随着主角下降，街道、车辆和十字路口迅速显现。巨型黑色圆形弹性装置从画面下方出现，彩虹灯环照亮周围建筑。

主角的下降轨迹必须准确对准黑色弹性面的圆心，不能偏向灯环或撞向建筑。

00:04.80-00:05.50｜命中中心

主角身体落在黑色弹性面正中心。弹性面受到冲击后明显向下形成深凹，彩虹灯环保持固定，装置不能破裂。

短暂压缩后，弹性面以巨大力量恢复原状，将主角垂直向上弹出。

必须清楚表现“接触—下陷—压缩—回弹”四个阶段，不能在接触前提前反向飞行。

00:05.50-00:08.20｜高速反弹与空中翻腾

摄影者仍站在屋顶护墙边。画面底部短暂出现摄影者的双脚，强化真实第一视角和高空距离。

主角从圆形装置中心高速升起，沿原来的垂直路线返回屋顶。摄影机从垂直向下持续向上抬起，跟随主角穿过城市楼宇之间的空间。

主角升空后收紧腰腹，双膝靠近胸口，双臂抱住小腿，形成紧凑团身，在空中完成连续快速翻腾。不要锁定具体翻转方向，以自然连续旋转为准。

主角接近屋顶高度时开始打开身体：松开双腿、抬起头寻找屋顶、双脚转向下方，双臂向两侧展开保持平衡。

00:08.20-00:09.40｜返回屋顶

主角高速接近镜头，从屋顶护墙外侧越回停机坪。双脚同时接触绿色地面，膝盖和髋部深度弯曲，以低位蹲姿吸收落地冲击。

落地必须具有明显重量：鞋底或脚掌接触、腿部压缩、身体下沉、轻微反弹恢复。不能站直着轻飘落地。

摄影者快速后退半步，避免主角撞上镜头，同时继续保持正面近景。

00:09.40-00:10.00｜真实庆祝

主角从蹲姿快速站起，兴奋地看向镜头，张口欢呼。屋顶朋友冲进画面，举着手机围过来，拍肩、挥拳、大声庆祝。

镜头因人群靠近产生轻微晃动，以真实手机自拍视频状态结束。

Environment:
高楼灯光、街道车辆和彩虹灯环保持空间位置稳定。下落和上升必须发生在同一条垂直路线，主角最后返回起跳的同一栋屋顶。

Camera:
24mm手机广角，一镜到底。开始为背后低位跟拍；跃下后变为越肩俯拍；回弹时由垂直俯拍连续抬升至仰拍；最后恢复平视近景。

Style:
真实夜间手机曝光，高楼具有准确透视和尺度。下落阶段风声增强，城市灯光形成自然运动拖影；主角返回屋顶时速度极快，但人体轮廓仍然清晰。

Constraints:
这是经过专业布置的虚构极限运动场景。必须完整显示圆形弹性装置承接并反弹主角，不能表现为无保护自由坠落。

主角下降和上升必须连续可追踪。回弹来自黑色弹性面的物理压缩，不是飞行、瞬移、绳索拖拽或超能力。

cases.author: techhalla
cases.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic daytime amusement park roller coaster, bright hard sunlight, strong wind, realistic motion blur on tracks and background, subtle handheld camera energy, rich skin detail, heavy natural film grain.

0-5s: [Medium Shot] A young woman in her early 20s sits in the front seat of a moving roller coaster car, calm and slightly bored, hair whipping in the wind. Beside her sits a middle-aged man wearing what looks like a normal full head of hair. Behind them, another car with a woman is visible. The coaster drops and banks hard.

5-9s: [Dynamic Tracking] The force of the turn rips the man's wig free. It peels off his bald head in a chaotic upward arc, spinning and flying backward through the air. The wig lands messily on the head of the woman in the car behind. Everyone's faces freeze in pure shock and confusion at the peak of the chaos. Time locks completely. Only the young woman in the front keeps moving.

9-15s: [Slow Orbital + Detail] Camera slowly orbits the frozen cars. The wig hangs mid-air in a twisted shape with individual hairs suspended. The bald man's scalp is fully exposed, mouth open. The woman behind is frozen mid-scream with the wig draped over her face. The young woman looks sideways, rolls her eyes and mouths "joder, otra vez". She reaches into her pocket, pulls out a stick of chewing gum, unwraps it and calmly puts it in her mouth, starting to chew while the entire frozen scene (except her) begins a precise reverse.

15-20s: [Medium Close-up] The rewind is controlled and elegant: the wig lifts off the woman behind, flies backward through the air in reverse, and returns exactly to the moment it is only beginning to peel off the bald man's head. Time freezes again at that precise instant — the front edge of the wig just lifting, a few strands already loose.

20-26s: [Tight Medium] Still frozen for everyone else, the young woman takes the chewed gum out of her mouth, reaches over and firmly presses it onto the center of the bald man's scalp, right under the lifting wig. With the same hand she smooths and presses the wig back down into perfect place, locking it with the gum. She sits back, looks straight ahead with a tiny private smile, completely unbothered.

26-30s: [Medium Shot] Time suddenly resumes at full real-time speed. The coaster continues its drop. The man touches his head, feels the wig still firmly in place, looks confused for a second, then breaks into a relieved, happy smile. The young woman stares forward, already chewing a new piece of gum, expression of quiet satisfaction.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed wind and hair physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

cases.prompt:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic 30-second vertical video using the provided girl reference image as the strict character reference.

Preserve her exact facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, age, and natural proportions throughout the entire video. Do not change her identity or facial features.

Character: The same woman from the reference image, wearing an elegant deep burgundy/red long-sleeve midi dress with a subtle vintage pattern, a matching belt, and elegant burgundy high heels. She carries a simple brown kraft-paper grocery bag containing a few visible groceries.

Shot 1 — 0–5 sec

Begin with a breathtaking aerial establishing shot high above the clouds. A gigantic, extremely tall, narrow rocky mountain spire rises vertically through a sea of white clouds. The peak is covered with patches of green vegetation, with a tiny charming house perched impossibly at the very top.

Slow cinematic drone movement toward the mountain. Bright blue sky, warm sunlight, soft atmospheric haze, realistic clouds, immense sense of scale.

Shot 2 — 5–10 sec

Cut to a close-up of the woman's feet as she carefully climbs uneven stone steps carved into the side of the mountain.

Her burgundy high heels step naturally from one stone ledge to another. The hem of her dress moves gently in the wind. Far below, clouds and the distant landscape are visible.

Use realistic foot movement, natural weight, physically accurate fabric motion, shallow depth of field, cinematic lens.

Shot 3 — 10–15 sec

Reveal the woman from a side/back angle as she continues climbing toward the summit.

She carries the brown grocery bag naturally in one hand. Her burgundy dress flows slightly in the strong mountain breeze.

The camera slowly tracks beside her, revealing the enormous drop and clouds stretching endlessly below. She remains calm and composed despite the surreal height.

Shot 4 — 15–20 sec

The woman reaches the tiny house at the summit and walks through its doorway while still holding the grocery bag.

Transition from the bright outdoor environment into a warm, cozy interior. Golden sunlight enters through the doorway. She walks naturally through the small home and places the grocery bag inside.

Maintain the exact same character appearance, dress, hairstyle, and proportions.

Shot 5 — 20–26 sec

Show the woman standing inside the cozy house beside a huge floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the clouds.

She pauses with a cup in her hand and looks peacefully toward the breathtaking view. The camera slowly moves backward, revealing the warm interior, wooden furniture, soft curtains, and the enormous mountain landscape outside.

Golden-hour lighting, subtle curtain movement, realistic shadows, cinematic atmosphere.

Shot 6 — 26–30 sec

Return to a spectacular wide aerial shot of the entire impossibly tall mountain spire rising above the clouds.

The tiny house is visible at the very top, emphasizing the incredible scale. Slowly pull the camera farther away until the mountain becomes surrounded by an endless sea of clouds.

End on a beautiful cinematic wide shot.

Visual style: ultra-realistic cinematic photography, premium film look, natural skin texture, realistic physics, realistic fabric and hair movement, volumetric sunlight, atmospheric perspective, detailed environments, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field where appropriate, high dynamic range, smooth camera motion, believable lighting.

Camera: cinematic drone shots, slow tracking shots, low-angle detail shots, gentle push-ins, smooth aerial pullback, realistic handheld micro-movements only when appropriate.

Important: Keep the woman's identity perfectly consistent across every shot. No face morphing, no character changes, no extra fingers, no distorted hands, no warped feet, no duplicated objects, no floating objects, no unnatural body movement, no cartoon or CGI appearance, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

cases.title_zh: Bladesmith Competition Reality TV Video
cases.title_en: Bladesmith Competition Reality TV Video
cases.description_zh: A realistic reality TV style video prompt showing a bladesmith testing a forged machete against ceramic gnomes with dynamic impact physics and documentary camera work.
cases.author: techhalla
cases.prompt:
Reality TV bladesmith competition testing segment, multi-camera documentary production, bright industrial workshop lighting, sharp HD broadcast look, practical forge practicals, natural handheld shake on action cams, clean documentary texture, no cinematic film look.

0-4s: [Medium Two-Shot] Martial arts master of clear Asian ancestry in black tactical shirt stands facing the young female bladesmith in her early 20s (work apron, focused). He holds her forged machete, turns the blade once under the lights. Looks her in the eye: “Are you ready?” She answers firmly “Yes.” Quick cut to her determined face, then to three classic ceramic garden gnomes lined up on sturdy stands behind them.

4-7s: [Low-Angle Tracking + Rapid Cuts] Master steps in, raises the machete. Hard cut to side angle as he delivers a powerful overhead chop into the first gnome. Impact explodes in slow motion: ceramic shatters into sharp fragments, paint chips and dust fly outward. Time locks at peak penetration. Camera orbits the frozen blade buried in the broken gnome for one second. Quick insert ECU of the edge biting through the ceramic body.

7-11s: [Dynamic Side Tracking] Action resumes. Master yanks the machete free, immediately follows with a heavy diagonal slash across the second gnome. Slow-motion again: the figure tears apart sideways, large colored pieces and shards scatter. Freeze at maximum destruction. Two rapid cuts: one over-shoulder from behind the master, one low angle under the flying fragments. Orbit holds for half a second on the locked impact.

11-15s: [Handheld Close Action] Third strike — short, vicious downward chop into the third gnome. Slow-mo impact, the ceramic erupts into dozens of pieces, hat and beard flying. Full freeze. Camera pushes in and circles the frozen chaos for one beat. Quick insert of the master’s focused face mid-swing, then back to the locked blade.

15-19s: [Series of Fast Cuts] Time resumes. Master pulls the machete out, turns it under the light. Tight ECU tracks along the edge: a few small nicks and rolled spots visible. Cut to his fingers testing the edge. Cut to the ruined garden gnomes still shedding fragments. Cut to the young woman’s tense expression as she watches.

19-24s: [Medium Close-Up] Master lowers the blade, looks straight at her. Calm, professional delivery: “There are a couple of nicks on the edge… but your weapon, ma’am… it kills.” Hard cut to her face — a small, controlled smile of pride breaks through.

24-28s: [Final ECU Montage] Extreme close-up of the nicked but still lethal edge catching the light. Cut to the shattered remains of the garden gnomes. Final frame holds on the young bladesmith’s quiet satisfaction as the master nods once.

Realistic TV broadcast quality, detailed ceramic shatter physics, sharp edge detail, natural motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, coherent impact timing, no artifacts, high rewatch value.
