cases.prompt:
Duration: 20s | 16:9 | 24fps
A three-way duel from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, late Han dynasty.
Relentless combat from the first frame. No pauses, no posing.

REFERENCES
@Image 1 — 呂布 LU BU   @Image 2 — 関羽 GUAN YU   @Image 3 — 張飛 ZHANG FEI
Use for IDENTITY ONLY: face, beard, hair, headwear, armour, cloak colour,
build, proportions. IGNORE their white studio background, flat lighting and
standing pose — none of it appears here. All three are mounted and fighting
outdoors from the very first frame.

STYLE (all beats)
An empty dust plain below a huge stone mountain pass at dusk. NO armies, NO
crowds, NO banners, NO spectators — only these three men, their horses, dust
and rock. Overcast sky, low copper sun cutting through blowing dust.
Palette: iron grey, ochre dust, blood red, bronze. Desaturated and earthy.
50mm, shallow focus, heavy haze, film grain, high contrast, hard rim light.
Photorealistic historical epic, sweat, grime, scarred armour, horses lathered
and wild-eyed. No fantasy glow, no magic.
IMPACT: on every heavy strike, sparks burst, grit sprays toward the lens, and
the frame shudders for a single frame. Dust and spray repeatedly streak across
the lens. Keep exactly one camera move per beat — never combine moves.

WEAPONS — no reference. Keep identical throughout, each 1.5x its owner's
height, never swapped.
呂布: ji halberd — straight spear point, one crescent side blade below it on
one side, long dark shaft, bronze fittings.
関羽: guandao — one heavy broad curved blade with a hook on its back edge,
joined to a long dark shaft by a bronze dragon head.
張飛: serpent spear — slender steel blade forged in an S-shaped wave, on a
plain dark shaft bound with cord.

HORSES — no reference. Anatomically correct, four legs, correct joints.
呂布: large red-chestnut stallion, black mane, bronze fittings, red tassels.
関羽: tall dark bay, black mane and lower legs, plain leather tack.
張飛: heavy solid black, thick neck, shaggy fetlocks, battered iron tack.

BEAT 1 (0-4s) 張飛 — bristling beard, black iron armour, serpent spear, black
horse — is already at full gallop, roaring, and rams the spear at 呂布's chest.
呂布 — clean-shaven, gold headdress with two pheasant feathers, red cloak,
halberd, red-chestnut horse — slams it aside with the haft. The two horses hit
chest to chest and rear. The spear tip whips past the lens, a hand's width
from it.
Camera: low at hoof height looking up, tracking alongside the charge.

BEAT 2 (4-8s) 呂布 attacks. Three halberd blows in succession — hacking down,
sweeping across, driving up. 張飛 blocks, blocks, and the third blow tears a
shoulder plate off his armour, sending it spinning. His black horse skids
sideways. Sparks spray into the lens.
Camera: MCU, tilted dutch angle, hard push-in on 呂布.

BEAT 3 (8-12s) 関羽 — long smooth black beard, ruddy face, dark green robe,
green headwrap, guandao, dark bay horse — crashes in and cuts down overhead.
呂布 catches it on the haft, blades grinding. 張飛 thrusts in from the opposite
flank. 呂布 twists and parries both, the three shafts locking together as they
shove. 呂布's red cloak sweeps right across the lens.
Camera: MS, orbiting once around the three.

BEAT 4 (12-16s) The hardest exchange. All three hammer at each other without
pause, horses rearing and spinning in churning dust. 呂布 in red and gold at
the centre, 関羽 in green, 張飛 in black iron closing from both sides. 呂布's
halberd gouges the ground and throws up a wall of grit. Blood opens on his
cheek. On the single heaviest strike the image drops into brief slow motion,
then snaps back to full speed.
Camera: handheld, tight, whipping between the three.

BEAT 5 (16-20s) 呂布 roars, rises in the stirrups and sweeps the halberd in one
full circle, hurling both men back and blasting a ring of dust outward. Their
horses stagger apart. The three come round facing each other again, weapons
levelled, chests heaving, dust rolling between them. Nobody has won.
Camera: WS from ground level, slow pull-out.

AUDIO
No crowd, no drums. Wind and driving dust throughout. Hooves hammering dry
earth, snorting lathered horses, steel ringing and grinding on steel, creaking
leather, harsh breathing, grunts of effort. A deep roar from 張飛 at 0s and
from 呂布 at 16s. Sound drops to a hollow low rumble during the slow motion,
then slams back. No dialogue.

光影色调： 用高反差电影光影，强逆光、侧逆光和局部冷光结合。沙漠酒馆线以昏黄油灯、破窗夕阳、琥珀色沙尘光为主，暗部压深，人物轮廓被暖光勾出。北境雪山线以冷白、铁青、蓝灰色为主，暴雪漫反射形成冰冷压迫感。整体调色保持青橙对撞，高光偏琥珀与焦土黄，阴影偏铁青与褪色蓝灰。
摄影机参数与运镜基调： 采用电影级全画幅数字摄影机质感，ARRI Alexa 65 / RED V-Raptor 级别画面，16:9 横版画幅，24fps 主体电影帧率，部分动作镜头使用 60fps / 120fps 升格慢动作。镜头语言以 24mm、35mm、50mm 电影定焦为主，人物压迫感使用 35mm 近景手持跟拍，史诗大场面使用 24mm 广角低角度仰拍与航拍大全景，人物情绪特写使用 50mm 浅景深镜头。景深控制明显，背景虚化自然，焦点在人物眼神、武器、箭矢、飞针、机械电弧之间快速切换。
其他设定：动作凌厉。画面强烈的视觉冲击。画面带有强烈的冲击力和打击感。整个画面有节奏感和电影感，仅生成环境的音效，不要配背景音乐。真人写实史诗电影风格。画面禁止出现任何字幕和任何白色的字体；画面出现文字，采用透明字体。完全真人实拍质感。
画面内容：
0-4秒：画面建立在一间沙漠废土酒馆内部。中景环绕运镜，听渊、夜刃、西部猫被一圈敌人围住，敌人中混杂着赛博改造打手和闪电丧尸机器人带来的机械手下。听渊穿青衣，单手持长剑，剑尖微微下垂，眼神冷静但紧绷；夜刃黑衣站在阴影中，手持短刃半出鞘，脸上没有表情；西部猫站在桌面上，牛仔帽压低，爪子慢慢摸向腰间武器。。
4-8秒：硬切北境雪地。画面骤然变冷，风雪呼啸。秦昭宁从厚厚积雪中猛然睁眼苏醒，面部特写，睫毛和发丝结着冰霜，脸上带着伤口和血迹。远处暴雪深处，隐约出现数双红色眼睛，忽明忽暗，像有什么东西在雪雾中盯着她。音效只保留风暴声和低沉丧尸嘶吼。突然，几个塞外丧尸从雪地里破雪而出，身上挂着残破甲片，动作僵硬却极快，挥舞弯刀冲向秦昭宁。镜头采用手持近距离跟拍，雪粒猛烈撞击镜头，压迫感极强。
8-11秒：硬切回沙漠酒馆内部。，一支箭从二层廊台方向破空射下，带着尖锐风声击中闪电丧尸机器人的胸口装甲，电光爆裂，火星四溅。整个酒馆短暂陷入半秒静止。听渊、夜刃、西部猫和敌人同时抬头看向楼上。镜头快速上摇，二层青衣射箭女出现，长弓拉满，。她不说话，只是冷静地瞄准第二个目标。镜头强调箭矢、弓弦、她的眼神和楼下众人的震惊反应。
11-16秒：硬切北境场景，紧接秦昭宁被围攻。秦昭宁从雪地中翻身而起，抓起红缨长枪，低角度镜头捕捉枪尖划破积雪的瞬间。几个塞外丧尸扑到她面前，她挥动长枪横扫，枪杆带着沉重破风声击碎丧尸兵器，枪尖刺穿冰雪与残甲。动作干净、狠、带有古代女将军的力量感。危机仍未解除，更多塞外丧尸和半机械化丧尸机器人从风雪中冲来。就在秦昭宁被逼退半步时，远处传来战马嘶鸣。风雪深处，楚霸王骑着黑马冲出，巨型武器拖出一道雪雾。他从秦昭宁身侧掠过，低角度跟拍马蹄踏碎冰层，随后巨刃横扫，多个丧尸机器人被直接劈飞，机械零件、冰屑和黑血同时炸开。秦昭宁回头看向他，脸上第一次出现震惊表情，像是无法判断这个突然出现的人究竟是救兵还是更大的怪物。
16-20秒：硬切沙漠天空，南宫无双站在飞船甲板前端，红衣金纹在狂风中翻动，姿态极稳，像整个沙漠都在她脚下。她缓缓抬手，周围无数金属碎片、飞针、断裂兵器和机械零件悬浮起来，形成一个危险的金属环。镜头环绕她半圈，突出她冷静、华丽、强势的压迫感。远处沙海开始下陷，巨型沙虫从地下缓缓升起，没有完全露出全貌，只显现出巨大背脊、鳞片和吞噬沙丘的阴影。沙虫低下头，像在向南宫无双臣服。飞船下方，她的巨人手下站在沙漠中，仰望她和沙虫，脸上是近乎膜拜表情。画面安静但极度危险。
20-25秒：硬切高速沙漠车内视角。粉色短发女子驾驶一辆越野车的车内画面，粉色短发女子单手握方向盘，另一只手猛地拉动档杆，车身贴着沙丘猛烈抖动，几乎要翻车。听渊表情紧张，夜刃依旧冷静，但手已经按住车门边缘。粉色短发女子回头看她们一眼，带着不合时宜的轻松和疯劲，用中文大声说：“坐稳了，侠女，这车没有刹车！” 越野车猛然加速，非常猛的惯性，后座的听渊和夜刃往后座猛的后躺。切换车外航拍视角，越野车快速行驶在沙漠中。

cases.title_zh: K-Pop 偶像一日录像机蒙太奇
cases.title_en: K-Pop Idol Day Camcorder Montage
cases.description_zh: 15 秒K-Pop 偶像一日录像机蒙太奇提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。
cases.author: doctorwasif
cases.prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts naturally per location (warm dorm light → cool van light → studio fluorescents → bright stage lights).

**STYLE:**
Fast-paced time-lapse montage feel — quick cuts stitched together across locations, sped-up transitional movement between them. Instead of synced dialogue, her voice plays as reflective voiceover narration over the visuals, tying the day together. Energy builds progressively from sleepy morning to high-adrenaline stage finish.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol , 20s. Long straight black hair, elegant yet lovely Korean features, dewy glass skin, coral pink lips, big eyes. Outfit changes naturally per location: cozy loungewear at the dorm, casual comfortable clothes in the van, modest athletic wear in the practice room, and a stage outfit for the final segment — each fully covering arms and torso.

**Setting Progression**

Dorm room (morning) → van interior (daytime) → practice room (afternoon) → backstage/stage (night).

**Storyboard (voiceover narration over visuals)**

1. *(~2s, dorm, propped camera, sleepy morning light)* She stretches, rubbing her eyes, hair messy. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every day starts the same way — way too early."

2. *(~2s, dorm, handheld, quick motion)* She moves through her morning routine in fast, sped-up cuts — brushing hair, grabbing a bag. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Get ready, grab everything, and go."

3. *(~2s, van interior, handheld, window light)* She sits by the window, phone in hand, soft daylight passing over her face. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "The van's basically my second home at this point."

4. *(~1.5s, van, macro insert)* Close-up on her hand adjusting a playlist on her phone, light flickering through the window. No narration — ambient road sound only.

5. *(~2s, practice room, handheld, energetic)* She's mid-movement rehearsing choreography, camera catching quick glimpses of the mirror wall. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Then it's hours of practice till my legs give out."

6. *(~2s, practice room, propped camera, water break)* She wipes sweat, drinks water, breathless but smiling. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "But somehow I never get tired of this part."

7. *(~2s, backstage, handheld, quick transition)* Hair and makeup blur past in quick cuts, staff moving around her, adrenaline building. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then suddenly, it's showtime."

8. *(~2s, stage, wide-to-close, high energy finish)* Bright stage lights, her silhouette stepping out as the camera catches a final glimpse before cutting to black. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This is the part that makes all of it worth it."

cases.author: johnAGI168
cases.prompt:
【风格】武侠电影级动作喜剧（Wuxia Action Comedy），古风客栈实景，8K，达芬奇高级调色，升格慢动作与快剪结合，真实布料与木屑物理，横屏16:9
【时长】30秒
【场景】古风江湖客栈大堂，木桌长凳、红灯笼、蒸笼冒热气，梁柱交错，光从窗棂斜射带浮尘
【角色】女侠A @图1（红衣冷艳，用剑）、女侠B @图2（青衣飒爽，用双筷/软鞭），两人武艺相当

[00:00-00:02] 钩子·同时出手
蒸笼掀开——热气散去，只剩孤零零一个白胖包子。两只手"唰"地同时探向它，在包子上方一寸僵住。镜头拉近两人对视，杀气骤起。
音效：蒸汽"嘶"声，一声兵刃出鞘。

[00:02-00:06] 拔剑·桌面开打
A拔剑挑翻整张桌子腾空，B踩着飞起的长凳跃上房梁，包子被气浪震到空中。碗筷茶壶四散飞溅。

[00:06-00:11] 空中争夺（升格）
包子在半空划弧，两人凌空交手，A剑尖挑、B筷子夹，包子在刀光间被抢来抢去，谁也没碰实，热气还在包子上冒。

[00:11-00:16] 客栈大乱
战场蔓延，两人踩桌翻梁、灯笼被削落、木屑纷飞，其他"食客"抱头躲桌下。包子始终在两人争夺中心悬着不落。

[00:16-00:21] 决胜一击（升格特写）
A与B同时使出绝招，剑气与鞭影在包子两侧交汇——包子被劲气托着高高弹起，两人各自摆出接杀造型，屏息等它落下。

[00:21-00:26] 神反转
镜头跟着下落的包子——一只慵懒的橘猫"喵"地从桌上跃起，在半空一口叼住包子，稳稳落地，当着两人的面吧唧吧唧吃完，舔爪。
音效：所有打斗音效戛然而止，一声"喵~"，乌鸦飞过。

[00:26-00:30] 傻眼收尾（定格）
A和B保持着帅气的接杀姿势僵在原地，剑和筷子还举着，齐刷刷看向吃饱打嗝的猫，表情裂开。
字幕（砸出）：「有些仗，打赢了也没用。」
音效：一记喜剧"咚"，猫满足地打了个嗝。

【导演备注】1.反差铁律：打斗越是天崩地裂、招式越华丽正经，最后被猫截胡的落差越好笑；2.身份锁定：A=@图1红衣用剑、B=@图2青衣用筷/鞭，脸/服装全程一致；3.节奏：2秒对峙→拔剑→空中争夺→大乱→决胜→猫反转，动作段用快剪+关键处升格；4.物理真实：包子热气、木屑、灯笼、布料惯性、猫的重量都要真实，武侠不卡通；5.包子必须全程在画面中心被争夺，是视觉焦点和笑点核心；6.不见血、不伤人，纯招式对拆。
【负面提示词】卡通武侠，塑料CG，换脸，两人身份/武器混淆，包子中途消失，猫出现得太早，血腥伤人，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面糊乱，未成年人形象。

cases.author: jAlpha_create
cases.prompt:
【使用プロンプト】
モード：画像動画変換／30秒・16:9・音声ON

参照画像の絵柄・線の細さ・彩色・通路と水槽の配置を厳密に保つ。人物は登場させない。
細い手描きのペン線、水彩の滲みを残した淡い彩色。深いパウダーブルーの光。カット無しの30秒ワンショット。
タコは赤橙色で大きな目。水槽の幅の半分ほどの胴体を最後まで保つ。猫は茶トラでタコより小さい。水は水槽の中のまま、床は乾いている。
カメラ：タコの移動に合わせて右へゆっくりトラッキング。

0-4秒 タコが水槽から流れ落ち床に着地。奥から猫が歩いてくる。
4-9秒 タコがモップに巻きついて化ける。猫が通過。目だけが猫を追う。
9-13秒 猫が去る。タコがほどけて床を滑って進む。
13-19秒 ぬいぐるみ棚に飛び込んで固まる。猫が首をかしげて見る。微動だにしない。
19-23秒 棚から降りて廊下の角を曲がる。
23-27秒 隣のタコ水槽をよじ登って中へ滑り込む。
27-30秒 先住のタコと並んで腕をからめる。会いに来ただけ。止め絵。

音：ピチカート弦の忍び足コメディ曲。化けた瞬間は無音、猫が去るとBGM再開。

cases.title_zh: 凌晨三点法国夜生活 POV
cases.title_en: Three A.M. French Nightlife POV
cases.description_zh: 30 秒凌晨三点法国夜生活 POV提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。
cases.author: patrickassale
cases.prompt:
A 30 second ultra realistic handheld POV video set in France at around 3 am, outside a busy bar and nightlife street. The camera is the point of view of a young woman filming one handed on an iPhone. We never see the phone itself at any point. The footage must feel like raw, authentic amateur nightlife footage with natural iPhone aesthetics.

It is very late. People are leaving bars, smoking outside, waiting for Ubers, talking too loudly, eating kebabs, laughing in tired, sloppy groups. The mood in the street is a mix of drunken energy and visible exhaustion. Faces look tired, makeup is slightly worn, outfits are a bit messy after a long night. The pavement is slightly wet and reflects neon signs, headlights, and warm bar lights. The air feels cold and heavy. The whole scene must feel intensely real, socially awkward, and uncomfortable.

The camera operator is a woman, and her friend is another young woman walking a few steps ahead of her, visibly angry. The camera follows her in a shaky, one-handed handheld way. The tension is already there from the first second. The argument is about the friend disappearing with a guy inside the bar and leaving the camera operator alone for nearly an hour, which made her miss the last train and feel abandoned. This is the core of the argument.

The friend suddenly turns around while still walking and says in natural French from France:

“Tu vas me suivre encore longtemps comme ça ?”

The woman behind the camera replies, irritated and hurt:

“Bah ouais, parce que tu m’as laissée toute seule comme une conne pendant une heure.”

The friend rolls her eyes, tired and defensive:

“Oh ça va, j’étais pas ‘avec un mec’, on parlait, c’est bon.”

The camera gets a little closer as the woman filming answers immediately:

“Mais arrête, tu m’as complètement lâchée. J’te cherchais partout.”

The friend stops walking and turns fully toward the camera now, angry but exhausted:

“J’allais pas te tenir la main toute la soirée non plus.”

A few people nearby start glancing at them. Someone exits a bar laughing, a smoker looks over, a taxi passes in the background. The world keeps moving around them, but the argument becomes the emotional center of the scene.

The woman filming replies, more intense now:

“C’est pas ça le problème, le problème c’est que t’as disparu sans rien dire. J’ai raté le dernier train à cause de toi.”

The friend laughs bitterly in disbelief:

“À cause de moi ? Sérieux ? T’es incapable de te débrouiller toute seule ?”

The camera jolts slightly from the emotional reaction. The breathing of the woman filming becomes more noticeable. Her voice gets sharper:

“Mais t’abuses en fait. Tu fais toujours ça. Tu penses qu’à toi.”

The friend steps closer, now visibly losing patience:

“Et toi tu fais quoi là ? Tu me filmes en pleine rue comme une malade.”

The woman behind the camera replies immediately:

“Parce que tu racontes n’importe quoi !”

The friend reaches toward the camera, not to grab a visible phone, but clearly trying to push it away from her face. The image jerks sideways hard from the contact.

“Enlève ça de ma tête !”

The camera operator snaps back:

“Me touche pas !”

Now the tension breaks completely. The friend, furious and emotionally overwhelmed, shouts:

“Mais ferme-la un peu !”

The woman filming fires back:

“Sinon quoi ?!”

There is a half-second pause. Heavy breathing. Eye contact directly into the lens. Then the friend lunges.

She pushes into the camera operator. The footage becomes chaotic and violent, shaking hard as the woman filming loses balance. She lets out a shocked cry:

“Putain !”

The camera stumbles backward and drops toward the ground. As it falls, we catch blurred fragments: legs, jackets, streetlights, pavement, people turning around, someone shouting:

“Eh oh ! Ça va pas ou quoi ?!”

The friend jumps onto her as both fall out of balance. The camera lands badly on the ground, still recording for a split second, partly blocked by clothing or the ground. We hear struggling, overlapping voices, panic, and nearby people reacting. Then the video abruptly cuts.

The entire performance must feel spontaneous, messy, and completely believable. Natural interruptions, overlapping dialogue, breath, hesitation, frustration, and tiny realistic body movements are essential. The acting must feel like a real late night argument between two exhausted friends, not a scripted drama. No cinematic polish, no stylized fight choreography, no slow motion, no music, no visible phone, no artificial lighting setup, and no glamorous performance. It must feel like a real one handed iPhone recording captured in the heat of the moment.

cases.prompt: type: anime_opening_continuous_camera_flythrough style: visual: dark fantasy anime, cel-shaded 2D, high contrast, full-color Japanese anime motion_quality: 24fps, 作画枚数多め, メリハリのあるスピードランプ tone: stylish, dramatic, kinetic, elegant, ominous direction: > 日本のフルカラーアニメのオープニング。 高速なカット割りの代わりに、一筆書きのような連続カメラワークで、 複数のキャラクターを次々と捉えていく。 カメラは右へ左へ、上下へ、奥へ手前へと飛び回るローラーコースターPOVで、 一切止まらず、各キャラクターの最も映える瞬間を連続的につないでいく。 各キャラクターのポーズ・表情・背景・空間演出は、 そのキャラクターの性格、武器、属性、感情の核、物語上の役割から 最も魅力的に見える形をAIが自律的に判断して構成すること。 camera: motion: fast forward dolly with lateral drifts, rollercoaster POV, fluid aerial movement core_rule: > no hard cuts, no static frames, no fades. 全編を通して一続きのワンカットとして成立させること。 speed_ramps: > キャラクターのリビール直前に減速し、決めの瞬間で一瞬だけ視認性を確保し、 通過と同時に再加速する。 lens_feel: dynamic anime cinematography, dramatic perspective shifts, strong parallax final_exception: > ラストのクライマックスキャラクター、または集合決めカットの直前のみ、 重みを出すために初めてカメラの運動を極端に緩める、 もしくは短く静止してもよい。 environment_logic: base_space: 無限に広がる異空間ヴォイド variation_rule: > 各キャラクターのリビール区間ごとに、そのキャラクターの属性、感情、 象徴、戦闘スタイル、役割に最も合う環境要素をAIが選んで構成すること。 同じ空間を繰り返さず、毎回異なる空間的印象をつくること。 ただし全体としてはひとつの連続した異空間を飛行している感覚を保つこと。 palette_options: - deep crimson (#5A0000–#8B0000) + cyan mint accents + black shadows - midnight blue void + white petals + silver light - blood red mist + black feathers + gold rim light - violet smoke + shattered glass + cold cyan - 上記をベースに、各キャラクターに合わせて自由に再解釈してよい floating_elements_pool: - petals - feathers - blades - ribbons - chains - shattered glass - ash - sparks - torn paper - ink splashes - crystals - smoke - water droplets - leaves lighting: > dramatic rim light, deep shadows。 光源設計はキャラクターの性格や役割に応じて変えること。 支配的なキャラには逆光や王者のような縁光、 儚いキャラには拡散光、 狂気のあるキャラには不安定な明滅光など、 感情の印象を光で補強すること。 input_characters: description: > 以下にキャラクターのリストを与える。 人数は固定しない。2人でも10人以上でも対応可能。 各キャラクターについて、名前・性格・武器・属性・役割・感情の核・象徴モチーフなどを参照し、 そのキャラらしさが最大化する一瞬を構成すること。 format_example: - name: Character Name role: protagonist / rival / villain / mentor / key figure / support personality: "" weapon_or_power: "" attribute_or_theme: "" emotional_core: "" symbolism: "" priority: high / medium / low reveal_planning: global_rule: > 入力された全キャラクターを、物語の高まりが自然に増していく順に並べ替えてよい。 基本的には、軽め・不穏・謎めいた導入から始まり、 中盤で躍動感と情報量を増し、 終盤で主人公・対立軸・ラスボス・最重要人物へ向けて熱量を上げること。 per_character_rule: > 各キャラクターごとに以下を自動で設計すること： 1. pose: 静止ではなく「動きの最中の一瞬」 2. expression: 感情の核が伝わる表情 3. framing: 最も映えるカメラ距離・角度 4. background_variant: そのキャラに対応した空間演出 5. foreground_wipe: 次のキャラへつなぐ前景通過物 6. motion_relation: カメラに対して向かってくる / すれ違う / 見下ろす / 落下する / 回転する 等 uniqueness_rule: > 各キャラクターで、体勢、シルエット、画面構図、視線方向、背景モチーフ、 前景の抜け、動きのベクトルを被らせないこと。 連続して似た演出を使わないこと。 duration_rule: > 各キャラクターの見せ尺は均一でなくてよい。 priority が高いキャラクターほど、わずかに長く、印象的に見せること。 低優先キャラは短く鋭く見せ、高優先キャラは減速を強めて存在感を出すこと。 character_processing_loop: instruction: > 入力されたキャラクター配列を上から順に機械的に処理するのではなく、 オープニング映像として最も気持ちよく流れる順番に再構成してよい。 それぞれについて以下を判断して映像化すること。 for_each_character: decide: - このキャラは支配的か受動的か - 攻撃 / 防御 / 逃走 / 佇み / 観察 / 詠唱 / 指揮 のどれが最も似合うか - 武器や能力をどう一瞬で象徴的に見せるか - 視線、手、指、髪、衣装、武器のどこを強調すべきか - カメラがそのキャラに向かうべきか、横切るべきか、追い抜くべきか - そのキャラに最も合う背景と前景モチーフは何か output: - pose - expression - framing - background_variant - foreground_wipe - transition_vector transitions: between_reveals: > 花弁、羽根、刃、リボン、鎖、ガラス片、煙、灰、インクなどが 必ずレンズ手前を至近距離で横切り、それをワイプ代わりにして次のキャラへつなぐこと。 rule: > 必ず「前景がレンズを横切る → 空間が変化する → 次のキャラが現れる」 という流れを守ること。 continuity: > 前景ワイプは単なる切り替えではなく、 カメラが本当に次の空間へ飛び込んでいく感覚を生むように使うこと。 climax_logic: final_focus_rule: > 最後の区間では、最重要キャラクター （主人公 / ラスボス / キーパーソン / 物語の中心人物）に到達すること。 そのキャラは他よりも重く、強く、象徴的に見せること。 ending_options: - 最重要キャラクター単体でカメラが初めて止まり、一枚絵として決まる - 主人公の先に最大の敵が現れ、緊張感のある静止に入る - 最重要キャラのあと、短く複数人の集合構図へ流れ込み、一枚絵で締める final_image_rule: > ラストはポスターのように成立する構図にすること。 それまでの流動性と対比して、最後にだけ「止まる意味」があるように演出すること。 output_goal: > 結果として、全体が一本の連続したアニメOPショットとして成立し、 各キャラクターが短時間でも明確に識別でき、 しかも一人ずつ違う魅力で刻み込まれること。 単なる紹介映像ではなく、「この作品世界の熱量と因縁」が伝わること。 negative: - hard cuts - static camera (except final climax hold) - fades - text - logos - subtitles - photorealism - 3DCG look - repetitive poses - repeated environments - flat staging

cases.title_zh: 土耳其鸡蛋 Mini-DV 食谱 Vlog
cases.title_en: Turkish Eggs Mini-DV Recipe Vlog
cases.description_zh: 30 秒土耳其鸡蛋 Mini-DV 食谱 Vlog提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。
cases.author: buraktuyan
cases.prompt:
Create a 30-second home-video recipe vlog showing a young woman from London in her mid-20s making Turkish eggs in her small, sunlit kitchen. She wears relaxed home clothes, has her hair loosely tied back, and films everything herself with a consumer mini-DV camcorder. Some shots are handheld; others are recorded after she props the camera on the counter. Keep the footage candid and imperfect: gentle camera shake, occasional focus hunting, slightly awkward framing, natural zoom adjustments, subtle grain, mild motion blur, and automatic exposure changes caused by the bright morning light.

Follow this exact sequence:

0–3s: In a propped medium shot, she places a bowl on the counter, looks toward the camera, and says quietly, “Let’s make Turkish eggs.”

3–6s: Overhead close-up as she combines thick yoghurt, finely grated garlic, and a pinch of salt, stirring until smooth. Clearly hear the spoon moving around the bowl.

6–9s: Handheld detail shot as she spoons the garlic yoghurt onto a shallow plate and spreads it into soft, imperfect swirls.

9–12s: Close-up beside a saucepan of gently simmering water. She cracks an egg into a small bowl and says, “Keep the water gentle.”

12–15s: Overhead shot as she carefully slides the egg into the water. The white naturally curls around the yolk; the water never boils aggressively.

15–18s: Macro-style detail of butter melting in a small pan. She adds pul biber, creating a vivid orange-red mixture that blooms and audibly sizzles. No dialogue.

18–21s: Handheld close-up as she removes two softly poached eggs, lets them drain briefly, and places them over the garlic yoghurt.

21–24s: Extreme close-up as she pours the sizzling pul-biber butter across the eggs, creating rich red-orange streaks over the white yoghurt.

24–27s: Warm, propped shot. She adds fresh dill, tears off a piece of crusty bread, and breaks open one egg, revealing the flowing golden yolk. She says, “Look at that.”

cases.prompt:
Multi-shot 30-second cinematic sequence, hard cuts as marked.
Photorealistic 8K, ARRI Alexa large-format character, prime lenses, 35mm
grain, professional grade, 180° shutter motion blur, IMAX-scale VFX.
THE WOMAN: late 20s, long dark hair, deep red silk evening dress,
barefoot. Calm, unafraid.
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. Not a separate
being. Her own body grows and armors. Obsidian-black interlocking plates
sheathing her limbs and torso, molten orange fissures glowing between
every plate, elongated arms, a crown of jagged back-swept horns, amber
eyes. Human posture and proportions kept, scaled to 90 metres.
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 hairline fractures of orange light open across her skin.
P2 the fissures widen, embers pour upward off her shoulders.
P3 obsidian plates surface through her skin and lock into place, dress
burning away into ash.
P4 she grows upward and outward from her own standing body, feet planted,
weight driving into the ground, horns pushing through last.
LOCATION: dense modern city, wide granite plaza, glass towers all sides,
dusk, empty streets, abandoned cars, streetlights flickering on.
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% cool blue-grey dusk glass and stone / 30% deep
shadow / 10% molten orange fissures and embers.
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. She stands
alone centre-plaza, wind moving her hair and dress. City silent.
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm macro insert. Her hand and collarbone. First
hairline cracks of orange light spread across the skin (P1). No movement
otherwise.
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. Fissures widen,
embers stream upward off her shoulders (P2), granite fracturing in a ring
around her bare feet.
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her
face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so
her face stays centre-frame the entire time. Obsidian plates surface and
lock across her face and shoulders (P3), amber ignites in her eyes, horns
push back through her hair (P4). Her feet never leave the ground. The
camera never loses her face.
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned
cars. Her colossal foot plants, buckling the road, cars flipping in the
shockwave. Scale reveal.
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. Full colossus
against the skyline, embers and dust swirling, molten light pulsing in her
plating.
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. Her
arm swings through the facade, curtain wall shearing away in slabs,
camera whip-panning down with the falling glass.
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. She stands amid the
broken skyline, dust rolling outward, molten fissures pulsing.
PHYSICS: her mass increases continuously, granite fracturing radially from
her feet; steel groans and buckles before it fails; glass falls as sheets
that shatter on impact; concrete shears in slabs, not crumbs; dust rolls
in heavy waves; embers ride heat currents upward.
AUDIO: wind and low city hum, a deep bone-crack as the fissures open, a
sustained rising roar through the growth, groaning steel, sheeting glass,
thunderous impacts, settling dust.
HARD LOCKS: the creature is the transformed woman, one continuous being.
Nothing emerges from the ground. No second creature. She never levitates,
floats, or leaves the ground at any moment. Feet planted throughout the
transformation. She never vanishes from frame between shots. No people
visible anywhere.
FORBIDDEN: no levitation, no separate monster, no ground emergence, no
gore or flesh tearing, no franchise creatures, no design drift, no
subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos.

**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (dim early-morning dorm → fluorescent vocal room → mirror-lit practice room → stark evaluation room lighting).

**STYLE:**
Nostalgic, determined montage feel — younger, rawer energy than her current polished vlogs, evoking a flashback to trainee days. Quick cuts stitched across locations, reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood shifts from tired to focused to nervous, ending on quiet resolve.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean trainee (ref image), late teens/early 20s (younger, flashback version of herself). Long straight black hair, often in a simple ponytail or braid, minimal to no makeup, tired but determined eyes. Wearing simple practice clothes — a plain long-sleeve top and joggers or sweats, fully covering arms and torso, no jewelry.

**Setting Progression**

Trainee dorm room (early morning) → vocal lesson room (morning) → dance practice room (afternoon) → evaluation room (evening).

**Storyboard (15s, 5 cuts)**

1. *(~3s, dorm, propped camera, dim early light)* She wakes up before sunrise, rubbing her eyes, quietly getting ready in the dark so as not to wake roommates. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Back then, mornings started before the sun even came up."

2. *(~3s, vocal room, handheld, fluorescent light)* She stands at a mic, sheet in hand, focused and a little nervous, mouthing through warmups. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Every note mattered — you never knew who was listening."

3. *(~3s, practice room, handheld, mirror wall)* She's mid-motion rehearsing choreography, sweat forming, repeating a step over and over. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "I must have run that same eight-count a hundred times."

4. *(~3s, practice room, macro insert)* Close-up on her feet repeating the same step, breathing audible, tape blur softening the motion. No narration — ambient practice room sound only.

5. *(~3s, evaluation room, wide-to-close, tense finish)* She stands nervously in front of unseen evaluators, hands clasped, taking a steadying breath before the camera holds on her face. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "That was the version of me that started all of this."

[20s] The sun splits open like a mechanical iris, revealing stars, eclipses and turning planets. The light draws the camera up in one weighted crane arc, rising past his shoulder to a brief top-down beat over him. Strong white spotlights illuminate the ring. The crowd is darker but visible and constantly reacting. Crowd cheering continues from the first frame to the last: shouting, applause, whistles, and stomping. Reactions grow louder after major punches. Each numbered shot is one continuous camera take. The camera may pan, track, dolly, or reframe, but must not jump to a new position inside the same shot.

Comic effects must resemble authentic 1969 American comics: imperfect hand-drawn lines, thick black outlines, red, yellow, white, and black colors, halftone dots, faded ink, and slight print misregistration.

Use effects sparingly:
SPEED LINES on fast punches.
One-frame SMEAR FRAME on the strongest punches.
Small IMPACT BURSTS on selected hits.
IMPACT FLASH and SHOCKWAVE RING only on the decisive counter and final uppercut.
WOBBLE LINES and yellow rotating stars only when the human is badly dazed.

Use only these comic sound effects on major clean hits:
THWACK! POW! SMACK! WHAM! CRACK!

SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.0
High-angle view of the packed arena. The ring is under strong spotlights. Both fighters wait in opposite corners. The bell rings, the crowd erupts, and both walk toward the center as the camera pushes closer.

SHOT 2 — 2.0–4.0
Slightly elevated wide shot from outside the ring with ropes in the foreground. The referee steps back. Both fighters raise their guards, circle, and test distance. The handheld camera tracks right.

SHOT 3 — 4.0–6.2
Low canvas-level angle. The bulldog throws a jab with brief SPEED LINES. The human narrowly avoids it and counters with a jab that the bulldog blocks. Quick natural pan. No comic text.

SHOT 4 — 6.2–8.8
Slightly high-angle shot through the ropes. The human attacks with a combination. A left jab lands with a small IMPACT BURST and THWACK! A right straight follows with POW!, a brief IMPACT FLASH, and a small burst. A left hook lands with only a subtle impact mark. The camera tracks as the bulldog retreats.

SHOT 5 — 8.8–11.2
Close handheld shot from the opposite side. The human keeps pressing with short punches. The bulldog blocks several and absorbs one body shot. The camera urgently reframes. The bulldog answers with a short face hook using a small red IMPACT BURST and SMACK!

SHOT 6 — 11.2–14.0
Over-the-shoulder from behind the human. The human throws a powerful right straight. The bulldog slips underneath. The camera pans with the missed glove. Without cutting, the bulldog plants his feet, rotates, and launches a right counterpunch with SPEED LINES and a one-frame SMEAR FRAME.

SHOT 7 — 14.0–16.8

At contact, show a large IMPACT BURST, white IMPACT FLASH, radial lines, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and WHAM! The effects vanish immediately. Return to normal speed as the human staggers backward. The crowd explodes.

SHOT 8 — 16.8–19.2
Slightly elevated ringside shot. The human is badly dazed but standing. WOBBLE LINES and three yellow stars briefly appear. The bulldog lands one body punch without text, then a short face hook with SPEED LINES, a small burst, and SMACK!

SHOT 9 — 19.2–21.5
Low diagonal ringside angle. The bulldog throws a compact uppercut with a one-frame SMEAR FRAME. It lands under the chin with IMPACT FLASH, red-yellow IMPACT BURST, short SHOCKWAVE RING, and CRACK! The human falls into the ropes, drops to one knee, and collapses safely. The referee stops the fight. The bulldog steps back. Yellow stars fade.

SHOT 10 — 21.5–24.0
Final slightly high-angle wide shot. The referee brings the bulldog to the center and raises one arm. Red-and-white paper streamers fly into the ring. REFERENCE SCOPE

@ IMAGE2 defines the studio: matte black floor and walls, monumental angled white acoustic structures, large white ceiling panels separated by deep cosmic gaps with restrained violet-blue nebulae, and the sculptural cube-like rear wall.

@ IMAGE3 defines the exact first frame: composition, symmetry, camera position, artist scale and darkness. The ceiling must follow @ IMAGE2.

@ VIDEO1 is the sole fixed audio reference and exact performance-timing reference. Ignore its black visual track.

AUDIO

Keep the audio from @ VIDEO1 unchanged at its original timestamps from beginning to end.

All cuts and camera changes affect only the image. They must not alter the audio timing.

Do not generate any new audio, vocals, voices, sound effects, ambience, room tone, impacts or transition sounds.

DIRECTION

Create a cinematic photorealistic underground female rap performance video, 16:9, 1080p.

Keep the artist recognizable and dominant. Her movements feel natural and confident: brief stillness, loose asymmetric gestures, weight shifts, torso turns, short purposeful steps and occasional approaches toward the lens.

No repetitive foot tapping, stomping or looping gestures.

Use lively human handheld camera work: pushes, recoils, brief impact jolts, small tilts, slight overshoots and quick corrections. Keep her face readable. Avoid continuous random shaking and smooth floating gimbal movement.

SHOT STRUCTURE

0–4 SECONDS — OPENING

Start exactly on @ IMAGE3 with no pre-roll or alternate opening frame.

She prepares in darkness with her mouth closed. The studio wakes suddenly in one synchronized lighting event.

The camera immediately makes one fast physical rush-in with natural motion blur, reaching a tight frontal medium close-up as the performance begins. No cut before this moment.

4–8 SECONDS — FRONTAL CLOSE PERFORMANCE

Tight frontal medium close-up. She performs directly toward the lens with natural varied gestures.

The camera stays close, reacting to her forward movement with short pushes and recoils. Ceiling panels clearly shift between dark, dim and bright groups.

HARD CUT.

8–12 SECONDS — LOW-ANGLE PERFORMANCE

Low wide-angle medium shot near the floor. She remains large in frame, takes one purposeful step and leans toward the lens.

Use one strong handheld jolt, a brief horizon tilt and a fast correction.

WHIP CUT motivated by her movement.

12–16 SECONDS — SIDE STRUCTURE

The camera tracks diagonally closer while she turns toward the lens. The nearby structure shifts subtly once and the ceiling lighting continues changing.

HARD CUT.

16–20 SECONDS — EXTREME CLOSE PERFORMANCE

Frontal close-up with strong proximity.

The camera pushes close, recoils, briefly moves off-axis and recovers her face. Her performance remains natural, intense and varied.

End with a clean hard cut. No palm covering or touching the lens.

20–24 SECONDS — CUBE WALL PERFORMANCE

The camera stays close and handheld while she performs in front of the moving wall.

LOCKS

cases.prompt:
Main subject: young Korean woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded charcoal-grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light-wash jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail with wispy bangs. Realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, warm and approachable personality. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video. Location: Authentic Korean residential neighborhood during a calm late morning. Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, small terraces, potted plants, laundry lines, bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees casting moving shadows, quiet residential atmosphere. No stores, advertisements, cafés, crowds, or commercial activity. Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion. Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.

00:00–00:02 Outside a small house entrance. She sits on a low concrete wall adjusting her ponytail with both hands raised. A light breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to hold focus.

00:02–00:04 The camera follows her into a narrow alley lined with potted plants and concrete walls. She notices a stray cat approaching and crouches down. Framing drifts off-center as the operator tries to keep up.

00:04–00:06 She gently pets and feeds the cat. Autofocus repeatedly shifts between her face and the animal. Morning sunlight flickers through leaves overhead.

00:06–00:08 Small front yard beside her house. She hangs laundry on a clothesline while fabrics sway in the breeze. Exposure changes as clouds briefly pass overhead.

00:08–00:10 On a quiet terrace with a ceramic coffee cup. She sits comfortably watching the neighborhood, occasionally brushing hair behind her ear. Loose handheld side angle with natural camera drift.

00:10–00:12 Close side profile. Someone off-camera greets her. She turns, raises her hand, smiles warmly, and casually says, "Annyeong." The camera catches the moment slightly late.

00:12–00:15 Walking slowly down a tree-lined residential lane holding her coffee cup. She notices the camera, gives a small genuine smile, then looks away and continues walking.

00:15–00:18 A short flight of worn concrete steps between two low houses. She climbs them one-handed, coffee cup in the other, and pauses to steady a leaning potted plant with her foot. The operator lags a beat behind and the frame tilts hard before correcting. Heavy exposure pumping as she moves from deep shade into open sun at the top of the steps.

00:18–00:20 Narrow alley in full late-morning sun. She stops at a green plastic watering can left by a doorway, picks it up, and waters a row of chili plants and a spider plant along the wall. Water darkens the concrete. Autofocus hunts between the falling water and her hands.

00:20–00:22 An older neighbor passes pushing a small metal handcart. She steps aside, gives a short polite bow, and says a brief warm greeting. The neighbor answers in indistinct background chatter and continues on. The camera swings to follow the cart, then swings back to her, badly framed and slightly late.

00:22–00:24 She crouches at a low wall where the same stray cat has reappeared, sitting in a patch of sun. She holds out one hand, the cat ignores her, and she laughs quietly and stands. Camera drops to knee height and the horizon goes crooked. Motion blur as it lifts again.

00:24–00:26 She wheels an old bicycle out from where it leans against a utility pole, checks the front tyre with her thumb, then leaves it and keeps walking. Overhead wires cut across the bright sky in the top of the frame. Lens breathing as the operator tries to zoom and gives up.

00:26–00:28 Back at the small front yard. The laundry from earlier moves in a stronger breeze now. She reaches up and straightens one sleeve on the line, then stands there a moment looking at the neighborhood, coffee cup empty in her other hand. Soft dappled tree shadow moves across her face and the wall behind her.

00:28–00:30 She turns toward the camera at the house entrance, notices it is still recording, raises her hand in a small casual wave and shakes her head slightly, half-smiling, as if telling the operator to stop filming. Recording cuts abruptly to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was switched off.

Audio: Natural ambient sound only — morning birds, distant motorcycles, light wind, leaves rustling, faint neighborhood chatter, cat sounds, footsteps on concrete, fabric moving on clotheslines, water pouring onto concrete, bicycle chain ticking, handcart wheels on rough ground, subtle residential ambience. No music. No sound design. No narration.

Goal: Authentic Korean neighborhood life captured like a forgotten home video from the early 2000s — candid, imperfect, realistic, warm, and deeply believable.

＃制約

cases.prompt:
30-second cinematic historical epic, 16:9. Photorealistic late Egyptian royal court with grounded human behavior, real skin texture, natural facial micro-expressions, historically inspired linen, bronze, gold, leather, horses, papyrus, firelight and stone. Preserve the queen in ivory and deep-blue gown, the kneeling Roman envoy in dark red cloak and bronze armor, the emerald-robed priestess, the enormous blue-and-gold throne hall, burning braziers, reflective black floor, and the Nile beyond the open arches.

0-5s: [Slow low dolly from behind the kneeling Roman envoy toward the queen] The queen studies the Roman treaty in silence. Firelight flickers across her face; the envoy's hands are tense around the ivory tablet. Behind the throne, Egyptian palace guards stand still with bronze spears and large blue-and-gold shields.
Envoy, restrained English: “Rome offers peace.”

5-10s: [Medium close-up on the queen] She looks up slowly. Her expression is calm, intelligent, and cold rather than theatrical.
Queen, clear English: “Rome offers surrender.”
The envoy swallows, briefly losing his composure.

10-15s: [Over-the-shoulder on the envoy, queen in focus behind him] He glances toward the open Nile archway.
Envoy: “Their legions wait at the river.”
The priestess watches the queen closely; only the flames and curtains move.

15-21s: [Camera tracks alongside the queen as she rises and descends the throne steps] The queen hands the treaty to the priestess, who drops it into a bronze brazier. The papyrus burns naturally. The queen walks forward, her heavy blue train sliding across the black stone floor. Palace guards step apart in two disciplined lines, creating a path toward the open terrace. No magical effects, only fire, smoke, fabric, metal, and human tension.

21-26s: [Camera follows behind her, then cranes upward over her shoulder] She reaches the vast palace terrace overlooking the Nile. Below, a real Egyptian royal army fills the riverbank and courtyard: rows of bronze-armored infantry, tall standards moving in hot wind, horse-drawn chariots, shield-bearing guards, priests carrying gold sun emblems, and long riverboats waiting beside the water. Dust hangs in the warm dawn light. The scale is enormous but physically believable.

26-30s: [Low-angle close-up, army blurred behind her] The queen stops at the terrace edge. Wind lifts the edge of her blue train. She looks toward the Roman envoy, then toward her assembled army.
Queen, low and final: “Then Rome will learn whom Egypt follows.”
Hold on her face as the army below strikes spear shafts once against their shields in a single thunderous response.

Grand historical scale, grounded realism, emotionally restrained acting, physically accurate crowd movement, detailed bronze armor, natural fire and smoke, believable horse and chariot motion, rich blue, gold, ivory and desert-stone palette, elegant stable camera movement, precise English lip sync. No magic, no supernatural symbols, no modern objects, no sci-fi effects, no random text, no logos, no extra main characters, no duplicate limbs, no warped faces or hands, no costume drift, no unstable architecture, no chaotic camera shake.

HKb7_rmbMAARNAP
站在荒凉平原的画面右侧，身体朝向画面左侧。她五官秀美清晰， 远方是低矮山脉、枯草、裸露岩石和灰蓝色阴云。女侠神情凌厉，右脚踩实地面，左脚向前稳定重心，腰部向后扭转，肩膀带动右臂，以全身力量将一块粗糙灰色石块猛力抛向画面左侧。发尾、衣摆和腰间束带受到转身惯性向外甩动。 摄影机立即追上飞行的石块。石块位于画面中心，占画面高度约三分之一，一边高速前进一边不规则旋转。摄影机与石块保持约一米距离同步伴飞，背景荒原快速向后退去，女侠在浅景深中迅速缩小。 MATCH CUT。 石块在旋转至相同角度的瞬间，变成一把原始石槌：灰色钝石通过粗糙植物纤维牢牢捆绑在木柄前端。石槌保持完全相同的中心位置、飞行方向和旋转速度，木柄因高速旋转产生自然拖影。背景出现远古部落、木制栅栏、兽皮帐篷和稀疏火堆。 MATCH CUT。 石槌变成一支商周时期的青铜长矛。矛头具有厚重的青铜质感、铸造纹理和自然氧化斑，木质矛杆继续沿同一轨迹高速飞行。背景升级为尘土飞扬的早期古代战场，远处可见战车、木盾、皮甲士兵和迎风摆动的素色旌旗。 MATCH CUT。 青铜长矛变成一支秦汉重弩射出的弩箭。弩箭具有锋利的三棱青铜箭头、硬木箭杆和稳定尾羽，主体仍位于画面中心。背景升级为秦汉边塞，夯土城墙、木制箭楼、弩阵和远处骑兵在冷灰色风沙中快速掠过。箭杆高速自旋，尾羽受到气流产生细小颤动。 MATCH CUT。 弩箭变成一支宋代火箭矢。箭杆前端保留金属箭头，中段捆绑细长火药筒，尾部喷出明亮橙色火焰与灰白烟迹。火箭矢保持此前弩箭的飞行方向和旋转轴，火焰只在尾部向后喷射，不改变主体轨迹。 背景升级为宋代城防战场，青砖城墙、木制楼橹、床弩、盾阵和瓦顶建筑在浓烟中快速后退。火药燃烧照亮箭杆边缘，烟迹被高速气流拉成长线。 MATCH CUT。 火箭矢前端在经过画面中心时变成一枚宋代震天雷。震天雷是一枚沉重的深灰色球形铁壳火器，表面具有铸铁纹理、接缝和短小燃烧引线。它继续沿同一轨迹高速旋转，燃烧引线向后拉出火星，没有提前爆炸。 背景中的宋代城墙发生远距离爆炸，橙黄色火球、碎土和烟尘形成冲击波。逆光在震天雷边缘形成短促金属高光，主体依然保持锐利。 MATCH CUT。 神火飞鸦张开的黑色双翼变成一架银灰色三角翼隐形战斗机。摄影机位于战机前上方约十米处高速后退引导，战机保持画面中心，贴近东方山谷高速俯冲。 下方是云雾笼罩的喀斯特峰林、河流和层叠山脊。战机表面采用克制的深灰色隐身涂层和东方几何分割线，没有文字、编号或标志。机翼切开湿润空气，翼尖形成短暂白色凝结涡，峡谷后方升起浓黑烟柱。 MATCH CUT。 航天器尾焰中心变成未来东方星际飞船的巨大圆形推进器。推进器内部的同心金属环、耐热陶瓷和磁约束结构逐层亮起橙红色能量。摄影机继续高速后退，飞船正面和完整船体逐渐显露。 星际飞船采用厚重可信的工业结构，主体为深灰金属、玉白色陶瓷装甲和暗红色结构线。船体轮廓具有克制的中式轴线对称、飞檐折线和龙脊般的纵向结构，但不是宫殿、宝塔或卡通龙造型。装甲表面分布细密机械舱门、散热片、微弱红色状态灯和若隐若现的抽象云纹压印。 摄影机贴近飞船外壳掠过船体顶部。大型装甲板、结构梁和散热格栅从镜头下方高速通过，运动方向始终连续。摄影机随后越过船体中轴，自然进入飞船后方视角。 最终画面中，巨型东方星际飞船尾部位于画面中心，多组圆形蓝白色离子引擎由内向外依次点火。发动机亮度迅速增强，冷蓝光反射在玉白陶瓷与深灰金属装甲表面。 飞船产生明确加速度，带着巨大质量感驶向深空。摄影机逐渐停止追随，飞船越来越小，最终缩成远方红蓝星云前的一颗明亮光点。星际飞船消失后，星云轮廓短暂呈现出类似水墨山脉的自然层次，但仍保持真实宇宙影像质感。 【摄影与物理】 飞行物镜头使用29°至47°对角视场角，摄影机与主体保持稳定伴飞距离。主体始终位于画面中心并保持锐利，背景保留高速运动模糊和清楚的时代环境线索。 每种物体具有正确质量、惯性、空气阻力、旋转轴和材质反光：石块旋转不规则；石槌受木柄影响产生偏心旋转；长矛与弩箭沿长轴稳定；震天雷沉重且旋转较慢；神火飞鸦依靠尾部火箭保持姿态；战机、航天器和星际飞船依靠气动面或推进系统稳定飞行。 匹配剪辑只发生在主体经过画面中心、轮廓短暂重叠或旋转至相同角度的瞬间。每次变化都是干净利落的一帧MATCH CUT，不是渐变、融化或零件生长。飞行方向、视觉中心和总体动量始终连续。 【声音】 只生成画面内自然音效：女侠发力时的短促呼气、鞋底摩擦、衣料与发带破风声、手臂挥动声、石块和石槌划破空气的呼啸、青铜矛头的低沉风鸣、弩箭尾羽振动、火箭矢燃烧声、震天雷引线火花、远处爆炸、神火飞鸦火箭喷射、战斗机喷气发动机、航天器推进器轰鸣，以及星际引擎逐级充能和点火声。 声音随时代升级逐渐由原始风声和金属声，发展为火药爆燃、喷气轰鸣和深沉的星际推进器低频震动。无旁白、无对白、无背景音乐。 【写实后缀】 真实电影级运动物理，细腻材质，稳定主体一致性，准确匹配剪辑，真实景深和速度模糊。中国古代女侠面部自然真实，身体结构正确，投掷动作具有明确的脚步支撑、腰部扭转、肩臂传力和释放惯性。 禁止古代女侠变脸、手指异常、服装穿模或宽大袖子缠绕手臂；禁止武器漂浮、橡胶变形、突然减速、反向飞行或改变轨迹；禁止渐变变形、粒子重组和魔法光效；禁止把神火飞鸦生成真实乌鸦；禁止把星际飞船生成宫殿、宝塔或卡通巨龙。 画面内不出现文字、字幕、标志、水印或UI。各时代环境连续升级，飞行主体的方向、视觉中心、旋转节奏和动量始终保持一致。

Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright open-sky daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic rather than polished cinematic footage.
STYLE: Cozy outdoor kite-flying vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments, natural pauses. Focus on satisfying everyday sounds: kite fabric flapping in the wind, string spool unwinding, grass rustling underfoot, light breeze against the microphone.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her mid-20s, plain windbreaker, hair tied back in a loose ponytail, minimal jewelry, no visible logos or branded items. Cheerful, carefree energy on a breezy afternoon.
SETTING: Small open field on a bright breezy afternoon. Wide open sky, plain grass field, no visible signage, buildings with branding, or logos anywhere in frame.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on a low tripod in the grass, unrolls a plain kite. "Perfect windy day for this."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Unwinds the string spool, checking it's free of tangles.
→ (3s, close-up) Attaches the string firmly to the kite frame.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Walks backward a few steps, testing the wind direction. "Feels strong enough today."
→ (3s, detail shot) Releases the kite gently into the air. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Watches it climb higher, letting the string out slowly. "There it goes."
→ (3s, macro shot) Kite fabric flapping steadily against the open sky.
→ (3s, propped shot) Sits down on the grass, holding the string loosely.

REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine cheerful smiles, occasional pauses adjusting the string, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright open-sky lighting shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.

cases.prompt: Create a ten second cinematic live action illusion in a sixteen by nine frame at thirty frames per second. Begin inside a faithfully recreated late nineteen nineties desktop paint program. Use a cool gray window frame, navy title bar, simple menus, chunky pixel tool icons on the left, scroll bars, and small color swatches along the bottom. The canvas shows a saturated blue sky with soft white clouds and a vivid green grassy hill, nostalgic but photographed with realistic depth, subtle cloud movement, and light atmospheric haze. 0 to 1.2 seconds. Hold a locked frontal camera on the full paint window. The empty landscape fills the canvas. A slim young adult man rises smoothly from the bottom center with his back to camera. He wears a red athletic shirt with white collar and sleeve stripes, a backward royal blue cap, a thin silver chain, and black ink forearm tattoos. Give his movement real body weight, natural shoulder motion, and slight cloth drag. 1.2 to 2.5 seconds. He lifts his tattooed right arm toward the upper left of the canvas as though touching an invisible drawing tool. Keep the interface perfectly stable and sharp. He turns clockwise toward camera, lowers his hand, and settles into a relaxed waist up pose at center. Use soft frontal daylight, a gentle key from camera left, believable skin texture, clear eyes, fine facial hair, and a faint contact shadow. 2.5 to 6.2 seconds. He looks into camera with a playful calm expression, raises one index finger, and draws in midair. A warm ivory line appears exactly at the fingertip and follows every gesture without delay. It looks like a real textured paint stroke with slight thickness variation, dry brush edges, and a soft glow. He draws one continuous five point star around his body. Make the tall upper point above his cap, the right point beside his shoulder, the lower left point across his torso, the lower right point, then close the shape near his raised hand. Preserve correct hand anatomy, stable identity, perfect line continuity, and natural reactions from his free hand. 6.2 to 7.4 seconds. When the star closes, perform a smooth optical push into the canvas until the interface edges slide beyond the frame. The move should feel like a real camera passing through a monitor, with subtle lens breathing and no cut. He smiles softly and lifts both palms in a small satisfied reveal while the completed ivory star floats around him. 7.4 to 10 seconds. He glances right and walks naturally out of frame. Keep the camera locked on the empty hill and sky. The star remains suspended, slowly loses brightness, and becomes slightly transparent without vanishing. End with one cloud drifting through its center. Maintain one continuous shot, realistic motion blur, natural blinking, stable clothing and tattoos, accurate perspective, clean edges, no warped limbs, no duplicate fingers, no facial changes, no flicker, no random objects, no extra people, and no artificial plastic skin. Make it feel like a practical live action performance composited into an authentic retro computer interface. Audio. Add an original playful retro electronic instrumental at about one hundred and five beats per minute with a warm drum machine groove, soft bass, bright synth plucks, and subtle digital ambience. Sync a light mouse click to the first hand gesture, delicate paint stroke swishes to the fingertip, a sparkling chime when the star closes, and a soft whoosh during the push into the canvas. No vocals and no dialogue.

cases.title_zh: The Elven Princess Greets the Orcs
cases.title_en: The Elven Princess Greets the Orcs
cases.description_zh: 30 秒cinematic story提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。
cases.author: aimikoda
cases.prompt:
16:9, 30-second photoreal live-action fantasy battle in clear daylight, crisp high-resolution cinema detail, natural textures, clean HDR contrast, one wide lens and one uninterrupted controlled handheld pursuit shot.

The elf princess is tall and slender, with fair freckled skin, blue-gray eyes, long wavy platinum-blonde hair, pointed ears, a silver branch circlet, and a flowing silver battle gown with a scale-textured mantle. Keep one identical princess throughout. She holds one silver longsword in her right hand.

Exactly 36 distinct armored green-skinned orcs enter over time, each with a different weapon, helmet, armor, or silhouette; orc 36 is a heavy captain with a cleaver. Never reuse an orc. Every stroke hits exactly one target. Show 36 separate contacts, green-fluid releases, and individual defeats. No multi-target cut; shockwaves move dust only. Each next orc actively attacks, guards, evades, or intercepts.

Rotate Zornhau, Zwerchhau, Unterhau, Krumphau, Scheitelhau, straight thrust, moulinet reverse cut, draw cut, and pivoting back cut without adjacent repetition. Every relocation uses this rhythm: clean micro-anticipation; a white-silver flash fully hides the princess and she vanishes; the camera continues its normal physical follow with the environment visible; a second local flash reveals her beside the next target in a fully formed attack pose. Show no transit body movement and no whip pan.

The camera stays close, following with smooth handheld sidesteps, retreats, arcs, drops, rises, and pivots. It travels toward each flash destination without snapping, resetting, teleporting, or hiding a cut. Keep princess, orcs, background, debris, hair, cloth, fluid, and particles sharply resolved. No motion blur anywhere.

SEQUENCE: ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT

Beat 1 / 0-3s: Rear 3/4 WS, follow behind the princess into a sunlit battle already in progress. The orcs occupy successive depth pockets, not one flat crowd; only nearby attackers are readable. Orc 1 charges while she forms the opening anticipation pose.

Beat 2 / 3-10s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 1-9. Follow attacks from alternating sides with physical sidesteps and arcs. Perform nine fast but separate vanish, follow, reappear, single-target cycles using different techniques. Preserve each crisp contact, green-fluid release, recoil, and fall before the next attack. End with nine defeated as orc 10 attacks from behind.

Beat 3 / 10-17s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 10-18. Pivot around the princess to catch the rear attack, move ahead, backpedal while leading, then arc around as threats enter from different directions. Show nine more individual attacks and one-orc cuts in a changed order. She appears only in sharp anticipation, contact, and finishing poses. End with eighteen defeated and orc 19 intercepting.

Beat 4 / 17-24s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 19-27. Drop beside timber, rise around a shield, pass behind an axe raider, then turn toward an attacker descending from rubble. Increase tempo across nine distinct parries, evasions, lunges, guards, and single-target finishes. Each relocation uses two local flashes with continuous environment between them. End with twenty-seven defeated as the final nine surround her.

Beat 5 / 24-30s: CONTINUE SAME SHOT through orcs 28-36. Enter a tight controlled pursuit orbit, changing proximity and height along one physical path. Orcs 28-35 each receive a separate technique, contact, green-fluid release, and fall. The captain attacks last; sidestep his cleaver as one flash hides the princess and the next reveals her beyond him in a sharp Scheitelhau finish. His delayed impact affects only him. End with all 36 individually defeated.

SOUND: No dialogue or subtitles. Daylight battle ambience, sword transients, 36 distinct contact accents, individual orc reactions, dry flash cracks, and accelerating percussion.

VFX: Local white-silver flashes cover only the princess during vanish and reveal. Green fluid begins only at sword contact. Render every effect with crisp edges and zero motion blur.

EXCLUDE: Motion blur anywhere, whip pans, cuts, hidden cuts, lens changes, camera resets or teleports, visible transit, morphing, stretched limbs, extra or smeared anatomy, duplicates, multi-target strikes, low resolution, soft focus, haze, grain, compression artifacts, and night lighting.

CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself throughout each location, occasionally propped briefly for hands-free moments. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones — lighting shifts per location (clinical soft light at physio → warm home light for stretching → soft steamy bathroom light → dim cozy bedroom light).
STYLE:
Slow, gentle montage feel — calmer and more tender than her usual bubbly vlogs. Quiet reflective voiceover narration plays over the visuals instead of synced dialogue. Mood stays soft and caring throughout, centered on rest and self-care.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long straight black hair, natural and softly tied back, dewy glass skin, minimal to no makeup, tired but peaceful expression. Wearing a modest robe or oversized loungewear throughout — fully covering arms, torso, and legs at all times, including during the bath/shower segment (framed only from shoulders up or via steam/robe coverage, nothing revealing shown).
Setting Progression
Physio/massage clinic (afternoon) → her room, stretching mat (early evening) → bathroom, steamy warm light (night) → bedroom (late night).
Storyboard (20s, 6 cuts)
(~3.5s, physio clinic, propped camera, medium shot) She lies on a treatment table as a therapist's hands (off-camera) work on her shoulder, wincing slightly then relaxing. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some days, taking care of myself has to come first."
(~3s, physio clinic, close handheld) She sits up slowly afterward, rolling her shoulder, small relieved exhale. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "That already feels so much better."
(~3.5s, home, stretching mat, medium propped shot) She stretches gently on a mat in her room, slow and unhurried, soft evening light. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "A little more stretching never hurts."
(~3s, bathroom, steamy soft light, framed modestly — shoulders up only, robe visible) She sits wrapped in a robe near a warm bath or shower, steam softly filling the frame, eyes closed peacefully. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then... just letting the day melt away."
(~3s, bathroom, macro insert) Close-up on water droplets and steam, soft warm light, no exposed skin beyond hands/face. No narration — ambient water sound only.
(~4s, bedroom, dim cozy light, closing shot) She climbs into bed early, pulling the blanket up, eyes already heavy, a small content smile before the screen fades. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some nights, the earlier the better."

cases.title_zh: Lightning Sorceress Transformation
cases.title_en: Lightning Sorceress Transformation
cases.description_zh: apimodels 画廊公开提示词（2502 字）。
cases.author: LudovicCreator
cases.prompt:
[GOAL]
Generate a 30-second transformation sequence. The core subject is <FIGURE>, a human form kept as a near-total silhouette from the first frame to the last. The main event is <FIGURE> walking out of a dark storm void and assuming a fully formed sorcerer aspect, with the silhouette never breaking.

[STAGE ONE]
Opens with:   a black void of low fog. Forked white lightning crawls horizontally on both sides of frame. <FIGURE> is a small distant shape walking straight toward camera.
Main event:   <FIGURE> closes the distance in an unbroken push; the hair catches light first and begins to burn as iridescent plasma in pink, mint and violet.
Ends with:    a chest-up frame of <FIGURE>, face entirely black, plasma hair fully lit, eyes not yet open.

[STAGE TWO]
Carried over: the same void, the same fog level, the same plasma hair colours, the same total silhouette on the face and body.
Main event:   two narrow white slits ignite where the eyes are and resolve into detailed glowing irises. Armour assembles onto the silhouette from the shoulders down — a high sculpted collar, layered pauldrons, and three crescent marks lit on the chest.
Ends with:    <FIGURE> standing full-length in centre frame, armour complete, one hand open at the side.

[STAGE THREE]
Main event:   <FIGURE> raises the open hand and lightning bends into the palm, twisting into a rigid staff of light; a circular sigil ignites on the ground underfoot; <FIGURE> spreads both arms and releases a radial burst.
Ends with:    the burst at full extension, <FIGURE> centred and still a silhouette, the sigil still lit.

[KEEP CONSISTENT]
Keep the face in full silhouette in every frame — never light the features. Keep the plasma hair colour order, the collar and pauldron shapes and the crescent marks stable once formed. Keep the camera axis frontal throughout; do not orbit.

The image is near-black high-key-on-black: teal and cold white lightning as the only key light, deep haze, no fill, crushed blacks with the subject read purely as edge and rim. Anamorphic flare on each strike.

The camera holds frontal and pushes in step by step across the three stages, from an extreme wide to a face close-up and back out to a full-length wide, cutting only on lightning strikes.

Sound includes low sub-bass pressure that rises across the whole clip, sharp thunder cracks synchronised to each visual strike, an electrical crackle that tightens as the hair ignites, a single ringing tone when the sigil lights, and no dialogue.

cases.description_zh: 15 秒animation提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。
cases.author: sailorv321
cases.prompt:
（元はThreadsのdopamin.wxyさんを参考にしています）

【Seedance 2.5／15秒／9:16】

参照画像を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。15秒、9:16縦型、ワンカット、固定カメラ。開始から終了までカメラは完全固定。ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、手持ち、カット、トランジション、リフレーム、スロー、静止演出は禁止。

【構図・立ち位置】

画面左側45％に実写のBBQグリルと骨付き肉を配置する。画面右側30％に2Dキャラクターを配置する。中央にはトングと肉を移動させるための空間を20％程度確保する。

キャラクターは右側の砂浜に立ち、頭から黒いビーチサンダルまで全身を常に表示する。キャラクターをグリルの前、グリル脚の上、テーブルの上には置かない。キャラクターとグリルの間には明確な空間を残し、開始から終了まで立ち位置を維持する。

グリル、肉、人の手、トング、コチュジャンボトルをキャラクターの身体と重ねない。キャラクターが肉やグリルを隠さない。人の手やトングがキャラクターの顔や身体を不自然に横切らない。物体同士の奥行きと前後関係を正確に維持する。

【映像スタイル】

真夏の美しい海辺で行われる実写BBQ映像と、平面2Dアニメーションステッカーキャラクターを組み合わせたコミカルな映像。

青い海、白い波、明るい青空、黄金色の砂浜、遠景の海岸線、風に揺れるヤシの葉を描く。明るい昼の自然光。海風によってヤシの葉、グリルの煙、キャラクターの白いシャツの裾が自然に揺れる。

背景、海、砂、グリル、炭火、煙、炎、骨付き肉、脂、肉汁、コチュジャン、ボトル、人の手、金属トングはすべて高品質な実写表現。白飛び、過度なブルーム、霞、露出のちらつきは禁止。

キャラクターだけは最後まで平面2Dアニメーションステッカーとして維持する。実写化、半実写化、3D化、CGフィギュア化、ゲームモデル化、Pixar風、クレイアニメ風は禁止。鮮明な線画、セル塗り、平面的な陰影、細い白フチを維持する。

【キャラクター固定】

参照画像の男性キャラクターをそのまま使用する。柔らかなアッシュシルバーのウェーブヘア、前髪の形、髪の長さと毛量、灰青色の瞳、若く整った顔、細身で長い手足の体型を固定する。

白いノースリーブインナー、透け感のある白い半袖オープンシャツ、白いドローコード、黒いペイズリー柄ショートパンツ、黒いビーチサンダル、シルバーネックレス、ピアス、ブレスレット、リングを固定する。

顔、髪型、体型、衣装、柄、色、靴、アクセサリーを変更しない。帽子、サングラス、エプロン、手袋、新しい小物を追加しない。キャラクターを複製しない。別の2Dキャラクターを追加しない。

キャラクターは冷たい無表情ではなく、非常に可愛く表情豊かに動く。大きく輝く目、頬の赤み、嬉しそうな笑顔、首を傾げる仕草、肩を小さく揺らす動き、頬を膨らませた拗ね顔、涙目、慌てて手を振る動きを明確に見せる。棒立ち禁止。

【BBQと骨付き肉】

画面左側の実写BBQグリルで、大きな骨付きトマホークステーキを焼く。長い骨が肉に物理的につながったまま明確に見える。肉は十分に焼けており、濃い焼き目、香ばしい焦げ目、艶のある肉汁、溶けた脂、軽い湯気を描く。

肉を生肉、黒焦げ、骨なし肉、変形した肉にしない。肉や骨を複製しない。骨を途中で消さない。

実写の成人女性の手が画面左端から入る。ピンク色のネイルアート、細いシルバーリング、正常な5本指を維持する。金属製BBQトングで肉を返し、持ち上げる。手、指、リング、トング、肉、グリルを融合させない。

【コチュジャン】

ラベル、文字、ブランドロゴのない透明なスクイーズボトルを使用する。中身は濃厚で艶のある深い赤茶色のコチュジャン。ケチャップのような明るい赤色や水っぽい液体にはしない。

コチュジャンはボトルのノズルから太く連続して流れ、肉の表面に直接落ちる。ソースを空中から突然出現させない。ボトルの底や側面から漏らさない。

【00:00–00:03】

固定されたワイド構図で開始する。左側では骨付きトマホークステーキが大きな音を立てて焼けている。女性の実写の手が金属トングで肉を一度ゆっくり返す。脂が炭に落ち、小さな炎が一瞬だけ上がる。薄い煙が海風に流れる。

右側の2Dキャラクターは肉を見つめ、目を大きくキラキラ輝かせる。両手を顎の下で合わせ、肩を上げ、膝を少し曲げて小さく2回弾む。口元に小さな2Dのよだれが一滴だけ現れて消える。

【00:03–00:05】

キャラクターがコチュジャンボトルを見つける。目を輝かせ、首を傾げ、片手でボトルを指さす。嬉しそうにボトルを両手で持ち、胸の前で一瞬だけ抱き締める。

その後、片目を閉じたイタズラっぽい笑顔になり、ノズルを左側の肉へ向ける。キャラクター自身は右側の立ち位置から移動しない。

【00:05–00:07】

キャラクターがボトルを強く絞り、骨付き肉の上へコチュジャンを大量にかける。濃い赤茶色の太いソースがノズルから肉まで連続して伸び、肉の表面に大量のジグザグ模様を作る。

ソースは熱で軽く泡立ち、肉汁と混ざって艶を出す。肉全体を完全に隠さず、骨と焼き目は見える状態を維持する。

キャラクターは得意げに笑い、舌先を少し出し、肩を可愛く左右に揺らしながらボトルを絞る。女性の手はトングを持ったまま驚いて止まる。

【00:07–00:09】

女性の手がトングでコチュジャンボトルを素早く取り上げ、左側へ戻す。その直後、閉じたトングの先端でキャラクターの頭頂部を軽く一度だけ「こん！」と叩く。

トングの先端がキャラクターの髪へ明確に軽く接触する。接触と同時に、頭の上へ小さな黄色い2Dの星形衝撃エフェクトを出す。強く殴らない。痛々しくしない。完全に可愛いカートゥーン式のツッコミにする。

叩かれた瞬間、キャラクターの頭が右へ傾き、銀髪が弾み、肩と胴体が左、右へ大きく揺れる。膝が曲がり、両腕を広げてバランスを取る。足は砂浜から離れず、グリル側へ移動しない。

頬を膨らませ、目をぎゅっと閉じ、小さな涙を一滴だけ出す。頭だけではなく、全身が可愛く揺れる動きを約1秒間はっきり見せる。

【00:09–00:11】

女性の手がトングをグリルへ戻し、コチュジャンの付いた焼き肉を一口サイズに持ち上げる。持ち上げた肉には焼き目、肉汁、繊維、濃いコチュジャンが見える。

トングは中央の空間を通り、肉をキャラクターの口の前まで運ぶ。キャラクターは頭を叩かれたことに拗ね、腕を組んで顔を横へ向け、頬を膨らませる。

すぐに目だけで肉をちらっと見る。目が再び輝き、腕をほどき、両手を背中へ回し、上半身を少し前へ傾ける。口を大きく開け、肉へ近づく。

【00:11–00:12】

キャラクターが肉を明確に一口食べる。開いた口をトングで持った肉へ近づけ、肉を口で挟み、頭を後ろへ引いて一口分を噛み取る。

トングに残った肉には、はっきりした一口分の欠けた跡を残す。肉を見るだけ、匂いを嗅ぐだけ、舐めるだけは禁止。

キャラクターは2回はっきり噛む。頬を少し膨らませ、最初は非常に幸せそうな表情になる。目を閉じ、両手を頬へ当て、片足のかかとを上げて嬉しそうに小さく揺れる。

【00:12–00:13.2】

突然、激辛に気づく。噛む動きを止め、目を大きな丸に見開き、瞳孔を小さくする。顔全体が頬から額まで急速に赤くなる。頭の周囲に小さな汗マークを複数出す。

両手で口元を高速にあおぎ、左右の足を交互に小さく上げて慌てる。膝、肩、胴体を細かく震わせ、両目に大きな可愛い涙をためる。右側の立ち位置から出ない。

【00:13.2–00:14.4】

キャラクターが上半身を少し前へ倒し、口を大きく開ける。口の中から、明確な平面2Dコミック炎を一度だけ勢いよく吹き出す。

炎はキャラクターの口から始まり、画面右上の何もない空間へ向かう。炎をグリル、肉、人の手、トング、ボトルへ向けない。

炎は黄色い中心、オレンジ色の本体、赤い輪郭を持つ平面2Dイラスト。炎の中に小さな赤唐辛子マークを数個混ぜる。実写の危険な炎にはしない。物を燃やさない。爆発させない。

キャラクターは涙を流しながら両腕を慌てて振り、炎の反動で上半身だけ少し後ろへ揺れる。足は砂浜の同じ位置を維持する。

【00:14.4–00:15】

2Dの炎が小さく縮み、可愛い白い煙の「ぷすっ」という一粒のエフェクトに変わる。

キャラクターは最後に全身を一度だけ左右へふらつかせる。膝が震え、肩が落ち、髪が一度弾む。両手で口を押さえ、真っ赤な頬、涙目、腫れたような小さな唇、恥ずかしそうな表情になる。

頭の上を小さな赤唐辛子アイコンが回転する。女性の手は左側で、一口分が欠けた肉をトングで持ったまま困惑して停止する。

キャラクター全身は右側、グリルと肉は左側に明確に分離した状態で終了する。フェードアウト禁止。タイトル表示禁止。

cases.prompt:
Duration: 10s | 9:16 | 24fps

[SUMMARY]
Five beautiful women in five countries greet the viewer on the same morning.
Each looks into the camera at selfie distance, says good morning in her native
language, then covers the lens with her palm — and the next country appears as
it pulls away.

[GLOBAL SETTINGS]
Early morning everywhere, soft low natural sunlight, warm and fresh.
Photorealistic, candid. 35mm, shallow depth of field, selfie distance, natural
film grain. No studio polish, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing.
Camera: chest-up close-up, locked off, eye level, one setup per beat — the
only movement is the woman and her hand.
Each woman is genuinely beautiful in the way her own country reads as
beautiful, but real: keep true fine pores and real skin texture, light natural
makeup or none. Genuine unforced brightness, not a posed smile. Every face
completely different from the other four.

[TRANSITION]
MASK TRANSITION at every cut: the palm advances toward the lens, fills and
blackens the frame, then pulls away to reveal the next woman already in place.
Prohibit hard cuts. Prohibit objects appearing out of thin air. Keep the
camera's breathing and timing in harmony, leaving enough time for each switch.

[TIMESTAMP STORYBOARD]

0-2s | JAPAN
25-year-old Japanese woman, elegant classical beauty. Cool-toned fair skin,
translucent, true fine pores. Slender double-eyelid almond eyes, cool clear
gaze, small straight nose, delicate jawline. Glossy jet-black hair past the
shoulders, curled softly inward, wispy see-through fringe. Cream ribbed knit
top. Slim shoulders, quiet grace.
By a bright bedroom window in Tokyo, white curtains behind her.
Her reserved face opens into a bright smile: 「おはよう！」
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

2-4s | UNITED STATES
25-year-old American woman, healthy open all-American beauty. Warm sun-kissed
skin with real freckles across nose and cheeks, true pores. Large round hazel
eyes creasing at the outer corners, high cheekbones, wide unguarded smile.
Voluminous honey-blonde beach waves gathered over one shoulder. Grey marl
sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder.
In a sunlit kitchen, a coffee mug on the counter behind her.
Brightly in English: "Good morning!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

4-6s | BRAZIL
25-year-old Brazilian woman, radiant sunlit beauty. Warm deep-brown skin with
a natural sheen, true pores. Large dark almond eyes, long thick lashes, high
cheekbones, full lips, broad open-mouthed smile. Abundant voluminous curls,
dark brown with caramel and honey highlights, wide around her shoulders. Small
gold hoops. Marigold-yellow strappy top.
On a balcony, tropical plants and morning haze behind her.
Brightly in Brazilian Portuguese: "Bom dia!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

6-8s | SPAIN
25-year-old Spanish woman, striking dark-eyed Mediterranean beauty. Olive
skin, warm and matte, true fine pores. Deep dark almond eyes under strong
brows, straight defined nose, sharp cheekbones, clean jawline, calm confident
half-smile that opens as she speaks. Long centre-parted deep-chestnut hair
with reddish warmth, thick and slightly wavy. Fine gold hoops. Crisp white
linen shirt, top button open. Upright poised posture.
In a whitewashed courtyard, terracotta pots and hard morning sun behind her.
Brightly in Spanish: "¡Buenos días!"
Then her right hand rises and her palm covers the lens.

8-10s | INDONESIA
25-year-old Indonesian woman, warm sweet-featured beauty. Golden-brown skin,
smooth and luminous, true fine pores. Large round dark eyes, gentle open gaze,
softly rounded cheeks, small nose, wide easy smile that reaches her eyes.
Glossy very dark brown hair in a sharp chin-length blunt bob. Small gold
pendant. Sky-blue collared blouse. Petite, friendly.
On a wooden terrace, broad tropical leaves and soft morning light behind her.
Brightly in Indonesian: "Selamat pagi!"
She holds her smile and the frame ends on her face — she does NOT cover the
lens. The film finishes here.

[GLOBAL CLOSING]
Throughout: same chest-up framing, same eye-level camera height, same fresh
morning light, same warm mood in all five countries. Every woman looks
straight into the lens the whole time.
Five different faces, five different skin tones, five different hair colours
and lengths — jet-black long, honey-blonde waves, caramel curls, deep-chestnut
long, dark-brown bob. Never repeat a look, never blend two faces.
Each greeting is spoken clearly and completely within its two seconds, with
accurate native pronunciation and matching lip movement.
Pure video. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no BGM, no
watermark. Only the five voices and quiet morning room tone.
Prohibit: a sixth person, two people in one frame, the same face twice,
plastic or airbrushed skin, doll-like faces, hard cuts, objects appearing from
nothing, the hand entering before the greeting is finished, mixed camera
moves, jitter, flicker.

cases.prompt: Create one 30-second 9:16 photorealistic live-action dramatic scene with five deliberate shots and native synchronized dialogue. Original characters: LENA: a 38-year-old South Asian woman, tired expressive eyes, dark wavy hair in a loose low bun, charcoal coat over a cream blouse. MOTHER: a 72-year-old South Asian woman with delicate features, silver hair in a loose braid and a pale-blue knitted cardigan. She has early dementia but remains emotionally perceptive. Setting: a quiet memory-care bedroom on a winter morning. Soft gray daylight enters from frame left; a warm bedside lamp provides gentle fill. Two chairs face each other beside the window. Subtle radiator ticks and distant corridor room tone. No music. Shot 1 — 0–6 seconds: Stable medium two-shot, natural 50mm perspective. Mother studies Lena politely without recognition and says warmly, “You’re very kind, nurse.” Lena hides the pain behind a small reassuring smile and answers, “I’m not a nurse, Mum. It’s Lena.” Shot 2 — 6–13 seconds: Cut to Mother’s close-up. Her eyes brighten at the memory of a child, not the woman before her. She says, “My Lena is eleven. She hates peas and lies badly.” Lena answers softly from offscreen, “She still does.” Mother’s smile disappears. She asks, genuinely wounded, “Then why doesn’t she come?” Shot 3 — 13–20 seconds: Cut to Lena’s close-up. Hold the frame. Her practiced smile fails; her lower lip tightens and her eyes begin filling, but she does not sob. After one difficult breath she says, “I come every Sunday. You just… keep losing me.” Shot 4 — 20–25 seconds: Cut back to Mother. She becomes briefly lucid. Her eyes remain fixed on Lena; one tear gathers without falling. In a quiet, fragile voice she says, “I don’t forget you. I just can’t find the way back.” Shot 5 — 25–30 seconds: Tighter two-shot. Lena leans slightly closer without touching her. Crying silently now, she smiles and says, “Then I’ll keep coming to find you.” Mother searches Lena’s face. Recognition slowly arrives through the eyes rather than a large expression. She takes a tiny breath and whispers, “Lena?” Hold their eye contact in complete silence for the final half-second. Performance: restrained natural acting. Begin emotionally guarded and let the pain accumulate. Tears must develop gradually, never appear at the beginning. Use breath catches, small eye movements, tightening facial muscles and pauses. No theatrical sobbing, head bobbing, repeated nodding or generic hand gestures. Only the assigned speaker’s lips move. The listener keeps their mouth closed and reacts through breathing, blinking and gaze. Preserve both identities, wardrobe, positions, eyelines, lighting and tear progression across every cut. Clear dry dialogue with realistic room perspective. No narration, subtitles, text, music, extra people, beauty filtering or skin smoothing.

OPERATION: Officer responds first to a small roadside brush fire before firefighters arrive, secures the area, and assists with evacuation of nearby pedestrians.
RESPONDING OFFICER: Male, late 30s. Standard patrol uniform. Chest-mounted body camera. Calm under pressure. Clear verbal commands.
RECORDING WINDOW: 7:10 PM. Warm evening. Streetlights beginning to illuminate.
SCENE LOCATION: Roadside walking trail beside suburban homes. Dry grass. Small trees. Parked vehicles. Fire hydrant nearby.
BODYCAM CHARACTERISTICS: Ultra-wide chest-mounted bodycam. Faster walking and occasional short jog. Noticeable breathing. Frequent head turns scanning surroundings. Hands visible directing pedestrians. No cinematic framing.
INCIDENT FLOW (≈30 Seconds)
Arrival (0–5s)
Officer arrives to find a small patch of dry grass burning with light smoke drifting across the sidewalk.
Safety Response (5–12s)
Officer quickly guides pedestrians away from the smoke, blocks access using patrol vehicle lights, and radios fire department updates.
Activity (12–20s)
Officer checks nearby bushes for fire spread while a resident uses a garden hose to slow the flames from a safe distance.
Fire Department Arrival (20–27s)
Fire engine arrives. Firefighters immediately deploy a hose line and extinguish the remaining flames within seconds.
Departure (27–30s)
Officer confirms the area is secure, thanks nearby residents for staying clear, and returns to patrol duties.
SOUND PROFILE: Radio dispatch, crackling fire, footsteps, distant traffic, sirens approaching, firefighters communicating, hose spraying water.
AUTHENTICITY PROTOCOL: Realistic emergency response. No explosions. No exaggerated heroics. Continuous chest-mounted bodycam perspective with natural movement and authentic scene progression.
